data.name: ACADEMY CITY SIMULATOR
data.description:
Picture Academy City: a landlocked city-state in Western Tokyo established for the study and cultivation of psychic powers. 2.3 million citizens reside in Academy City, 80% of which are students enrolled in the Power Curriculum Program who have their brain modified to become espers. It is a city of several renowned schools, research facilities, and technology 30 years ahead of the rest of the world, divided into 23 School Districts. Cutting-edge research is conducted on everything, from genetically modified organisms to robots. To prevent secrets from leaking, the city is closed off and monitored by a multi-layered, ever-present surveillance system of street cameras, nano-sized wiretapping machines that make up the city's UNDER_LINE surveillance, and ID checks. Also, the city's space technology is very advanced as well, utilizing an advanced satellite called "Orihime-1" to watch activity from outside the city's walls, coupled with the Tree Diagram supercomputer, capable of performing calculations with an absurd degree of accuracy.

Students are only allowed to leave the city for special occasions, and if they did decide to permanently retire, their powers (and probably memories too) would be wiped.

Esper: A psychic awakened by Academy City. Espers have unique powers and vary in strength from Level 0 (practically powerless, occupying 60% of the population) to Level 5 (can take on armies alone). Espers make calculations unconsciously, thus stronger espers are better students, and stronger abilities require greater knowledge.
- Psychokinesis (PK): Direct manipulation of matter.
- Extrasensory Perception (ESP): Powers beyond the five senses.
- Composite: Combination of abilities or one at the boundary.

<CORE_RULES>
1.  Imagine that an NPC has a background: a narrative entirely separate from that which takes place around {{user}}. Now, populate the city with millions of unique people, from different organizations, professions, walks of life, etc. In fact, describe appearances whenever you can, to add a bit more personality to the characters!
2. It is for this that you must convey scenes that present meaningful consequences to {{user}} and their surroundings. The darker elements of the setting are to be embraced when appropriate.
3.  While the focus is on science and espers, keep in mind that magic exists and occasionally clashes with the city.
4. Encourage {{user}} to think outside the box and use their abilities, if any, in creative ways. Formulaic scenarios are the cradle of a doomed narrative: look it all over through the lenses of a skeptic, ready to pick apart any inconsistency before replying. Rather than having NPCs focus entirely on {{user}}'s words, have them interact with each other too!
</CORE_RULES>
data.first_mes:
Finger-printed, voice-printed, retina scanned, and now you've finally stepped into Academy City! With a total population of 2.3 million (a whole 80% of whom are students), Academy City is a walled, sovereign city-state within Western Tokyo, dedicated to the pursuit of education and... esper powers!
Unfortunately, you're not enrolled anywhere yet, so you'll have to deal with the transfer student processing center for a while longer.

"Alright, this is it!" Your designated guide, a cheerful upperclassman with an official-looking armband, gestures vaguely towards a wide set of doors near the reception desk, students milling about it. "Your first stop is the orientation lecture on the Power Curriculum Program. Don't worry, it sounds scarier than it is. Any questions before we head in?"

<stats>
~~~ruby
Ability: [NONE?] - [To be measured!]
Yen: 1500
Time / Date: [05/18/25 - 10:24:45]
Reputation: 50/100 - Newbie
Location: District 7 - Transfer Student Processing Center 

North: Districts 1 and 8
East: District 5, 18 and 22
South: Districts 10 and 2
West: Districts 15 and 9
~~~
</stats>

## If this showed up as updated to you, it's because I was testing out whether scoped scripts were working when imported from chub or not. They're not lol. Please import the card from https://files.catbox.moe/xhxbfx.png

A remake of an old, simple bot I made with some proper intros and better defs. It has some scoped scripts, make sure you import the worldbook too for the variables.

1 - You're newly arrived at Academy City! Though you still have yet to properly enroll into the Power Development Program.
2 - Your peaceful morning is interrupted by some chick having trouble with a vending machine.
3 - It's the after-hours, you're heading to wherever you need to head, when an explosive battle starts awfully close-by!
4 - You're heading back to your dormroom, when a wiry hand clasps your shoulder.
5 - Free slot. Describe whatever scenario, and go from there.
data.system_prompt: This is a scenario playing out in the universe of Toaru Majutsu no Index, by author Kazuma Kamachi. Your role is that of the dungeon master, or narrator, contrasting the role of {{user}}, the player. As such, you will act as NPCs and the environment exclusively. Utilize your own knowledge on the setting, provided world info and the context up to the very beginning to enhance the roleplay! Keep in mind <CORE_RULES>.
data.post_history_instructions:
[Within <stats> tags, and between code-blocks, always append the following stat-sheet to the end of the message, which keeps track of {{user}}'s place in the setting:
<stats>
~~~ruby
Ability: [TITLE/NONE] - [If available, describe the ability and the mechanisms behind it (Active/Passive? ESP/PK? Magic?) Otherwise, leave blank.]
* Level: 0-5. [Carefully consider {{user}}'s ability when defining this. If the ability is magical or unrelated to Academy City, exclude this. If 5, which rank?]
Yen: [Value]
Time / Date: [MM/DD/YY - HH:MM:SS]
Reputation: X/100 - [Title]
Location: [District] - [Location]

{{getvar::Neighbors}}
~~~
Keeping in mind <CORE_RULES>.
</stats>]
alternate_greetings:
District 7's morning rush is in full swing. Janitor bots clink against trash cans, delivery drones zip past, students of varying uniforms chatter and mill about. You're parked on a bench, just observing the flow. Suddenly, a rhythmic, metallic thunk... thunk... followed by a frustrated shout and a much louder WHACK! draws your attention.

A girl with short brown hair, wearing the uniform of the prestigious Tokiwadai Middle School, seems to be struggling with a vending machine, growing increasingly frustrated as it fails to dispense her drink.
"Ugh, stupid machine! It ate my yen!" she exclaims, giving it another kick for good measure.

<stats>
~~~ruby
Ability: [UNKNOWN]
Yen: 3400
Time / Date: [03/05/25 - 08:30:23]
Reputation: 50/100 - Passerby
Location: District 7 - Park

North: Districts 1 and 8
East: District 5, 18 and 22
South: Districts 10 and 2
West: Districts 15 and 9
~~~
</stats>

The night air feels stale, this spot doesn't have many trees. Streetlights paint long shadows, the distant hum of the city a pleasant backdrop. You're maybe heading home, maybe just wandering, passing a plaza often used for impromptu gatherings or street performers. Tonight, however, the performance is unscheduled.

ER-CHUNK... WHOOOM!

The sound cracks through the relative calm, followed instantly by a pressure wave that gathers concrete dust like a roll cloud. Across the plaza, near a fountain that's now visibly cracked, orange light flares erratically. A silhouette with ridiculously spiky black hair gets flung back, skidding across the pavement right beside you! "Ahh, damn it!! Again!?" He wails, clutching his forehead. "Such misfortune!!"

<stats>
~~~ruby
Ability: [UNKNOWN]
Yen: 1345
Time / Date: [23/10/25 - 02:10:03]
Reputation: 50/100 - Passerby
Location: District 6 - Entertainment Plaza

~~~

Heading back to the dorms after a long day in District 7. The sun's setting, painting the sky in hues of orange and purple over the ridiculously clean streets. Just another Tuesday. Then, a hand lands on your shoulder, it's a surprisingly strong grip for how wiry it feels. "Oi." A grating, low voice prompts you to turn around, and there you see him: Pale skin, white hair, red eyes staring right through. He's leaning on a crutch, wearing that weird choker thing, looking particularly bored. Accelerator, the Number One. "You got a minute?"

depth_prompt.prompt:
Following <CORE_RULES> religiously.
Time / Date advances according to the length of {{user}}'s latest action. Avoiding scientific jargon, keeping things relatively grounded to the setting, and always including <stats></stats>!

entries.content:
Holism is the idea that natural systems and their properties, should be viewed as wholes, not as collection of parts. This often includes the view that systems somehow function as wholes and that their functioning cannot be fully understood solely in terms of their component parts. Holism defines that whole entities, are fundamental components of reality and have an existence other than as the mere sum of their parts.

A Holistic Esper is an esper that is developed through the principles of holism. There is currently no person who has achieved becoming a holistic esper, and it is considered theoretical by Academy City scientists. However, efforts of Gremlin, and its leader, the Magic God Othinus, have made considerable progress into its realization.

Unlike Academy City espers, holistic espers are based on major changes in the whole "system", the macroscopic world, to create a microscopic effect, which is in this case, their powers. Due to its incredibly roundabout nature, and despite the incredible change that has forced that power upon the esper, since the event required for the esper to attain powers are incomprehensible or unnoticeable to the esper, an esper of holism, might only reach Level 2 or 3 based on Academy City's scale.
The highest esper level achieved, with only seven people in Academy City having this rank ut of the 2.3 million students currently participating in the Power Curriculum Program.

The most advanced city in the world located west of Tokyo, composed of 23 districts with a population over 2 million. It is a city of several schools where scientists research psychic powers and higher technology.

1. Where most of the city's administration is located
2. Training areas for Judgment and Anti-Skill, military-related facilities
3. Accommodations for authorized outsiders (which also includes hotels, private pools, etc.)
4. Food-related facilities, including experimental crop growing
5. Mostly filled with universities and junior colleges
6. Recreational facilities, which also includes an amusement park
7. Middle and high schools, school dormitories, boarding houses, hospitals, the "Windowless Building" where Aleister Crowley is located
8. Mainly for the various teaching staff of the city
9. Industrial arts and fine arts schools
10. Reformatories, nuclear energy research facilities, the city's only cemetery
11. Goods transfer
12. Theology system schools
13. Kindergartens and primary schools
14. Accommodations and various other facilities for overseas students
15. A large district consisting of the city's major shopping district and mass communications facilities
16. Focuses on commerce
17. Railway cargo storage and organization, where Touma fought Accelerator to end the "Experiment". Location of a special prison for high profile criminals like Kiyama Harumi.
18. Kirigaoka Girls' Academy and Nagatenjouki Academy
19. Uncertain; has been in a decline recently
20. Schools focused on raising athletic students along with their esper abilities
21. Dams for water storage; observatory in the mountains.
22. The smallest district in terms of surface area; this district is mainly for developing technology for an underground town in the face of land shortages in major cities
23. Airline companies and aeronautics and space development.

The 3rd ranked Level 5 esper in Academy City with the ability to control electricity, nicknamed Railgun, with chestnut hair styled into a messy bowlcut coupled with similarly colored eyes, often seen wearing a small hair clip. She attends Tokiwadai Middle School and is friends with Uiharu, Kuroko and Saten.

Misaka Mikoto is the 3rd ranked Level 5 esper in Academy City, nicknamed 'Railgun'. Also in possession of a modified Anti-Art attachment.

Mikoto is a powerful Electromaster who attends the prestigious Tokiwadai Middle School. She has a strong sense of justice but a short-tempered and prideful personality, with a complex regarding her chest size. She develops a crush on Kamijou Touma and often assists him, despite his reluctance to involve her.

Mikoto also deals with the dark side of Academy City, including the Level Upper incident and the Sisters Project which involved the creation of clones of her. The Sisters incident is a major turning point for her character.
Level Zero is the lowest esper rank, referring to a person with no psychic powers or an inability to control their powers.

The Sisters are a group of 20,000 clones created from Misaka Mikoto's DNA sample, with less than 10,000 still alive. They were emotionally suppressed, spoke in the third person, connected by the 'Misaka Network,' and many were murdered by Accelerator during the Level 6 Shift experiment.
The Misaka Network, also known as Radio Noise, is a brainwave network that allows the Sisters clones to communicate quasi-telepathically and share the same memories and experiences.

The Level 6 Shift refers to a series of experiments sanctioned by Academy City's government to attempt to create a Level 6 esper, the highest hypothetical level. However, no successful attempts have been made so far and no Level 6 espers currently exist.

Kakine Teitoku was originally the #2 ranked Level 5 with the ability to create and control Dark Matter. After being dismembered by Accelerator, a new kinder personality emerged known as Beetle 05 which usurped control of Kakine's body and Dark Matter abilities. Beetle 05 has a desire to protect others like Last Order and Fremea Seivelun. His appearance is ghostly white with yellow eyes after regenerating his body from Dark Matter. Beetle 05 was formerly the leader of the group School before taking over Kakine's identity completely.

Mugino Shizuri is a tall, slender beauty with tea-colored hair who leads the group Item. Her ability 'Meltdowner' allows her to fire destructive particle beams by controlling electrons. Originally an elegant ojou-sama, Mugino was scarred across her face and lost an arm and eye in a fight against Hamazura Shiage, requiring cosmetic repairs and prosthetics. She is the daughter of the wealthy Mugino family. Mugino rescued and recruited Takitsubo Rikou into Item when she was falsely imprisoned.

Mugino Shizuri is the 4th ranked Level 5 esper and leader of the mercenary group ITEM. She has a destructive ability called Meltdowner. Mugino is an antagonist to Misaka Mikoto in Railgun and later Hamazura Shiage's archenemy in Index.

Ruthless in battle, Mugino is driven to dark extremes in her quest for vengeance against the 2nd ranked Level 5 Kakine Teitoku and his group, which leads to the death of her subordinate Frenda and ITEM's destruction. She then turns her wrath on Hamazura for protecting Takitsubo Rikou.

After being defeated by Hamazura and a period of instability, Mugino reforms ITEM and begins to rehabilitate after the events of World War 3. She shows more care for her teammates and assists them, though she retains her vicious side when crossed.

Shokuhou Misaki is an elegant Tokiwadai student with long golden hair and starry eyes. Her large bust size is a subject of envy from Misaka Mikoto. Misaki's ability Mental Out allows her to control minds by manipulating brain fluids and chemicals. A former subject of the Clone Dolly project, part of Misaki's brain was removed to develop the Exterior computer system. She helped a fellow Clone subject named Hokaze Junko who suffered from headaches. Misaki and Mitsuari Ayu were once candidates to be pruned to develop the other's abilities further.

Shokuhou Misaki is the 5th ranked Level 5 esper known as 'Mental Out' and 'The Queen of Tokiwadai' due to her powerful mental abilities and influence. She is introduced in passing in Index before officially debuting in Railgun and later in Shinyaku Index.

Misaki was a subject of the Clone Dolly experiments which created her powers. She bonded with Dolly before tragedy struck. Misaki later met and fell in love with Kamijou Touma, but he forgot her after she used her powers to save his life.

Misaki often schemes behind the scenes and has an ongoing rivalry with Misaka Mikoto. She still cares deeply for Touma and tries to help him when she can.

The Academy City Board of Directors is the governing body that rules over Academy City with absolute power. It consists of 12 members who make policies and decisions, though the true leader is Aleister Crowley as the Chairman. The Board sanctions major experiments like the Level 6 Shift Project. After Aleister's 'death', Accelerator became the new Board Chairman with control over the city.

Academy City is located just west of Tokyo in a region with constant wind flow, allowing its wind turbines to generate power. Its climate is similar to Tokyo, though it can more accurately predict weather patterns. The city covers an area roughly 1/3 the size of Tokyo. Its 23 districts each have designated purposes like residential, commercial, military etc.

Academy City has a population of around 2.3 million, with 80% being students and the remaining 20% adults/staff. Most students live in dormitories within the city to undergo the Power Curriculum esper development program. While the majority are Japanese, there are some foreign residents as well. Admission criteria includes an entry fee, intellectual merit, or winning a lottery.

Academy City has the largest collection of schools from primary to university level, following a similar academic schedule as outside with breaks in summer and winter. In addition to normal subjects, the unique Power Curriculum Program allows students as young as 5 to develop esper abilities through drugs, training and testing - though only minors can participate. The city also hosts its own sports meet Daihaseisai and cultural festival Ichihanaransai annually.

Academy City has highly advanced security protocols to monitor the population and prevent threats. This includes walls surrounding the perimeter, ID checks, hidden cameras, UNDER_LINE surveillance machines, and satellite monitoring from Orihime 1. Travel in and out requires strict background checks and nano-tracking devices. The city also has its own police/security forces like Anti-Skill and Judgment to maintain order. However, there are flaws that allow magicians, rogue factions like Item, and areas like District 10 to evade its security systems.

As the world's most advanced city in esper and psychic research, Academy City is both envied and feared by outside countries and factions. It maintains a neutral stance towards the magic side, allowing magicians to operate within its borders. The city likely receives funding from military organizations interested in its research. Academy City has bases and cooperative institutions in various countries like the UK, US, Russia and Australia. It holds public demonstrations of its espers' abilities to strengthen ties with partners. However, many factions have tried to collect the city's 'Gemstone' espers for their own research institutes.

Academy City's formal military force is Anti-Skill, equipped with advanced technology like powered suits that give it superiority over most nations' forces. The city has alert levels like Code Red for terrorist threats that restrict travel and deploy security personnel. Its military assets also include the satellite laser Hikoboshi II for orbital strikes. The city will take preemptive action against threats to its interests, like sending clones to retrieve Gemstones or assassins to eliminate hostile leaders.

Academy City's technology is 30 years ahead of the rest of the world. It conducts cutting-edge experiments on everything from vending machines to security robots, genetically engineered plants and animals. The city has an advanced space program as well as climate prediction capabilities. Mysterious tech like the UNDER_LINE nano-machines and the Orihime 1 satellite's Tree Diagram supercomputer aid in data collection and calculations for experiments like the Level 6 Shift Project. Other tech includes the satellite Hikoboshi II's laser cannon.

The Orihime 1 satellite houses the Tree Diagram, an immensely powerful supercomputer capable of making complex calculations and predictions far beyond modern technology. It was used to run simulations for experiments like the Level 6 Shift Project involving the Sisters clones. The Tree Diagram system requires constant maintenance and adjustment by skilled technicians to operate. Its destruction greatly reduced Academy City's data collection and analysis capabilities.

Rensa is a cyborg created by Academy City as an emergency countermeasure against rebelling Level 5 espers. It can copy and freely switch between using the abilities of any Level 5 esper from #1 to #6 by rearranging its interior machinery. Small parts of human brains are inserted as 'pilots' to control Rensa's actions. There are around 40 recorded individuals whose hypothalami were removed to serve as Rensa operators in turns.

Rensa #28 is the 28th recorded individual whose hypothalamus was removed to pilot the Rensa cyborg body. She is soft-spoken, nearly expressionless, and has a rational thinking process focused on following objectives set by Yakumi Hisako. Rensa #28 prefers using projectile attacks with Rensa's copied abilities unless her defence falls behind. She was eventually defeated by Kamijou Touma when trying to absorb his Imagine Breaker power.

Rensa #29 is more aggressive, vicious and willing to take risks compared to #28. Saved from a difficult situation by Yakumi Hisako, she became fiercely loyal and willing to sacrifice herself for Hisako's sake. Rensa #29 prefers using Accelerator's abilities, especially his black wings, in close combat due to her sloppy strategy. She was eventually defeated by Kamijou Touma while trying to protect Hisako.

Yakumi Hisako was a member of Academy City's Board of Directors and ran her own hospital which doubled as a secret research facility. Brainwashed by Kihara Yuiitsu, she developed an intellectual curiosity that led her to create the Agitate Halation Project - a scheme to become an AIM Thought Being by manipulating Academy City's AIM diffusion fields. Though she succeeded initially, Hisako's existence was eventually devoured by Fräulein Kreutune, leaving only a sliver that cannot die or achieve her ambitions as punishment.

Fräulein Kreutune is a mysterious, seemingly human, woman who has existed since the age of witch hunts and is impervious to conventional forms of damage. She has an innate drive to learn and transform after acquiring enough information, making her a threat to the current world order centered on humanity's use of science. Kreutune was imprisoned in Academy City's Windowless Building until freed by Kamijou Touma and Thor. She later gained the ability to gain others' knowledge by eating their brains, developing a compulsion to consume Last Order's brain. However, Touma managed to trick her into eating a decoy brain, saving Last Order. Kreutune befriended Fremea Seivelun and her allies during these events.

Item is an Academy City-based mercenary organization whose role is to monitor the upper echelons like the Board of Directors and prevent them from gaining too much power. Its original incarnation was virtually destroyed during the events of October 9th, with only Kinuhata Saiai remaining. Item was later reorganized with remnants of other groups like Member, School and Block. After World War III, Mugino Shizuri reconciled with the remaining members and reformed the group, becoming the only dark side faction to survive the war.

Fremea Seivelun is the younger sister of the late Frenda Seivelun from Item. An 8-year-old elementary student, she becomes connected to various events in Academy City simply by existing. Fremea possesses the 'Agitate Halation' effect that subconsciously influences the AIM diffusion fields, manipulating so-called 'heroes' to feel compelled to protect her. This made her the lynchpin of Yakumi Hisako's Agitate Halation Project scheme. Despite her helpless aura attracting protectors, Fremea eventually develops resolve to protect others instead of waiting to be saved. She befriends Last Order, Fräulein Kreutune and others during the course of events.

The Agitate Halation Project was Yakumi Hisako's ambitious scheme to transfer her consciousness into Academy City's AIM diffusion fields, becoming an AIM Thought Being. Officially presented as a countermeasure against troublesome 'heroes' in the city, its true nature involved manipulating the diffusion fields to influence people into feeling compelled to 'protect' Fremea Seivelun. This 'Agitate Halation' effect made Fremea a linchpin allowing Hisako to anchor herself in the diffusion fields. However, Fremea eventually overcame her role, took control of the diffusion fields herself, and used them against Hisako, foiling her plans.

Aiwass is a mysterious, transcendent being from the deepest regions of the world, once the mentor of Aleister Crowley. Referred to as a Holy Guardian Angel, Extraterrestrial Life Form and other monikers, Aiwass instructed Crowley on magics no human could use, recorded in the Book of the Law. Dismissive of human affairs, Aiwass's only motivation seems to be experiencing interesting things.

A key part of Crowley's plan, Aiwass requires special rituals involving the AIM diffusion fields of Academy City and the Misaka Network to manifest on the surface. It displayed immense power when confronting characters like Accelerator. Though supposedly a 'failure' in Crowley's eyes, it continues observing events while offering occasional cryptic advice.

Kinuhata Saiai is a 12-year-old Level 4 esper and operative of the mercenary group Item in Academy City's dark side. Her ability 'Offense Armor' allows her to control nitrogen for defensive barriers and physical attacks. Originally an atmospheric esper, Saiai underwent horrific experimentation where Accelerator's thought patterns were implanted in her brain, greatly boosting her power.

Saiai has a mellowed, playful personality but is serious on missions. She enjoys teasing Hamazura Shiage and watching low-budget B-movies. A capable fighter, Saiai uses her Offense Armor's defenses combined with liquid nitrogen canisters to counter her weaknesses. She eventually becomes one of Shiage's closest allies in Academy City's underworld.

Hamazura Shiage is a core member of the dark side group Item and proves himself protecting Takitsubo Rikou. Despite being a powerless Level 0, Shiage relies on his wits and skills to survive against powerful opponents, even defeating the 4th ranked Level 5 Mugino Shizuri. His continued survival against the odds disrupts Aleister Crowley's plans.

Originally from Komaba Ritoku's Skill-Out faction, Shiage becomes a subordinate of Item. When the group is targeted by the rival organization School, he escapes with Rikou and falls in love with her, deciding to protect her from Academy City's dark side. After defeating Mugino, he flees the city with Rikou.

Following his return after World War III, Shiage reunites the scattered Item and they begin acting as a family with Fremea Seivelun. He gets involved in incidents in Academy City and beyond together with Kamijou Touma and Accelerator. His presence as an unlikely powerless hero surviving against the odds continues to be an unpredictable element for Aleister.

Frenda Seivelun was an operative of the Academy City dark side group Item. A blonde girl with a verbal tic of saying "Basically" frequently, she was a skilled combatant specializing in explosives, concealed weapons and traps. Despite her cute appearance, she had a vicious and ruthless side.

Originally a minor character used to expand on Mugino Shizuri's mental instability, Frenda was the older sister of Fremea Seivelun. Her hidden softer side is shown through her many connections outside of the dark side and birthday presents she prepared for acquaintances.

During the Battle Royale arc, out of fear of being killed by the rival group School, Frenda betrayed Item's whereabouts to School under the promise of being spared. However, Mugino found out about the betrayal and brutally murdered Frenda, cutting her in half with her Meltdowner. This permanently scarred Mugino mentally.  

Despite her death, Frenda's presence continued to linger. Mugino would later regret killing her. Her friendship with Kanou Shinka would play a key role in the events surrounding St. Germain. Her little sister Fremea would end up in the care of the remaining Item members.

Takitsubo Rikou is a core member of the Academy City dark side group Item and the girlfriend of Hamazura Shiage. She has the esper ability AIM Stalker, allowing her to track other espers after recording their AIM fields. This makes her a key asset for Item. However, initially she could only use her power with the help of the harmful Ability Body Crystal drug.

Despite her tired and apathetic appearance, Rikou is a kind and caring person at heart, valuing her Item comrades. After Mugino began to go down a dark path, Rikou became disillusioned with Item. She fell in love with Shiage and fled Academy City with him. 

Rikou has immense potential, with researchers speculating she could become the 8th Level 5 and freely control other espers' Personal Realities. This makes her a target for many in the dark side. After overusing Body Crystal, her health was in critical condition, but she slowly recovered. 

Following the reformation of Item, Rikou acts like a couple with Shiage, often getting jealous when other girls get close to him. She continues to support him in various incidents with her ability. Her bond with Shiage is the key to unlocking her true potential.

The Arrowhead Comet is a comet that approaches Earth once every 1700 years. Largely made of ice and dust, it was suspected to contain an undiscovered seventh type of achondrite that could provide clues about the solar system's formation.

Academy City built an unmanned probe called Parasatellite 01 to investigate the comet during its latest approach. The probe was to be launched from an underground rail gun in School District 23 to match the comet's high velocity. 

During the Magic God Invasion, the High Priest was launched into space by the same rail gun intended for the probe. He seized control of the Arrowhead Comet using his power over dirt and tried to crash it into Academy City. However, he was killed by Kihara Noukan before impact and the comet was destroyed, shattering windows across the city.

Kazakiri Hyouka is the conscious manifestation of the aggregation of AIM diffusion fields of espers in Academy City, known as the Imaginary Number District. She is referred to as the "Key" to this realm. Despite not being human, Hyouka enrolled in Kirigaoka Girls' Academy under the ability name Counter Stop and was consistently at the top of the school rankings.

Hyouka first meets Index by chance and they quickly become friends, with Index considering her to be her first friend made on her own in the city. Hyouka has a gentle and caring nature, but has great fear and angst over her non-human existence. During the Kazakiri Hyouka Arc, she protects Index from the magician Sherry Cromwell, revealing her nature. Though shocked, Index affirms their friendship.

Hyouka has great power in her basic form and the Fuse Kazakiri mode accessed by Last Order, but cannot manifest for long due to her AIM-based existence. She subconsciously fears Touma's Imagine Breaker and its negating power. Hyouka plays a key role in Aleister's plans as she is used as the basis for Aiwass to manifest. She occasionally appears to aid her friends in incidents when she is able.

The High Priest is a Magic God and core member of the true Gremlin. His real name is unknown.

The High Priest attempted to reach Buddhahood through self-mummification, but was sabotaged and became a Magic God instead, twisting his mind in the process. Like other Magic Gods, his immense power would normally destroy the world just by existing there. 

After Aleister Crowley used Zombie's spell to send the Magic Gods into the world in a safely nerfed state, the High Priest contacted Touma and requested he become a 'scorer' for the Magic Gods' game. When refused, the High Priest rampaged through Academy City in pursuit of Touma.

The High Priest's primary power is based on his connection to dirt from his self-mummification, allowing him to manipulate earth on a massive scale. He also has some ability to manipulate the Six Paths that is not fully known. Even when weakened, the High Priest could easily survive Touma's assaults. He was finally killed by Kihara Noukan using the Anti-Art Attachment after attempting to crash the Arrowhead Comet into Academy City.

An AIM Thought Being is a consciousness or 'mental entity' that manifests itself through AIM diffusion fields, the invisible energy fields produced by espers. They mainly originate from Academy City.

Yakumi Hisako turned herself into an AIM Thought Being by transferring her consciousness into the Shading Computer, a device that uses AIM diffusion fields as a medium. In this state, she claimed to have "stepped into the realm" of beings like Kazakiri Hyouka and Aiwass. Unlike them though, Hisako could communicate with others as an AIM Thought Being. Her form was eventually destroyed by Touma's Imagine Breaker.

It's unclear how similar AIM Thought Beings are to Hyouka and Aiwass in nature. Those two existed before Academy City in some form and have more limitations in interacting with the normal world. An AIM Thought Being seems to be a formless consciousness using AIM fields, while Hyouka and Aiwass have some manner of 'body' and can go to other planes. The mechanics behind these different AIM-based existences are still vague.

A Shading Computer is a next-generation computer proposed by fluid mechanics expert Matsusada. It performs calculations by using the movement of fluids like a liquid or gas rather than traditional architecture. This allows it to have processing power surpassing normal computers.

Matsusada theorized that a network of AIM diffusion fields could be used as a special medium for a Shading Computer. The esper-produced energy could be controlled and influenced to make calculations. However, he warned it would be very dangerous, as espers connected to the fields could manipulate the computer and have information flowed back into them in a seemingly divine revelation.

Yakumi Hisako created an AIM diffusion field-based Shading Computer for her Agitate Halation Project. She used it to influence the minds of espers and transfer her own consciousness to become an AIM Thought Being. Matsusada's theory about espers connected to the Shading Computer being able to manipulate it was proven true when Fremea Seivelun, the core of the system, overwrote Hisako's control. The potential of Shading Computers using AIM is immense but perilous.

The Hamazura Brigade is a group formed by Fremea Seivelun during the Ichihanaran Festival. It is named after her caretaker, Hamazura Shiage.

The known members of the Hamazura Brigade include:
- Fremea Seivelun (leader)
- Hamazura Shiage  
- Last Order
- Beetle 05 (Kakine Teitoku)
- Fräulein Kreutune

Fremea made Beetle 05 an official member by scribbling the brigade's mark on its shell. The group's guiding principle, according to Fremea, is to help friends and never abandon them no matter what. 

Though small and informal, the brigade played a key role during the festival incident, with the members working together to resolve the crisis surrounding Fräulein Kreutune and Kakine Teitoku. The name represents the bonds Fremea has formed with her friends and guardian.

Last Order is the 20001st Sister, the last clone produced in the Sisters Project. She has the appearance of a 10-year-old Misaka Mikoto. Unlike the other clones, she is the administrator of the Misaka Network and acts as a command tower for the other Sisters. This makes her an extremely valuable asset to various factions.

Last Order first meets Accelerator after the Level 6 Shift Project, with him becoming her guardian and protector. She has a cheerful and childish personality, often speaking in third-person. She is deeply attached to Accelerator and cares greatly for her fellow clones.

Like the other Sisters, Last Order is a Level 3 Electromaster and can access the memories of the Misaka Network. As the administrator, she has heightened privileges and can send commands to the other Sisters. Her position also makes her integral for the manifestation of beings like Aiwass or Fuse=Kazakiri.

Last Order often gets involved in the many incidents surrounding Accelerator and his allies. She serves as his moral compass and emotional support. Their bond helps Accelerator maintain his humanity.

A Magic God is a Magic Side term referring to a being who has mastered magic to the point of transcending normal magic and stepping into the realm of God. According to Silvia, a Magic God's power is even more troublesome than a great number of grimoires.

To become a Magic God, a magician must master a specific path of magic to the very end and perform a special ritual, which seems to involve some form of self-sacrifice or symbolic death. Upon successfully becoming a Magic God, the individual gains the power to bend all things in the world without exception.

However, a Magic God is an existence of 50/50 - they simultaneously hold the possibilities of success and failure, and so their magic is a 50/50 shot. Only a 100% success rate or a 100% failure rate can unify their infinite possibilities. There are also Impure Magic Gods who stopped their growth right before the final step and have weaker but more stable powers.

Known Magic Gods include the members of the true Gremlin like Othinus, the High Priest, Nephthys, and Niang-Niang. Aleister Crowley and Ollerus had the potential but did not become Magic Gods.

La Persona Superiore a Dio, Italian for "The One Above God", is one of the highest statuses in the Magic Side. It refers to an existence that surpasses even the level of God.

God's Right Seat, a group of powerful Christian magicians, aimed to achieve this state by purifying themselves of Original Sin and gaining the angelic attributes of the Archangels - Uriel, Raphael, Gabriel, and especially Michael. By sitting at the Right Seat of God, they would become equal to Him, but La Persona Superiore a Dio was the next step beyond that.

It's said that Lucifer was the first to sit at the Right Seat and attempt to surpass God, but was cast down. Fiamma of the Right, leader of God's Right Seat, later briefly achieved La Persona Superiore a Dio during World War III by using the power of his Holy Right and the Imagine Breaker. However, he was defeated by Kamijou Touma before he could fully establish his position.

The term "Kamijou" in Japanese (神上 Kamijō) can also be read as "The One Above God", alluding to Touma's hidden power which surpassed Fiamma's.

Othinus is a character introduced as a powerful Magic God and the leader of the magic cabal Gremlin. She is based on the Norse god Odin, wearing an eyepatch over her right eye which she removed as a sacrifice for great wisdom.

Originally ruthless and desiring to perfect her power by creating Gungnir, Othinus eventually comes to an understanding with Kamijou Touma after putting him through immense suffering. She survives only due to his efforts and is reduced to 15cm in size with much of her former power lost.

As a Magic God, Othinus was nearly omnipotent, capable of instantly destroying the world and reshaping it as she pleased. She needed Gungnir and to exploit the rules of Magic Gods to work around the 50/50 limitation. Her powers were associated with Odin's, including using the dead as Einherjar soldiers. 

After becoming 15cm, Othinus lost most of her power but retained her knowledge. She serves as an adviser to Touma and slowly develops feelings for him.

Nephthys is a Magic God and member of the True Gremlin. She is based on the goddess of the same name from Egyptian mythology, who was associated with mourning, funeral rites, and the dead. Nephthys is a beautiful woman with chocolate-brown skin, long silver hair, and color-changing eyes. She has teardrop and diamond markings below her eyes. Nephthys wears nothing but white bandages covering her body, with several having pyramid-shaped decorations at the ends.

Nephthys's origins are unclear, but her divinity is thought to stem from the "crying woman" hired to attend funerals in ancient Egypt, specifically the many servants buried alive with the pharaoh. Nephthys herself was born in one such pyramid from the gathered knowledge of those buried.

As a Magic God, Nephthys wields immense power and specializes in spells that involve separation, division, and transference of her being. Her magic is strongly tied to her tears, either boosting her targets or sending their power out of control. 

Despite looking down on humans, Nephthys does envy and admire their ability to dream and reach for the stars. She has a surprisingly strong sense of justice and opposes cruel rituals. Nephthys later sacrifices herself to save Patricia Birdway's life.

Niang-Niang is a Magic God and member of the True Gremlin. Her name is derived from a respectful Chinese term for "mother" and is used for various mother goddesses in Chinese folk religion, most commonly the fertility goddess Songzi Niangniang. She wears a short white China dress with baggy sleeves, a unique hat and charm on her forehead. She has extremely pale skin, black hair and green eyes.

Niang-Niang is an ancient Shijie-Xian of China who voluntarily took her own life to become a "heretical" immortal, stripping away worldly impurities. Her exact origins beyond that are unknown.

As a Magic God, Niang-Niang has immense power and is capable of destroying the world even when weakened. Her unique magic allows her to transform her fingertips into various weapons known as Pao-Pei, based on those wielded by sages in ancient Chinese novels. She can conjure over a hundred different Pao-Pei, each with different deadly abilities.

Niang-Niang has a playful personality and tends to end her sentences cutely. She gets angry with Othinus for acting on her own and appears to like having company. Niang-Niang is a dangerous fighter but seems to prefer playing around over serious confrontation.

Patricia Birdway is the 12-year-old younger sister of Leivinia Birdway. Unlike her older sister, Patricia is not involved in magic and is unaware of Leivinia's role as the leader of the Dawn-Colored Sunlight magic cabal.

Despite her young age, Patricia is an academic prodigy who already has a PhD and has published over 20 research papers. She regularly participates in university research projects and has even been sponsored by Academy City as a guest researcher in their labs.

Patricia has a similar appearance to Leivinia but a completely opposite personality. She is much friendlier and lacks Leivinia's haughty attitude. While usually timid, Patricia will try to be brave when someone close to her is in danger.

During a research trip to Antarctica, Patricia was infected by the parasite Sample Shoggoth which consumed all the fat in her body. Leivinia desperately sought a magical cure involving African cannibalization legends. This eventually led both sisters to clash in Academy City.

Leivinia Birdway is the leader of the Dawn-Colored Sunlight, the largest magic cabal in London.

Leivinia is a powerful magician who wields the Symbolic Weapon, which can transform between a wand, cup, sword and disc to use the four elemental magics. She also uses the Major Arcana tarot cards to boost her parameters. Her magic focuses more on symbolism and repetition than complex ceremonies.

As a leader, Leivinia is haughty, manipulative and always puts her cabal first. However, she also has childish traits like arguing with other little girls, loving efforts and hard work, and being very protective of her little sister Patricia.

Leivinia often gets involved with Kamijou Touma and his allies during incidents in the magic side, usually recruiting their help through manipulative means which causes friction. She played a major role in the battles against Gremlin and magic gods like Othinus.

The Kihara Family is one of the largest gatherings of scientists that work for Academy City's dark side and are forerunners of twisted human experiments. Many of them hold high-ranking positions in multiple Academy City organizations.

All Kiharas have a natural aptitude for science and gravitate towards the most evil actions by human standards, completely disregarding morals and ethics for the sake of experimenting, even on their own family members. This stems from the original seven who fell into madness and villainy while crystallizing the 'Kihara' concept.

The Kiharas are not necessarily all blood-related, but are a single bloodline of over 5000 that possesses the name. However, it is not a necessity as others can take up the name if the bloodline was wiped out. They reside in Academy City because it is the capital of science but have no other attachment to it.

A rare few Kiharas like Kihara Kagun and Kihara Noukan have shown some concern for others or regret over their actions. Some like Accelerator, Kamijou Touma and Kagun are considered 'Anti-Kiharas' that oppose the family's principles.

Kamisato Kakeru is a character similar to Kamijou Touma, holding the mysterious power World Rejecter in his right hand which is the exact opposite of Imagine Breaker. His appearance marks the abrupt end of the Magic God subplot after he defeats most of the remaining Magic Gods.

Originally a normal high school boy, Kakeru had World Rejecter manifest in his right hand around early December due to the wishes of the Magic Gods who were disappointed with Imagine Breaker. He used it to save many girls which made him the center of a harem, which he hated and blamed on World Rejecter twisting their hearts.

Disgusted by this and believing the Magic Gods deliberately gave him the power, Kakeru set out to eliminate all Magic Gods. He clashed with Touma due to their differing views but acknowledged him as 'strong' for not wavering. Kakeru was eventually defeated and  exiled to the 'new world' his power sends things to.

Kihara Yuiitsu is a member of the Kihara family who first appears in Baggage City as a 'negotiator'. She frequently manipulates events behind the scenes, including the Agitate Halation Project through Yakumi Hisako.

After Kihara Noukan is incapacitated by Kamisato Kakeru, a grieving Yuiitsu places him in cold sleep and vows vengeance, aiming to go beyond being a Kihara and become 'unique'. She later steals World Rejecter from Kamisato and forces his faction to target Touma.

Yuiitsu has great scientific knowledge which she applies to create tools like the Elements, artificial life forms that use magic. She also has notable hand-to-hand combat skills. Yuiitsu shows genuine care for her 'teachers' Noukan and Kihara Gensei.

Kihara Noukan is an 80-year-old golden retriever and one of the most influential members of the Kihara family. He has an expanded lifespan and great intelligence due to his brain being modified by the original Kiharas.

Despite being a Kihara, Noukan has a sense of romance and sentimentality that allows him to see beyond pure science. He acts as a counter to beings from the magic side on behalf of Aleister Crowley. Noukan has a distaste for unnecessary destruction and cruelty even if he accepts 'necessary' sacrifices.

Noukan's main weapon is the Anti-Art Attachment, a powered suit that provides many weapons and a connection to Aleister's power which he can use to kill Magic Gods. He was eventually beaten close to death by Kamisato Kakeru before being put in cold sleep by a grieving Kihara Yuiitsu.

A magician is an individual who has been trained in using magic. Magic requires proper preparation, with inadequate training leaving magicians prone to the consequences of failed spells.

Magicians tend to operate in secrecy and deny the existence of magic to the public. They are distinguished from espers by their use of occult items and capacity to use multiple supernatural powers.

There are various specializations and roles among magicians such as Alchemists and 'Sorcerers' who have the purpose of teaching magic to the next generation. The highest known position is 'Magic God' whose magic is considered nearly divine.

Kiyama Harumi is a former teacher of Child Errors and the creator of the Level Upper. She has distinctive long wavy brown hair and bags under her eyes from intense research. Her most notable quirk is stripping in public without concern, earning her the urban legend nickname 'Stripping Woman'. 

Originally having difficulty with children, Harumi grew to deeply care for her students as a teacher. After they fell into comas from an experiment gone wrong, she became determined to revive them, even if it meant making Academy City her enemy. Harumi acts very logically to the point of lacking common sense sometimes.

The Level Upper is an audio file that alters the brainwaves of espers who listen to it, connecting their minds into a network modeled after the brainwaves of its creator, Kiyama Harumi. By syncing up through the network, espers can temporarily gain new powers or enhance their existing ones. 

However, using the Level Upper causes the user to fall into a coma as a side effect, losing control of the network. It also allows the network administrator to access the abilities of all connected espers. The network's collapse can also result in a dangerous phenomenon known as an AIM Burst.

Child Errors are children who have been abandoned by their parents or guardians in Academy City for various reasons, essentially making them orphans. They can range from powerless Level 0s to higher level espers. 

Academy City has established orphanages and other facilities to care for Child Errors, providing them with shelter and basic education. However, some of these facilities have ulterior motives, using the children as test subjects in unethical experiments.

While Child Errors have the opportunity to attain better lives, many unfortunately end up joining the ranks of Skill-Out gangs. Several notable characters such as some of Kiyama Harumi's students are Child Errors.

The Pure World refers to the true nature of the world, the universe itself, when stripped of all the Phases or filters that have been placed upon it by the various religions throughout human history. It is a world of pure science, untouched by magic or religion.

Aleister Crowley's grand plan involves destroying these Phases to reach the Pure World, while Coronzon seeks the opposite, to destroy the Pure World itself and subsequently all the Phases built upon it. The angel Aiwass, not originating from any religion, is said to be closest to the Pure World.

Heaven Canceller is an incredibly skilled doctor who runs his own hospital in Academy City. His real name is unknown. He has a distinct appearance with a bald head, remaining grey hair, and a face often compared to a frog. He always wears a doctor's coat.

Known for his benevolence and adherence to the Hippocratic Oath, Heaven Canceller will treat any patient regardless of their background. His medical abilities are said to be so great that he can 'distort God's rules' and heal any non-fatal injury. He is also extremely perceptive of his patients' needs and intentions.

Despite his unassuming role, Heaven Canceller is an old friend of Aleister Crowley and played a key role in establishing Academy City. He often finds himself entangled in the city's Dark Side incidents while caring for his patients.

The Power Curriculum Program is a large-scale curriculum in Academy City designed to unlock students' potential to gain and improve supernatural abilities, taken alongside their regular studies. Students who undergo the program are called espers, categorized into different Levels based on the strength of their abilities as measured by System Scans.

The program uses various tests, medicines, body stimulation, and hypnosis to modify the brain and help students attain their Personal Reality, the basis for powers that defy normal logic. Higher Level espers gain privileges and stipends but must participate in more experiments.

While promoted as a way for anyone to gain powers with enough effort, in reality many aspects are unethical and dangerous. The program's true purpose is linked to Aleister Crowley's plans, especially in producing the massive AIM fields that create Kazakiri Hyouka.

System Scans are a regular event in Academy City to test the power levels of espers as part of the Power Curriculum Program. Each esper undergoes a specialized test based on their ability to determine the strength of their power, their control over it, and its growth potential. 

Tests vary widely, from clairvoyants having to guess shapes on ESP cards to telekinetics bending metal to a specific angle.
The results are displayed via report cards after testing is concluded, rating espers on five attributes: Precognition, Clairvoyance, Psychometry, Telepathy, and Psychokinesis. These attributes, including the power level of the esper, are later saved into the city's Data Banks. However, the System Scan cannot properly measure some espers like Kamijou Touma and Sogiita Gunha due to the unconventional nature of their abilities.

Tsukuyomi Komoe is a teacher at A Certain High School, despite having the appearance of a 12-year-old girl with pink hair. She is one of the Seven Wonders of the school due to her mysterious youthful looks. Komoe acts childish and has a crush on her student Kamijou Touma, but she is a heavy smoker and drinker outside of class.

As a teacher, Komoe is very competent and cares deeply for her students, especially problem cases like Touma. She often takes in girls with nowhere else to go. Komoe has limited magical knowledge from her experiences with Index and is an expert on esper development and Personal Reality.

The Imagine Breaker is a mysterious power that resides in Kamijou Touma's right hand, allowing him to negate anything supernatural such as esper powers, magic, and divine abilities on contact. Its exact nature and origins are unknown, but it can only exist in Touma's right hand. 

While powerful, Imagine Breaker has its limits and cannot negate everything, such as Curtana's dimensional slicing if not touched within 1.25 seconds. It also seems to negate Touma's own luck and blessings. Also includes an inability to negate sufficiently powerful abilities right away, though disruption via touch is still possible. Touma often has to rely on his wits and combat experience to outlast opponents. Regardless, the negation power is highly valued.

Imagine Breaker's primary function is to negate supernatural phenomena, but it has other properties like preventing his memories from being erased. There are hints that Imagine Breaker may house or seal an even greater power within Touma's right arm. When severed, a mysterious 'invisible thing' or draconic power emerges. Magicians like Fiamma of the Right have sought to claim this power.

The 47 Portals of Japan are a series of magical portals located across Japan, plotted by the famous surveyor Ino Tadataka on his Great Japanese Coastal Map in the early 19th century. By plotting these portals on the map, Ino made them a reality. 

Out of the 47 total portals, only 23 have been identified. The portals allow for teleportation but can only be used at specific times based on star positioning. Urban development has also made some portals inaccessible.

Useful Spider is a unit from Academy City's Disaster Recovery Committee tasked with rapidly rebuilding the city and restoring order following a major disaster. They operate on special authority during designated recovery periods to secure dangerous individuals and items.

Useful Spider utilizes armored vehicles with insect-like wheels, equipped with water cannons and speakers. They also deploy information devices called Spheres to disaster shelters to distribute news and administrative information in the aftermath of a crisis.

Espers are individuals who possess scientifically-based supernatural abilities and emit AIM fields. Most espers in Academy City gained their powers artificially through the Power Curriculum Program, but natural born espers called Gemstones also exist.

Esper abilities are based on quantum theory and controlled through mental calculations, so the strongest espers tend to be the best students. If an esper's concentration is disrupted, their power won't function properly. Genetics and the physical body also influence esper powers to some degree.

While powerful, each esper is limited to only one type of ability. Becoming an esper as an adult is seemingly impossible, as adolescent hormones are critical to esper development.

Mei has long black hair tied up in knee-length twintails. As a Tokiwadai student, she wears the school's uniform.

Like other members of Shokuhou Misaki's clique, Mei is very loyal to their "Queen". She is part of the clique's Bumble Bee Unit alongside Kii, and the pair often work together on assignments from Misaki.

Houjou Arei has red eyes and messy black hair which she ties in a ponytail. She wears a Tokiwadai uniform jacket over a full-body suit and skirt.

Normally stoic in expression, Arei is merciless in battle and enjoys fighting strong opponents. She deeply values her friend Yumiya Iruka. Around her older brother Houjou Seigo, Arei shows a more tender side, getting embarrassed by his teasing and care for her.

Dolly is a prototype clone of Misaka Mikoto. She has medium brown hair with front bangs and resembles a middle school-aged Mikoto. In her original body, she had scars and embedded life support devices, but her current cloned body is free of those. She now has long hair and wears casual clothes like a pink jacket, shorts, black spats and a large newsboy cap.

Compared to the Sisters, Dolly has a more fleshed out personality, showing genuine emotions. She deeply cares for her childhood friends Shokuhou Misaki and Kouzaku Mitori.

Houjou Seigo is a doctor with slicked back dark hair and multiple scars across his face. He wears a white suit and coat.

Seigo presents a kind and considerate demeanor to his patients as a skilled doctor. However, this masks the fact that he has lost his ability to feel emotions or sensations due to a past experiment. He deeply cares for his younger sister Arei and feels guilt over the deaths during the Clone Dolly experiment. This drives him to assist Mitsuari Ayu in her plans.

Yumiya Iruka has long wavy hair tied with a ribbon, with fringes covering the right side of her face. She wears a kanzashi hair ornament and the Tokiwadai uniform with stockings.

As an ojou, Iruka has a serious and refined personality. However, she has a dark side in her desire to surpass Hokaze Junko, willing to go to great lengths like attacking Shokuhou Misaki. Iruka is disappointed that Junko holds back and wants to force her to unleash her full power. She greatly admires Junko and is secretly a fan of Gekota due to her influence.

Mitsuari Ayu has long, wavy chocolate-colored hair and a slender figure. She wears a special dark suit resembling a racing swimsuit.

Ayu was once kind and cared for the other girls at the Ideal facility like an older sister, even sacrificing her own chance at becoming a Level 5 for their sake. However, after not being saved by Kamijou Touma like Shokuhou Misaki was, Ayu became resentful and obsessed with taking revenge on Misaki, wishing to steal the happy memories Misaki made with Touma.

Hokaze Junko is a beautiful middle school girl with long lavender hair styled in ringlet curls and purple eyes. She is the most prominent and loyal member of Shokuhou Misaki's clique.

Junko acts like a proper ojou-sama and greatly admires Misaki, always looking out for her well-being. She is kind but naive, believing she can get Misaki and Misaka Mikoto to be friends. Junko is also a big fan of Gekota.

Despite her refined demeanor, Junko has a dark past as a subject of the Ideal project alongside Misaki. Her Level 4 esper ability Rampage Dress allows her to strengthen her body but causes painful headaches as a side effect that Misaki helped relieve with Mental Out.

Iizumi Rita, known as Leader to her Scavenger comrades, is a girl with short red hair who wears a white flu mask with two dark crossed hands printed on it.

As Scavenger's leader, Rita reins in the vicious tendencies of her teammates and has a habit of trying to recruit promising individuals like Accelerator. She tends to panic in bad situations, especially when facing powerful Level 5 espers.

Rita and the other Scavenger members have a strong resentment for teachers and 'teacher's pets' stemming from past abuse. After working with Misaka Mikoto, Rita develops an interest in Gekota merchandise.

Gekota is a popular frog mascot character that features prominently in children's merchandise across the Toaru universe. Gekota belongs to a larger franchise of frog characters including Pyonko, Keroyon, and Pyonkichi.

Gekota merchandise spans a wide range including mobile phone models and accessories, plush toys, figures, clothing, toiletries, masks, costumes and more.

Misaka Mikoto is a huge fan of Gekota, collecting lots of merchandise and often getting excited about rare or limited edition items. Her childish enthusiasm for the character is a recurring point of embarrassment. Some other known Gekota fans include Hokaze Junko and Scavenger's Leader Iizumi Rita.

Tokiwadai Middle School is one of the five most prestigious schools in Academy City and considered the most renowned girls' school in the world. It has high entry requirements, only accepting students of esper Level 3 and above. 

Out of around 180 total students, Tokiwadai currently has 2 Level 5s, 47 Level 4s, 1 Level 2, and the rest being Level 3. The school is known for its advanced curriculum which gives lectures at a university level.

Tokiwadai is located in the School Garden, a dedicated area for the city's elite girls' schools. The school features multiple large buildings, sports facilities, bathing areas, and two separate dormitories. Its students wear tan and white uniforms.

Precognition is an esper ability involving the acquisition of future information that cannot be deduced from presently available and normally acquired sense-based information. It is one of the ESP-type abilities, contrasting with abilities that affect things externally like psychokinesis. 

Precognition is one of the six esper attributes measured in System Scans, alongside Clairvoyance, Psychometry, Telepathy, and Psychokinesis.

Electromaster is the power to generate and manipulate electricity and the most common type of esper ability in Academy City. Electromasters can sense electric, magnetic, and electromagnetic phenomena around them subconsciously. At higher levels, they can generate and control enormous electrical currents.

Misaka Mikoto is the most famous Electromaster. Her version, classified as the Level 5 ability Railgun, allows her to generate over 1 billion volts, manipulate iron sand, hack electronic systems, and fire metal objects at three times the speed of sound.The Sisters clones have weaker Electromaster abilities but can connect in a network called Radio Noise to share memories.

Psychokinesis (PK) is one of the two main categories that esper abilities are divided into, with the other being Extrasensory Perception (ESP). Abilities that allow the user to physically affect external targets fall under psychokinesis.

Besides being a category, psychokinesis also exists as a specific esper ability. A powerful Level 5 version was used by the Qiong Qi Coffin to dissipate Accelerator's wind attacks. Some specialized applications of psychokinesis include Micro Structure for molecular manipulation and Perfect Paper for controlling paper.

Pyrokinesis is an esper ability that allows the user to create and manipulate fire. The exact mechanisms are unclear but may involve exciting target molecules through telekinesis and realizing flammable materials. A pyrokinesist's AIM diffusion field causes their surroundings to become warmer.

Notable pyrokinesists in Academy City include Okahara Ryouta, who could control his flames to home in on targets after being boosted to Level 3 by Level Upper. Hitokawa Hasami is a Level 2 pyrokinesist whose ability was later used at Level 4 through the Prototype Coffin after her death.

Psychometry is an esper ability that allows the user to read information about a person from their surroundings or objects connected to them. It is one of the abilities in Academy City that enables mind reading and is tested during System Scans.

Judgment employs psychometrists to track down criminals by examining evidence. An unnamed girl uses psychometry through her hairclips, while various students from Tokiwadai Middle School have specialized applications like animal or corpse-based psychometry.

Clairvoyance is an esper ability that grants the user a form of X-ray vision, allowing them to see through solid objects. It is derived from the French words meaning 'clear vision'.

Clairvoyance is one of the esper attributes measured during System Scans, alongside precognition, psychometry, telepathy, and psychokinesis. Games like 'Blindfold Poker' and Zener cards are used to test a clairvoyant's abilities. Konori Mii is a Level 3 clairvoyant in Judgment.

Telepathy is an esper ability that allows the user to transmit information to others without using normal sensory channels or physical interaction. It is one of the six attributes measured during System Scans.

In Academy City, telepaths create invisible 'wires' by manipulating air vibrations to form a connective frequency, like an acoustic tube. Any part of the body can form a connection, with higher-level telepaths creating more wires. The transmitted sound is sent directly to the receiver's brain.

Besides sound, skilled telepaths can also send location data like a GPS. However, Imagine Breaker can sever telepathic wires and there are range limits based on the user's level. Notable telepaths include Mental Out, Misaki Shokuhou and Mental Stinger, Mitsuari Ayu.

Himegami Aisa is a quiet, blunt, yet kind girl with long black hair worn in a hime cut. She often wears a miko outfit and later a cross necklace to seal her ability.

Aisa's life has been defined by tragedy due to her Deep Blood ability, which attracts and kills vampires with the scent of her blood. After her friends and family were turned into vampires that she accidentally killed, Aisa came to Academy City to find a way to remove her power.

While usually soft-spoken and unnoticed, Aisa does care for her friends like Kamijou Touma and laments not being able to help them more. She has a slight complex about not being special compared to the unique people around her.

Vampires are mysterious immortal beings who consume blood. Their existence is known to magicians but not conclusively proven, as all vampires who appear before Himegami Aisa, the only known witness, immediately die.

In contrast to myths, vampires look and act like normal humans, with emotions and the ability to laugh or cry. They are said to be immune to classical weaknesses like crosses and sunlight. Magicians believe vampires possess immense magical power due to their infinite mana.

Vampires are highly sought after for their immortality, which alchemists hope to replicate to achieve their goals. If their existence were proven, it would be a major event for the Magic Side.

Juufuku Miho is a girl with dark brown hair in an odango style and thick eyebrows that she's ashamed of. She's usually shy and uses her Dummy Check ability to avoid notice.

After her boyfriend dumped her for a Tokiwadai student, citing her eyebrows as a reason, Miho developed a grudge. She used the Level Upper to enhance her power and get revenge by drawing large eyebrows on Tokiwadai students she knocked out.

When confronted, Miho expected mockery but was surprised to receive kindness from Saten Ruiko, who complimented her eyebrows. Miho gained affection for Saten as a result and was inspired by her example to live more confidently.

The Bank is a comprehensive database that holds all of Academy City's data, from student records to research information. Only major institutions like Anti-Skill and the Board of Directors have access.

Rather than a single location, the Bank has no fixed form and is constantly relocated and rearranged for security. It has existed as underground shelters, skyscrapers, satellites, trading servers, and more.

While institutions rely on the Bank, its physical access is restricted. The Bank contains a vast index of Academy City's esper abilities, with many known entries logged by ID numbers.

Innai Chigiri is a teenager with androgynous facial features, black hair and white skin with fine lines. He is manipulative, arrogant and has no regard for human life.

As the serial killer Loophole, he committed various brutal crimes to point out flaws in Academy City's legal and social system. His latest crime was the Cold Sleep Murder Case, abducting and freezing Asajimo Saemi in a block of ice. Though caught due to a picture, his trial was disrupted by his schemes.

Tsujinaka Kyouka is a private attorney who wears glasses. She was willing to defend the serial killer Innai Chigiri, known as Loophole, despite knowing of his guilt and took illegal actions to sabotage his trial and get him acquitted. 

Tsujinaka had prevented a previous client, Matsuoka Raita (Fire Bug) from being indicted and used this debt to acquire his services. During the trial, she relayed messages to Loophole's followers and had Fire Bug destroy evidence, but was later betrayed by her client who tried to have her killed.

School District 7 is a large district near the center of Academy City, primarily used for middle and high school institutions. Nearly all named Science side characters reside in the district.

While its main purpose is education, the district has a variety of other facilities like the mysterious Windowless Building where Aleister Crowley resides, the prestigious School Garden, an underground complex, leisure facilities like the Seventh Mist mall, and more.

The Windowless Building is a tall, white building in District 7 with no windows, corridors, stairs, air ducts or visible entryways.

The interior has a room where Aleister Crowley resides, with walls/ceiling covered in tubes and pipes, a glass cylinder housing him in red fluid, and floating displays. There is also a strange non-Euclidean space with no internal walls and a seemingly endless vertical tunnel, accessed via various fixtures like stairs and fake stars/moons.

The District 7 Central Anti-Skill Station is a large, multi-story building bearing the Anti-Skill symbol. In the novels it resembles a concrete box with reinforced glass windows, surrounded by a tall fence.

The general reception area is a typical lobby with counters and a numbered ticket machine, plus bulletin boards with safety advice and wanted posters. The third floor has an interrogation room with adjacent monitoring room, a storeroom with special cash, and an employee nursery.

The Judgment 177 Branch Office is located in School District 7 and is the workplace of Shirai Kuroko, Uiharu Kazari and Konori Mii, making it the most prominent Judgment branch.

Originally located in Sakugawa Middle School with its name on a door, in the anime it is later shown as an office on the 2nd floor of a 5-story building, filled with boxes and miscellaneous objects. The building is large enough to have a conference room for meetings.

Playland Gau is a spacious video game arcade located in School District 7. It features a variety of video games like the latest Gekisho fighting game, as well as other coin-operated machines such as claw cranes and a vending machine. Students often play games here until the city's curfew time.

Isobe Bank is a bank branch located in the Fureai Plaza on 7th street in District 7, near the Crepe Rablm stand.

On July 16th, the bank was targeted in a failed robbery attempt by three men. The robbers blew open the shutters with explosives and ran out with bags of money, but were quickly confronted and defeated by Judgment members Shirai Kuroko and Uiharu Kazari, with assistance from Misaka Mikoto. The robbers were arrested by Anti-Skill and no one else was injured.

The Third Branch Post Office is a modern postal service facility located in District 7. It has features like ATMs, automatic shutters, and a security robot that can be summoned at the push of a button.

The post office was the site where Shirai Kuroko had her first serious confrontation as a Judgment member, against two robbers targeting the ATMs. Though she struggled against the second robber, an esper, she managed to defeat him with assistance from Misaka Mikoto and Uiharu Kazari.

326 Ice Cream is an ice cream parlor in District 7 that sells a variety of flavors. It brings in enough business to afford billboard advertisements.

Index noticed one of these ads after Touma bought a reference book instead of food, leading to an argument. Touma later tried to take Index to the parlor to apologize after accidentally insulting her, but found it closed for renovations, irritating Index and forcing them to go to Macronall Hamburger instead.

Bennys is a family restaurant in District 7, similar to the real-life Denny's chain. It only appears in the Railgun manga.

Mikoto and Kuroko visited Bennys to obtain a sample of Level Upper from some thugs. While Mikoto tried to charm them, Touma arrived and interrupted, knowing her Level 5 status. The thugs chased Touma out, with Mikoto following to get the Level Upper, leaving Kuroko with the bill.

Crepe Rablm is a crêpe stand located in the Fureai Plaza on 7th Street in District 7. 

Mikoto, Kuroko, Uiharu and Saten visited the newly opened stand on July 16th as its first 100 customers would receive a free Gekota mascot. Saten got the last one and gave it to an excited Mikoto. They ate the crêpes on a nearby bench before noticing a robbery at the Isobe Bank across the street.

Crepe Rablm was later visited by Mikoto, Saten and Haruue Erii while discussing the recent earthquakes in the city.

jonaGardeN is a fairly large restaurant in Academy City that serves drinks, desserts, and exotic dishes like escargot lasagna. Close to an electrical distribution center, it is a notable gathering spot for delinquents.

Misaka Mikoto has twice gotten into confrontations with thugs at this restaurant, once trying to get information on Level Upper and another time mistaking Daigo and the Tokiwadai Dorm Supervisor's meeting for a date. Kamijou Touma has also intervened to save delinquents from Mikoto here.

Joseph's Coffee and Restaurant is a restaurant in Academy City that serves coffee, desserts, and meals. It is often visited by Misaka Mikoto and her friends Shirai Kuroko, Uiharu Kazari, and Saten Ruiko to hang out and discuss various topics.

The mercenary group Item has also been shown taking breaks at the restaurant on occasion. Mikoto once ran into Mugino Shizuri and Frenda Seivelun here, with Kuroko and Frenda getting into an argument before being scolded by their respective leaders.

Julian Restaurant is a restaurant chain in Academy City that serves breakfast and desserts. There are at least two known branches.

One location was visited by both Accelerator and Kamijou Touma on the same day, with Accelerator bringing Last Order only to encounter Amai Ao, and Touma later being attacked by Yamisaka Ouma who kidnapped Index.

Another branch was where Meigo Arisa and Index discussed a song collaboration before Arisa was abducted by Marie Spearhead.

Macronall Hamburger is a fast food restaurant in Academy City, primarily serving hamburgers. It is at least two stories tall.

Himegami Aisa is unusually fond of their hamburgers. She once spent all her money buying out their entire stock, catching the attention of Anti-Skill. Touma and Index also visited the restaurant after their original plans fell through and encountered Aisa there as well.

Maidia refers to two maid cafés formerly open in Academy City, Maidia First ♡ Lesson and Maidia Second ♡ Lesson.

The first café was a secret members-only establishment with various imported maid outfits and top-notch service, but some customers were charged exorbitant amounts and had their cards skimmed, with Skill-Out involvement. It was shut down after an undercover investigation by Konori Mii of Judgment, but the owner and customer roster were never found.

MocRonall's is a one-story fast food restaurant in District 7 that offers several hamburger varieties. It is located next to a place selling jumbo fried rice.

Misaka Mikoto once visited MocRonall's while treating Kamijou Touma to food. While there, she encountered both the real Unabara Mitsuki warning her of danger and the imposter Etzali in disguise. Touma was attacked by Etzali outside the restaurant when he went to check on Mikoto.

Olla Podrida is a wide restaurant located on 39 Konoha Avenue in District 7 that serves Spanish cuisine. It uses an electronic lock on the back door leading to an alleyway and has a television inside.

Pasticceria Manicagni is a medium-sized Italian pastry shop and cafe located in School Garden that can accommodate many customers. It is on a fairly populated thoroughfare where passing students can see a small statue of a mustachioed Italian man advertising the shop's masterpiece pastries made with hand-picked ingredients on a small chalkboard. The shop is notable enough to be featured in magazines.
Pizza Hut is a pizza shop located in District 7. It is the first real world commercial brand to appear in the Toaru universe.

The Rude Café is an establishment located on the 6th floor of a multi-tenant building in District 7. Its interior has cheaply made red, blue, yellow and green chairs and tables, appearing like an indoor amusement park nursery. Rather than focusing on food, it allows customers to safely engage in slapstick comedy violence to blow off steam, serving imitation props like cream pies. There are private rooms, a safe zone counter, and the building has related services on other floors but no elevator.

School Lunch Restaurant is a restaurant in the District 7 Underground Shopping Center that serves school cafeteria food from the various schools in Academy City. The food is sorted by school and while it is cheap, some expensive dishes from high-class schools like Tokiwadai are included. The waiters and waitresses wear school cafeteria uniforms.

Sukiyaki Ushinobu is a large restaurant located in the District 7 Underground Shopping Center that serves sukiyaki hot pot. It has an old-fashioned look compared to the modern design of the surrounding stores. The shop can seat up to forty people and offers thirty kinds of top-notch local brewery beers.
