The Underground Shopping Center or Underground Mall is a network of underground streets located beneath School District 7 that functions as a large shopping mall. It is part of Academy City's experiments in underground construction technology.

The mall has many interconnecting streets and levels, linking to various stores, arcades, karaoke boxes, live houses, cafeterias and restaurants in a maze-like layout. It also has a train station and separation walls to prevent flooding in emergencies.

A Certain Iron Bridge is a notable 150 meter long landmark in District 7 that spans a river. There is a railway line running on the riverbank beneath it.

It was the site of Misaka Mikoto's first clash with Kamijou Touma, a later confrontation between them during the Sisters Arc, and battles against Accelerator and Vento of the Front. The bridge has been featured in other story arcs as a meeting spot.

The Automated Bus Maintenance Terminal was a temporary depot exclusively used to service automated buses in District 7 during the Daihaseisai.

The large terminal, built on the former site of demolished abandoned buildings, was 30 meters wide and several hundred meters long. It could hold 50-70 large buses tightly stacked together and featured metal pillars, a galvanized iron roof, robotic repair arms, and large two-story ultrasonic cleaning machines.

keys: School District 7 Central Hub Transformer Station
entries.content:
The School District 7 Central Hub Transformer Station is a facility that controls the flow of electricity through the power network in District 7.

The station covers a 30 square meter area and has one two-story square building. Equipment resembling drums are lined up across the area with power cables stretching from the ground around them.
entries.comment: School District 7 Central Hub Transformer Station

entries.content:
The School District 7 Multilevel Overpass is an overpass with several floors, some used for purposes other than roads. Twelve bus roundabout boarding areas are connected by it.

The top 'third floor' is a giant road, the second level has plants growing on it resembling a sports field, and the bottom level underground has a complex shopping area with pathways similar to the Underground Shopping Center.

The overpass was the site of several battles during the Ichihanaran Festival between various powerful characters.

The School District 7 Water Department is a facility in the southern end of District 7 responsible for managing the district's water supply.

It is comprised of two main buildings - one fenced-in concrete building and a high-rise with a smooth rectangular roof containing several septic tanks. The buildings are connected by a reinforced concrete pathway surrounded by glass.

The high-rise contains water purification equipment and large tanks for cultivating water purification microbes. During the Elements invasion, Touma's classmates tried to acquire the microbes to purify their school's pool.

Book-On is a fairly spacious bookshop in Academy City that sells a variety of books, CDs and DVDs. It is located across the road from a dark alleyway.

Touma visited the store to buy a reference book on cat care for Index. Misaka 10032 waited outside with her cat before leaving to fight Accelerator, leaving the cat at the entrance. Touma later found Misaka 10031's remains in the alley after buying the book.

For the Athletic Type!! is a supermarket in District 7 that sells both ordinary foods like blue fin tuna and special genetically modified Academy City produce such as 'Space Carrots' and 'Genetically Improved Lettuce #3'.

Those who frequent the supermarket and surrounding area apparently know of Index and refer to her as 'the devourer'.

Green Mart is a convenience store chain with multiple branches in Academy City and Japan. It sells a variety of items like food, beverages and magazines.

Mikoto once read a magazine at a Green Mart before meeting Touma outside. One of the branches was targeted in the graviton bombings. Mikoto was also in a Green Mart during Vento's invasion, unaware of the chaos happening in the city.

Seventh Mist is a multi-story shopping mall in District 7 with an accessible roof used for events. The price of clothing is much cheaper than shops in the School Garden.

It has been visited by various characters and was notably the target of the final graviton bombing, where Touma secretly used his power to save everyone. The mall has also held a summer festival on the roof that Mikoto wanted to attend for a Gekota promotion.

La Mancha is a multi-story department store in District 7 that remains open after the student curfew, apparently catering to non-student demographics.

Mikoto notably bought her disguise from this store during the Sisters Arc, which she used until it was destroyed in her battle against ITEM.

The Anti-Art Attachment (A.A.A.) is a powered suit developed in Academy City, primarily for use by Kihara Noukan against magic. It assembles itself from various dropped components around the user.

The A.A.A. has a vast arsenal of weapons like guns, swords, drills and armor, with immense firepower. Its key function is forming an external link to Aleister Crowley, allowing the user to draw on his power and techniques. Noukan has storage hangars for it across the city.

Misaka Mikoto later created her own modified A.A.A. after first using the original. Kihara Yuiitsu also made one using the Elements. The A.A.A. has played a role in many major events and battles.

The Horus Pet House is a pet shop located in School Garden, District 7. Its logo features depictions of animals from JoJo's Bizarre Adventure in the manga, but not the anime. 

Kongou Mitsuko uses the shop to buy food for her pet snake Ekaterina. Shirai Kuroko accompanied her on one such trip, getting the idea to use turtle meat for a hot pot while there.

Heaven Canceller's Hospital is a large hospital located in District 7 where the Heaven Canceller works. It has at least eleven levels including a basement with a morgue and chapel. The hospital has taken in many notable patients.

The hospital is equipped with advanced medical technology under Heaven Canceller's direction. He often pushes ethical boundaries to save patients conventional medicine cannot help. However, this has strained his relationship with Aleister Crowley, his former partner.  

Many protagonists like Kamijou Touma and Accelerator have been treated here repeatedly following injuries from battles and experiments. The Sisters, Misaka clones, and other Dark Side elements have also been patients. The hospital has been featured in most major story arcs.

Hero's Cave is the nickname given to a dentist clinic in District 7 where a skilled pediatric dentist referred to as the most frightening dentist by local children works.

The clinic has all the necessary dental tools and equipment as well as a waiting room. The dentist is professional but blunt when discussing a child's dental health. He usually has two or three assistants with him.

Fremea Seivelun had to get dental surgery here after drinking too much hot chocolate. Kinuhata Saiai later forced a powerless Kuroyoru Umidori to visit the dentist.

Higuchi Pharmacology Laboratory 7 is a medical research center owned by Higuchi Pharmaceutics in District 7. It has several doctors, nurses, patients, and incubation tanks.

The lab was researching muscular dystrophy and requested Misaka Mikoto's DNA map to help patients. However, her DNA was actually used in an attempt to produce military clones, the Sisters, which ultimately failed before being taken up by the Level 6 Shift Project.

Mikoto later infiltrated the abandoned lab and discovered records about the cloning attempt, not realizing the project was still ongoing. Nunotaba Shinobu worked at the lab and one of the clones erased the records after Mikoto left.

The Accelerator Residence was a single room apartment on the 3rd floor of a building in School District 7, in room 311. It was Accelerator's place of residence until after August 31. 

The apartment had a layout similar to Touma's dorm room, with partitions for the kitchen and bathroom. It contained a sofa, table, and bed.

The Saten Residence is a student apartment in Academy City where Saten Ruiko currently lives. 

The apartment consists of a bedroom with a bed, desk, computer, dresser and bookshelf, and a kitchen with a stove and oven. It also has a bathroom.

Saten's apartment is frequently visited by her friends, especially Uiharu Kazari. It has been the site of conversations about Urban Legends and a shared meal between Saten and Frenda Seivelun.

Yomikawa Aiho is a tall woman with long dark hair tied in a ponytail and a large bust, usually wearing a green track suit that hugs her figure. 

Aiho has a kind and caring personality, especially towards children, and has sworn never to point a weapon at them. She takes her jobs as a teacher and Anti-Skill officer seriously, but can be laid-back off-duty, enjoying beer and public baths. Aiho often uses 'comedy-like' methods to solve problems without serious violence.

Aiho becomes the guardian of Accelerator, Last Order and Misaka Worst. She supports Accelerator and pushes him to be a better person. Aiho has been involved in many Dark Side incidents and battles throughout the city.

Family Side is an apartment complex located in School District 7. From the outside it resembles a student dormitory, but has some differences in security and services to distinguish it as an apartment building. It is meant for teachers but also allows non-teachers to live there.

The building has good security measures in place, with lock systems that scan biometric data. A single apartment unit has 4 rooms plus a living room, dining room and kitchen (4LDK), suitable for a family.

The Yomikawa Residence is a 4LDK apartment unit on the 13th floor of Family Side Building 2. It is the current home of Anti-Skill officer Yomikawa Aiho and her wards - Accelerator, Last Order, Misaka Worst, and Yoshikawa Kikyou.

The apartment is well-furnished with modern electronics and appliances. Aiho keeps it very clean and organized due to her habit of cleaning when stressed. The kitchen has high-tech cooking equipment that Aiho rarely used before Accelerator moved in, except for the rice cookers.

There are two Tokiwadai Dormitory buildings - one located outside School Garden where Misaka Mikoto and Shirai Kuroko reside, and one inside School Garden itself. Males are prohibited from entering the dorm rooms.

The exterior dorm is a three-story red brick building with a Western architectural style, featuring arched windows, white parapets and columns. The interior has a simple yet elegant design with modern security systems. It holds a midsummer festival every year where the usual male prohibition is lifted.

The interior dorm's appearance is unknown but students there are allowed single rooms and to keep pets. Residents include Shokuhou Misaki and Kongou Mitsuko.

Beehive is a grim-looking location in School District 7, filled with many small multi-tenant buildings. While meant to be rented out as business facilities, the lax tenant review process has resulted in it becoming a hideout for those with suspicious backgrounds.

The buildings in Beehive are used by runaways for cheap housing, as cages for dangerous pets, as workshops, and as bases for unrecognized cults. People can easily obtain leases from a website and often break into empty rooms to squat in them.

The Multi-Story Inn is a rectangular building located in School District 7. It was designed for sightseers from outside Academy City, likely due to the lack of land in the area.

Despite its ordinary exterior, the inside of the building is constructed so that each floor contains an entire high-class traditional Japanese inn, complete with gardens. This allows visitors to experience staying at a ryokan inn within the limited space of the city.

The Tsukuyomi Residence is an old apartment building in Academy City, with Tsukuyomi Komoe's room located at the end of the hallway on the 2nd floor. The building lacks its own bathroom, requiring tenants to use nearby public baths.

Komoe's room has a reinforced door and a traditional Japanese interior with tatami mats. It's often messy with beer cans and cigarette butts. The roof was destroyed by Index's Dragon Breath spell and is currently covered by a tarp.

Komoe frequently allows runaway students to stay with her indefinitely, with previous residents including Kamijou Touma, Index, Himegami Aisa, Musujime Awaki and Shokuhou Misaki.

The Kamijou Residence is a single room in a student dormitory in District 7, located on the 7th floor. It has an auto-locking door, a small kitchen area, and a bathroom. The main living space has a one-person bed, coffee table, TV, refrigerator, and bookshelves.

Touma lives here alone originally, but it becomes home to Index and the cat Sphynx later on. Touma often has to sleep in the bathtub. The balcony is close enough to the adjacent room, belonging to Tsuchimikado Motoharu, to move between them.

Many events center around the dorm, including Touma's first meeting with Index, magicians like Stiyl Magnus visiting, and later housing girls like Itsuwa and Othinus.

A Certain High School is a large, multi-building campus located on a hill in District 7. It has the typical facilities of a Japanese high school like lockers, a cafeteria, and accessible roofs. Touma's class is taught by Tsukuyomi Komoe.

The school uniform is a white dress shirt with dark blue pants for boys, and a dark blue sailor uniform with a skirt for girls. For gym classes and festivals, students wear white shirts with blue accents.

Many events occur at the school, such as the start of the new semester, Touma meeting transfer student Himegami Aisa, various comedic incidents with Touma and his classmates, and battles against magicians. The school was heavily damaged by the High Priest but students were able to temporarily relocate.

Sakugawa Middle School is a co-ed middle school located in District 7. It has a typical Japanese school layout with a multi-story main building connected to adjacent ones.
Notable students include Uiharu Kazari and Saten Ruiko. The school is often featured when focusing on their daily lives and conversations.
Events that occurred here include the Level Upper incident affecting many students, meetings of the Poltergeist investigation, and Hokaze Junko visiting Uiharu and Saten to investigate an urban legend.

Vending Machine #7116 is a broken beverage vending machine in Academy City that has a propensity for eating customers' money without dispensing drinks. It is an old machine with loose springs that can be forced to give a random drink with enough kicking force. The machine is frequently kicked by Misaka Mikoto in frustration over losing money to it.

Aogami Pierce is one of Kamijou Touma's classmates and friends. He is a seemingly ordinary high school student, but is an unabashed pervert with a wide range of fetishes. Along with Tsuchimikado Motoharu, he is part of the 'idiot trio' Delta Force with Touma. 

Aogami has perpetually closed eyes and blue hair, wearing piercings in his ears. His real name is unknown. He has a carefree and energetic personality, often making perverted comments and jokes. However, Aogami is surprisingly the class representative and has occasional moments of insight.  

He often gets into comedic conflicts and shenanigans with Touma and Motoharu. Despite his lecherous nature, Aogami does care for his friends. His exact esper ability is unknown, but he is physically fit and agile. Aogami provides an element of comic relief and normalcy to contrast Touma's adventures in the Magic and Science Sides.

Fukiyose Seiri is a classmate of Kamijou Touma's and often acts as the voice of reason and discipline to the Delta Force's antics, especially towards Touma. 

Seiri is a tall, well-endowed girl with long black hair and a serious demeanor. She has a strong sense of responsibility and does not tolerate the shenanigans of her classmates, often resorting to physical force to reprimand them. However, Seiri does care for her friends and classmates underneath her stern exterior.

She is also a health nut, constantly trying various health products she buys from shopping channels. Only Touma is aware of this secret hobby. Seiri has demonstrated notable athletic abilities in sports and martial arts when the need arises.

While a minor character, Seiri serves an important role in representing the normal side of Touma's life and providing a contrast to his adventurous, often dangerous exploits in the Magic and Science Sides. She harbors feelings for Touma, but has difficulty expressing them.

Edasaki Banri is one of the children in Academy City who have been abandoned by their parents. Banri was once a student of Kiyama Harumi and a friend of Haruue Erii. Like Erii, she is a telepath.

Banri has brown hair tied back with a headband and a cheerful, energetic personality. She was very close to Kiyama as a student. However, she and the other children were used in an experiment by Kihara Gensei and fell into comas as a result, driving Kiyama to desperation. 

Banri and Erii would communicate telepathically as children. After Banri fell into a coma, Erii could still hear her friend's thoughts and searched for her. Banri was eventually rescued by Misaka Mikoto and her friends, then revived from her coma by Kiyama.

Despite her hardships, Banri remains a positive and determined person. She enrolls at Sakugawa Middle School with Erii after her recovery and even expresses a desire to join Judgement to help others, showing her kind heart.

Uiharu Kazari is a first-year student at Sakugawa Middle School and a member of the disciplinary committee Judgment, where she works alongside Shirai Kuroko in the 177th Branch Office.

Uiharu is a petite girl with black hair and golden-brown eyes. Her most distinctive feature is her headband made of artificial flowers. She has a gentle and friendly personality, but can be clumsy and shy at times. As a judgement member, Uiharu has a strong sense of justice, but lacks combat abilities. 

Instead, her true skills lie in computer technology. Uiharu is a genius hacker who can infiltrate and counter any security system. She provides critical mission control support to Kuroko and other Judgment members. Her esper ability, Thermal Hand, is very weak and limited in practical use.

Uiharu is best friends with her classmate Saten Ruiko, who often playfully flips her skirt. She is also close with Misaka Mikoto and Shirai Kuroko. Uiharu's computer skills have proven vital in many incidents across Academy City.

Saten Ruiko is a Level 0 Academy City student and a classmate and close friend of Uiharu Kazari, Mizaka Mikoto and Shirai Kuroko.

Saten has blue eyes and long black hair with a small white flower on the left side. She prefers wearing medium length skirts rather than the short ones typical of her peers. In the anime, her height is listed as 160 cm (5'3") but she is described as less than 150 cm in the novels and manga.

Saten has an outgoing, friendly and slightly shameless personality, not hesitating to flip her friend Uiharu's skirt in public. While once apathetic about being a Level 0, she grew envious of her friends' powers and briefly used the Level Upper, but came to accept herself. She has a deep sense of friendship and helped Uiharu and Kuroko reconcile. Saten is superstitious and loves urban legends despite the scientific setting. She is also very athletic and strong, capable of damaging advanced weaponry with just a baseball bat.

Komaba Ritoku was a leader of Skill-Out, where both Hamazura Shiage and Hattori Hanzou were members. A large and imposing man, he was later killed during Accelerator's first mission in GROUP. 

Ritoku had a gorilla-like appearance, being very large with a body built like a tank. He wore a black leather jacket and pants. As a Skill-Out leader, he was respected as a good person who cared about his subordinates. He forbid them from getting involved in unethical activities and only targeted espers who actively misused their powers on Level 0s.

Before his death, Ritoku was the guardian of Fremea Seivelun, the younger sister of ITEM member Frenda. Protecting Fremea was his main motivation for taking control of Skill-Out. When confronted by Accelerator, Ritoku put up a valiant fight using his knowledge of Accelerator's weaknesses but was ultimately overpowered. His actions were driven by a desire to protect the weak and reign in the "threatening" espers.

Kumokawa Seria is a third-year student at A Certain High School known for her high intelligence and attractive appearance, referred to as a "beauty sempai" by her underclassmen.

Seria has shoulder-length black hair with her fringe tied back, and a fine figure with a noticeably ample bosom. Her school uniform has a longer skirt than the standard for "defensive" reasons and her navel is visible between the blouse and skirt. She gives off an aura of sophistication.

Known for her genius-level intellect, Seria works as an advisor to Kaizumi Tsugutoshi, one of the twelve Board of Directors of Academy City. She is often described as his "brain" and is deeply involved in the behind-the-scenes politics and conspiracies of the city's Dark Side. While ruthless in achieving her goals, Seria is ultimately a good person who tries to prevent tragedies. 

Seria has a very analytical and manipulative personality, but also a mischievous side, especially when it comes to pranking Kamijou Touma, whom she seems to have feelings for. She also has an ongoing rivalry with Shokuhou Misaki, Mental Out. Despite having no esper powers herself, Seria's keen mind is considered a formidable weapon.

Shirai Kuroko is a Level 4 Teleporter and a student of Tokiwadai Middle School, as well as Misaka Mikoto's best friend and roommate. Not only is she able to teleport objects inside designated targets, allowing her to "throw" the darts she carries on her thighs with perfect accuracy, but she can also change their resulting orientation.

Kuroko has tawny hair tied into two curly pigtails, each tied by a red bow. With a height of 152 cm, she has the appearance of an average middle school girl. As a member of Judgment, she wears their armband along with her Tokiwadai uniform. On her thighs, she secures a pair of black straps where she stores the metal spikes used to secure criminals.

Kuroko has a modernistic outlook, ignorant of customs that Academy City has surpassed. She is usually laid-back and friendly, but determined and confident when facing enemies. She keeps her word, is kind to children, and has a strong sense of justice. Most notably, Kuroko has an obsessive romantic love for Mikoto, taking any chance to get intimate with her 'Onee-sama' (big sister) only to get electrocuted in return. Still, her feelings seem genuine as she will go to great lengths to help Mikoto.

School District 15 is Academy City's major shopping district. It contains many shopping malls, as well as facilities related to mass communication like television studios. The district has the highest land prices in the city. 

District 15 is the center of cutting-edge fashion in Academy City, attracting many visitors who come for fun rather than actually living there. It has a variety of leisure and entertainment facilities like karaoke, arcades, pools, bowling alleys and parks. The district also has its own schools which are the origin of gangs like the Disciplinary Guides.

The district has a website called Entertainment Cursor that advertises it. Its subway station is incorporated into the Dianoid, the district's primary landmark skyscraper.

The Ecomichi Company is a manufacturer that produces materials meant to assist in the development of esper abilities, including electrical stimulus devices. 

Their products were once the subject of a false rumor about causing an esper called Ishigaki Miho to lose control, leading to her expulsion. An official investigation by Judgment and Anti-Skill found no evidence of the incident or the esper's existence.

Despite the rumor being false, it was used by Aizono Mio to manipulate the Disciplinary Guides gang in School District 15. The official report debunking it was later presented to the gang by Uiharu Kazari after their apprehension.

The Celestaquarium is a giant aquarium located in School District 15. From the outside, it appears as a tall building covered in glass. 

Rather than being focused on observing aquatic life, the Celestaquarium is designed more to set a romantic mood for young couples. The top floor features a giant donut-shaped water tank with a glass ceiling that has seawater flowing above it, likely meant to light up spectacularly in the moonlight.

The facility has a staff-only elevator that leads to the top. It was once the home of Shundou Toshizou until his death at the hands of Kihara Noukan, which caused considerable damage to the aquarium during their confrontation.

The Dianoid is a 70-story hexagonal prism-shaped commercial building complex in School District 15, described as a place for the rich and famous. It is the district's primary landmark.

While appearing to be made of diamond, the Dianoid is actually constructed from various carbon materials like carbon frames, nanotubes and artificial diamonds. This makes it extremely durable, able to withstand impacts and handgun bullets without breaking. However, it is still vulnerable to fire and high-voltage electricity.

The Dianoid has shopping floors, entertainment and recreation facilities, the offices of TV station TV Orbit, high-class hotels and apartments used by celebrities for secure storage. It also serves as the district's subway station.

The building was once sealed off by the carbon-controlling magicians of St. Germain, trapping many people including Touma, Index and Hamazura inside until their defeat.

Maruichi is a fast food restaurant chain operating in Academy City, including School District 15. They are known to offer fried chicken promotions around the Christmas season. 

One of their Christmas advertisements was seen on TV by the hungry residents of the Kamijou household on the night of December 3rd, causing Index to burst into tears.

Zero-Day Link is an AI system consisting of four servers in Academy City that automatically gathers, analyzes and prioritizes information on the over 8000 new online risks like viruses and vulnerabilities discovered daily. 

The system tags threats according to risk level, with the highest priorities sent to the Virus Isolation Center for humans to develop countermeasures while the AI handles the rest. This automated approach is necessary due to the sheer volume exceeding what humans can handle.

However, the AI's standards for tagging are not perfect, allowing some threats to slip through the cracks. The system is also vulnerable to direct tampering at the physical servers. One of the four servers making up the system is located in School District 15.

Neoka Norito is a man in his 30s with the appearance of a high-profile entrepreneur or actor, wearing a fancy suit with some muscle tone visible. He has a polite facade hiding a rude and arrogant personality.

Neoka was formerly an elite in Academy City's rescue squads before becoming a member of the Board of Directors. He is manipulative and invested in the city's Dark Side, viewing it as a necessary refuge. 

When Accelerator became Board Chairman and threatened his position with Operation Handcuffs, Neoka tried to use Last Order as a hostage and frame Anti-Skill for injuring him. He used magic based on Kabbalah acquired from R&C Occultics to fight Touma, Index and Mikoto before being defeated.

Despite his villainous acts, Neoka's past as a rescuer showed he did care about saving those who fell through the cracks, even if it meant supporting the Dark Side. His combat experience and magic posed a threat.

Depart, real name unknown, was a black market dealer who looked like a carefree university student. He specialized in selling tools to help clients evade pursuers.

Depart had a lavish penthouse hideout in a District 15 high-rise which doubled as his office. He used a welcoming persona with clients but preferred getting down to business. However, he also had a 'hobby' of violently abusing people he 'purchased' as commodities.

When Accelerator visited posing as a client, Depart mistook a bag of money as being for a captive girl he was abusing. Accelerator then used the money to 'buy' Depart instead before brutally killing him, considering it a boring job.

Despite his professional demeanor, Depart was a cruel man who treated people as disposable goods for his amusement. His violent end at Accelerator's hands was sudden.

Fifteen Bells is a huge building complex in School District 15, the largest in the district. It has a luxury shopping mall on the lower levels with fashionable brands so high-class that even their empty boxes are valuable. The middle floors are occupied by offices, while the top floors contain high-end apartments.

The building has several movie theaters and an underground parking garage. Apartment residents can access the mall outside of normal hours. Palm scanners in the elevators restrict access to the top level apartments.

One year before the main story, the dark side group Item had their secret hideout in a penthouse on the top floor, while a group called Enemy Item spied on them from an apartment on the floor below until they self-destructed to target Item. Following this, Item relocated to a secret base in District 3 instead.

The 5th Emergency Treatment Center is a fairly large hospital located in School District 15. It is situated close to the Nature Park area.

During the Poltergeist incidents, the hospital received many of the victims due to its proximity to where the incidents occurred in Nature Park. Judgement member Uiharu Kazari was treated here for minor injuries.

While capable of handling disasters, more severe cases like Haruue Erii were instead sent to the MAR research facility. Shirai Kuroko confronted Uiharu here about suspecting Haruue's involvement in the incidents, leading to an argument between the two friends.

Shundou Toshizou was a middle-aged man with light, wavy hair, thick eyebrows and a vantablack shirt under a white lab coat. He directed the Ideal laboratory that conducted unethical experiments on child espers.

Toshizou had a callous disregard for life, willing to sacrifice others to achieve his goals. He armed Deadlock with the Queen Diver to target Misaki and steal her Mental Out. After an explosion destroyed his body, Toshizou transferred his mind into a killer whale to continue his schemes.

Using Mitsuari Ayu as a pawn, Toshizou made another attempt to take Mental Out for the FIVE_Over project. However, he was tracked down at the Celestaquarium and killed by Kihara Noukan, who mocked his failed efforts. 

Despite gathering deadly weapons to fight back, Toshizou was helpless against Noukan's Anti-Art Attachment and his unique power to control the space around him. In the end, Toshizou's inhumane ambitions led to his strange fate and demise.

An Involuntary Movement, better known as AIM, is an invisible energy field unconsciously emitted by espers. Similar to how living beings radiate body heat, an esper's AIM diffusion field emanates from their body and produces microscopic effects on their surroundings based on their ability.

AIM can only be detected by machines or specialized espers. It is deeply connected to an esper's Personal Reality, the source of their power. Interference with AIM diffusion fields can disrupt esper abilities. 

When espers with the same AIM type are close together, an AIM diffusion field resonance effect can occur, augmenting the field's effects. Large aggregations of AIM fields in places like Academy City can create separate realms like the Imaginary Number District. Such realms can also give rise to AIM thought beings.

RSPK Syndrome, commonly known as Poltergeist, is a condition where an esper's emotional stress or trauma causes them to lose perception of reality and unconsciously use their power in destructive ways.

It can be caused by espers being unable to properly perceive reality through the Power Curriculum Program's methods or by interference in their AIM diffusion fields. When multiple overloaded espers with the same AIM fields gather, resonance can trigger a Poltergeist outbreak.

Poltergeist incidents involve abnormal phenomena like objects moving on their own. On a large scale, the power of multiple out-of-control espers can converge to cause major destruction in the form of seeming earthquakes.

Personal Reality is a term referring to the unique reality created by espers who undergo Academy City's Power Curriculum Program. It replaces normal reality for them.

Related to quantum theory, a Personal Reality allows an esper to ignore the Uncertainty Principle and choose a possibility to actualize as their power. The stronger their belief, the stronger their ability. 

The Power Curriculum Program helps develop Personal Realities through methods like drugs and hypnosis to separate students from proper reality. A sufficiently traumatic experience can make an esper lose control, leading to RSPK Syndrome.

An esper's calculating ability, which grows along with their Personal Reality, determines the strength of their power. Because their brains are rewired, espers can suffer severe harm if they try to use magic.

Mana is the energy used to cast magic spells. All living things contain mana, but magicians learn to harness it for practical use.

Mana is produced by converting a creature's life force into magical energy, in a process likened to refining oil. Different magical traditions require specific types of mana. Some magicians can tap into mana generated by the earth itself.

Mana can be ritually imbued into objects to create magical items with special properties. However, mana is incompatible with the AIM fields of espers, which is why espers suffer injury if they attempt magic. 

Through their training, magicians develop stronger mana than ordinary people, allowing them to sense other magicians nearby. Immortal beings are theorized to have infinite mana and thus vast magical potential, making them highly sought after in the magic world.

Idol Theory, also known as Idolatry Theory or Idol Worship, is the magical concept that imitations or duplicates of a whole or parts of an original subject will gain some of the properties, attributes and powers inherent to that original.

This theory explains how most magicians draw their power from an original source. For example, a cross duplicating the one Jesus was crucified on would retain some of that holy power. Even a small percentage of the vast power of the original is potent.

However, the link goes both ways - changes to the idol can affect the original too. This has been exploited to persecute Christians by forcing them to step on holy images. Magicians must be wary, as someone knowledgeable of the source's history could discern weaknesses in their magic.

Idol Theory contrasts with the science side's Personal Reality. It requires belief in an external idol while espers distort reality through their own will. Magicians can wield multiple copied powers but espers only have one personal ability.

School District 10 is the southernmost district of Academy City, characterized by its poor public order, lax security, and concentration of facilities with negative social stigma like nuclear labs, animal testing labs, and graveyards. It has the city's cheapest land prices.

The district has pockets of severe urban decay, especially in the Strange area which is a hotbed for delinquent gangs like Big Spider. However, delinquents there follow an ironclad rule to be kind to abandoned cats and children.

District 10 houses the city's only known graveyard, built in a car park style with automated storage of miniature tombstones and cinerary caskets. Many of those memorialized have ties to the Dark Side.

Prison facilities are also found here, like the juvenile Reformatory for espers and the adult-focused Special Criminal Correctional Facility. Secret tunnels allow discreet prisoner transport from the courts.

While the east side is in disarray, the west has been redeveloped and the central area is better maintained. The district can also handle dangerous rocket fuels.

Infection Magic is one of two broad categories of magic, contrasted with Imitative Magic like Idol Theory. It involves using objects connected to the target, such as hair, nails or body parts like an eye to remotely attack them.

The most well-known Infection Magic are curse techniques, in which a piece of the target is destroyed in a special ritual to inflict damage on them from afar. Even those unfamiliar with magic can fall victim to infection spells.

Tsuchimikado Motoharu made use of a modified Infection Magic curse originating from Japan, Ushi no Koku Mairi, after Kumokawa Seria dominated him in their confrontation. He used Seria's plucked eye in the ritual to afflict her with an unpleasant, invisible pressure on her heart.

Saints are powerful magic side individuals who possess bodily characteristics matching those of the Son of God, which based on Idol Theory, allows them to draw on a portion of His power. Saints have less than 20 individuals among their number.

Most Saints boast superhuman strength, speed, senses and the ability to channel far more mana than a normal magician. Some have special blood with healing properties. However, they also share the Son of God's weaknesses to things like crucifixes and crown of thorns.

Many Saints share a tragic fate where their loved ones are harmed by the dark side of human nature, due to their unique traits and power. Consumed by regret and despair, Saints will eventually come to terms with being unable to save those close to them.

The term Saint also applies as a title to various important individuals, martyrs and legendary figures in Christian history, whose stories form the basis of many spells. Their relics and symbols hold special power. Some Saints are patron saints of specific places, groups and causes.

Christianity is the monotheistic religion based on the life and teachings of the Son of God, Jesus of Nazareth. It is the largest religion in the world of Toaru Majutsu no Index and represents a significant portion of the Magic Side.

Christians believe in a single supreme deity, God, who is the creator of the universe. The doctrine of the Trinity holds that God is one being in three aspects - the Father, Son and Holy Spirit. 

According to Christian teachings, Jesus was the Son of God, the promised Messiah who performed miracles, was executed by crucifixion, then resurrected. His apostles' accounts are recorded in the New Testament of the Bible.

Many schisms have occurred in Christianity over theological and political disputes, leading to the formation of different denominations and sects. The three largest Christian Churches in-universe are the Roman Catholic Church, the Russian Orthodox Church and the Anglican Church.

The symbols, stories and relics of Christianity are the basis for many forms of magic, as well as for the special power of Saints whose bodies match the Son of God. Many believe Christianity will remain the dominant force in the world until the end of its age.

Konori Mii is a young woman with short black hair and blue eyes. She has a mature figure and is considered very attractive, with a noticeably large bust. Her most distinctive accessories are her red-rimmed glasses and the red leather jacket she occasionally wears.

As the 177th Branch Chief, Konori has a very responsible and professional attitude. She acts as a warm yet strict senior to Kuroko and Uiharu. However, she also has a more laid-back, mischievous side. Konori is very fond of both designer bags and Musashino-brand milk.

In the past, Konori was a member of the Skill-Out gang Big Spider and had a deep admiration for their leader Kurozuma Wataru. She struggled after he was seemingly killed then later left the gang to join Judgement. When Kurozuma reappeared, Konori confronted her past and realized her feelings for him were unchanged.

Konori is a Level 3 esper with the ability Clairvoyance, allowing her to see through solid objects. Besides this, she has fairly good fighting capabilities for a Judgement member due to her past. Konori is dedicated to overcoming obstacles, helping others and upholding the peace of Academy City.

The Food Stand Spire is a multi-level parking garage in District 10 that is packed with 400-500 restaurants operating out of vans and RVs. The building has a chaotic, rundown atmosphere fitting the lawless nature of the district.

The garage is poorly lit with irregularly placed lights and filled with a jumble of vents and ducts to let out the cooking exhaust. There is no uniformity to the messy, dirty lineup of food stalls inside. Customers sit at rickety tables scattered between the vehicles.

The most popular stalls serving junk food are on the lower levels while the higher floors have more niche offerings but fewer customers. The elevator is out of service since fights kept breaking out over it.

During the Ichihanaran Festival, when Last Order and Fremea Seivelun got lost in District 10, they stumbled across the Food Stand Spire. They ended up at a Chinese food truck on the top floor, which exclusively sold comically oversized meat dishes.

The Reformatory is Academy City's juvenile detention center, located in District 10 and designed to handle esper criminals. It has 15 meter tall walls covered in wires generating anti-esper AIM Jammer fields, with the fields getting stronger deeper inside.

The guards are equipped with powered suits with anti-esper gear, however a well-armed group could still penetrate the facility's defenses, as Academy City weaponry was used by the mercenaries hired by BLOCK.

The internal layout is secret but there are hidden passages and rooms without surveillance. Most cells are anechoic chambers which absorb sound. Officially the Reformatory is for rehabilitation but there are rumors of students vanishing from inside, likely due to shady deals.

The facility has an unsettling atmosphere at night, with its thick walls and anti-esper measures. Kouzaku Mitori and Musujime Awaki's friends have been imprisoned there. Rumor has it being a guard is one of the three worst jobs in the city.

keys: Special Esper Dual Modification Technology Research Institute
entries.content:
The Special Ability Institute, formally the Special Esper Dual Modification Technology Research Institute, was a research facility in District 10 dedicated to studying Dual Skill, the theoretical ability for an esper to have two powers at once.

The institute was rumored to perform inhuman experiments on its test subjects, including using Child Errors as expendable guinea pigs. There were likely many casualties from the unethical research.

Accelerator was kept at the Special Ability Institute until age 9 due to his unique abilities. The facility was later dismantled after an Anti-Skill investigation by Yomikawa Aiho. All that remains is the unsettling legacy and dark rumors of its experiments.

The institute likely had a cold, sinister atmosphere, with mysterious equipment designed to push espers beyond their limits in pursuit of Dual Skill, heedless of the human cost. Its disregard for the lives of its subjects, especially Child Errors, showcased the depths of Academy City's Dark Side.

The Special Criminal Adult Correctional Facility is a prison in District 10 for containing adult criminals, in contrast with the Reformatory which handles juveniles. Prisoners are strictly restrained during transport.

The facility has an unofficial hidden area for secretly jailing individuals when other prisons are insufficient. An armored cell was constructed beneath the prison specifically to hold Accelerator. It resembles a school classroom in size without windows.

Despite Accelerator's wishes, as he was still Board Chairman at the time of imprisonment, his cell was filled with various luxuries like a king-size bed, ornate furniture, a full kitchen, and entertainment systems. However, it was built to withstand his esper power.

Following his trial for the Sisters incident, Accelerator was imprisoned there in the special cell. He reluctantly resumed his Board Chairman duties from inside. The facility has a hidden subway station connected to Academy City's underground transit network.

Zassou Academy is a school in Academy City's District 10, established by the game company Weed to train students to become video game developers and eventually join the company. The school allows students to learn professional subjects related to game development.

Misawa Cram School is a cram school in District 17 that was originally a front for a conspiracy to infiltrate Academy City and discover the secrets of esper development. When that failed, they devolved into a Cult of Science and imprisoned Himegami Aisa to use her ability.

Alchemist Aureolus Izzard later took over the school, killed the cult members, and used it as his base while trying to save Index. He magically sealed the building, revived students he killed as slaves, and fought Stiyl Magnus and Kamijou Touma there before his defeat. The school was destroyed in the process and shut down.

Located in District 1, the Academy City General Courthouse is equipped for extremely fast trials that can occur the day after arrests. It has strict security, using infrared beams to destabilize suspicious visitors.

The court uses a mix of professional and lay judges, with the latter being mandatory even for minors. A computer loaded with precedent assists the lay judges. Witnesses are kept in strict isolation and may have to wear concealing outfits.

School District 1 is located near the center of Academy City and houses most of the city's administrative and judicial facilities, including the offices of the Board of Directors. It has very few residences or restaurants, focusing entirely on the infrastructure needed to run the city.

The district's mechanical cityscape reflects its role. There are hidden railway lines and stations underneath for secretly transporting prisoners to facilities in District 10 when needed.

Hebitani Tsuguo is a black haired man with a scarred face and small mustache who wears a leather jacket. He has a small spider tattoo on his back meant to imitate the larger one of Kurozuma Wataru.

Tsuguo was a member of Big Spider under Wataru but strayed from his ideals after his presumed death. He is vicious, deceptive and willing to betray his comrades. Tsuguo took over Big Spider claiming to be Wataru.

Under Tsuguo's leadership, Big Spider became a violent esper-hunting gang armed with smuggled weapons like guns and explosives. He acquired the Capacity Down esper-jamming device to aid in their attacks.

During a confrontation with the real Wataru, Tsuguo revealed he felt he had no choice but to impersonate him to keep Big Spider together as a home for Level 0s. After a battle, Tsuguo was beaten and detained, leading to Big Spider's dissolution.

While somewhat capable in a fight, Tsuguo was far inferior to Wataru. His duplicity was his greatest weapon until it inevitably fell apart.

Big Spider was a Skill-Out gang in Academy City's Strange district, founded by Kurozuma Wataru as a place for Level 0s to belong. It later became a violent group under Hebitani Tsuguo before being dissolved.

In Wataru's time, the gang followed his example and knew when to show restraint. Members wore black leather jackets and rode motorcycles. They once saved a child from another group. Konori Mii joined during this era.

After Wataru's presumed death in a trap, Tsuguo took over pretending to be him. Under his leadership, Big Spider members stopped wearing uniforms and started using smuggled weapons like guns and explosives in esper hunts. They gained the Capacity Down esper jammer.

Facing the returned Wataru along with powerful espers and Judgment, and with their base assaulted by Anti-Skill, Tsuguo and his Big Spider were defeated. The gang dissolved with Tsuguo's arrest, despite his claims of trying to maintain a home for Level 0s.

Tamezou is a man with straight brown shoulder-length hair and distinct sanpaku eyes that make him look intimidating. He was part of the Skill-Out gang Big Spider under both leaders.

In the early benevolent days of Big Spider under Kurozuma Wataru, Tamezou followed his ideals and helped protect others, like when they saved a little boy from another gang. Konori Mii saw this good side of them.

However, after Wataru's apparent death, Tamezou went along with the gang's corruption under Hebitani Tsuguo's leadership as he impersonated Wataru. They began violently attacking espers using tools like the Capacity Down.

When the real Wataru returned and defeated them with the aid of powerful espers, Tamezou was beaten and arrested. Mii, now in Judgment, saw him being carried away. While unskilled, Tamezou is likely a decent street fighter to have survived so long in Skill-Out.

Drencher Kihara Repatri is a member of the infamous Kihara family known for unethical research. He has dark hair and eyes, wearing a tan jacket over a black shirt and cargo shorts.

Like others in his family, Drencher has a twisted personality, using cruel methods for his studies into ghost phenomena. He traveled the world investigating so-called haunted locations to uncover and replicate their tricks.

His expertise lay in artificially reproducing ghost-like traits, leading to the creation of his ultimate work - the artificial ghost Frillsand #G through a process called High Voltage Cutting. Frillsand could induce ghostly effects like remote damage and camera interference.

Drencher infiltrated Academy City, motivated by his Kihara drive to push unethical research to its limits. He was cunning but sometimes let his love of the 'art' in his work blind him. In the end, despite Frillsand's power, Drencher's plans were foiled and he met his end in the city he sought to exploit.

Frillsand #G is an artificial ghost with the appearance of a shapely 20-year-old woman. She has long blonde hair in twintails and wears a skintight light blue dress with a translucent overskirt, resembling a western doll. 

Created by Drencher Kihara Repatri through the High Voltage Cutting process, Frillsand is an existence of unstable electrical energy. As a ghost, she's incorporeal, passing through objects while unable to touch them.

Frillsand can remotely and continuously harm living things that perceive her, like tales of people being hurt by ghost encounters. She can also disrupt cameras and sensors to prevent them from properly detecting her.

Despite her nature, Frillsand displays a caring personality, fiercely protecting the children Drencher watches over as well as displaying devotion to her creator. She's willing to resort to lethal force to ensure their safety.

Frillsand is immensely powerful as a ghost but has weaknesses related to her electrical nature. Her full capabilities and ultimate fate after the events surrounding her creation are uncertain.

School District 19 is located in the northeastern part of Academy City. Once a thriving area, the district has fallen on hard times in recent years and is suffering from urban decay. The specific reasons for its decline are unknown.

Despite its state, District 19 still has residents and a functioning school system, as Haruue Erii lived and went to school there before transferring. The district's rundown state makes it a cheaper place to live in the advanced city.

One of District 19's current roles is re-examining old technology that has fallen out of use, like vacuum tubes and steam engines. Rumors suggest the district may have been intentionally abandoned to use as a testbed for outdated tech.

The area has many shops operating out of converted metal shipping containers. During the Freshmen incident, one of Hamazura Shiage's battles with the group took place in an abandoned District 19 supermarket.

Haruue Erii is a Level 2 telepathic esper and former Child Error. She has short dark hair with a few strands tied together on the left, and is petite like Uiharu Kazari.

Erii has a shy, soft-spoken personality and can be a bit eccentric, spacing out or walking into things. She's fond of eating and often gets food on her face. Erii ends many sentences with 'nano.'

As children, she and Edasaki Banri communicated telepathically in their Child Error facility before Banri was transferred. When Banri fell into a coma, Erii heard her thoughts and came to Sakugawa Middle School.

Erii helped investigate the Level Upper and Poltergeist incidents, reuniting with Banri. She was briefly held captive by the granddaughter of Kihara Gensei who wanted to use her. After being rescued, Erii and a revived Banri later moved away, sharing an emotional goodbye with friends like Uiharu.

Kuruwa is a kunoichi from the Iga ninja clan known for her distinct fashion sense - a revealing yellow mini-yukata, transparent obi, and decorative chains. She has black and brown hair adorned with colorful ornate pins. 

Despite her kunoichi training, Kuruwa has a ditzy, chatty personality and can get flustered easily, especially when her ninja authenticity is questioned. However, she's highly determined to restore her clan's prestige.

Kuruwa initially tries to hunt down her fellow ninja descendant Hattori Hanzou, going to extreme lengths like seducing him to combine their lineages. She uses tricks like hidden weapons and disguises in her pursuits.

After being defeated by Hanzou, Kuruwa ends up assisting him in various incidents. She acts as backup on missions and a close confidant, though they still bicker often. Kuruwa's gullible nature sometimes gets her in trouble.

While unconventional and clumsy, Kuruwa has her own brand of ninja skills and is a loyal ally to Hanzou in the various strange circumstances they find themselves in. Her ridiculous antics and chuuni attitude hide a caring heart.

The Dark Side of Academy City, also known as the Darkness, refers to the city's seedy criminal underbelly that operates in contrast to the advanced academic facade it shows the world. This underworld has roots leading all the way up to the city's highest governing bodies.

The Darkness evolved out of a need for the Board of Directors and other higher-ups to have additional security beyond what Anti-Skill could provide, in order to protect the city's research and other assets from interference by rogue espers and outside forces. It is composed of a variety of factions, often working at odds with each other.

Many Dark Side factions engage in unethical human experimentation, espionage, assassinations and other crimes, exploiting espers for their abilities. They are highly organized and well-funded, with support from within the city's power structure. However, some like Komaba Ritoku's Skill-Out oppose the establishment.

Most Dark Side factions have field operatives supported by a larger staff and led by a mysterious mediator who liaises with the higher-ups. After the events of World War III, many groups were disbanded but the Dark Side still endures in a reduced form.

World War III was an 11-day global conflict between Academy City and its allies against Russia, the Catholic Church and their allies, taking place in late October. It was the first open war between the Magic and Science Sides.

The war had complex roots in rising tensions and skirmishes between Academy City and the Roman Catholic Church, the goals of the secret magic cabal God's Right Seat, and international tensions surrounding the UK and the Elizalina Alliance. However, the entire war was ultimately manipulated and engineered by a single man, Fiamma of the Right, to forward his own plans to become 'The One Above God'.

Despite Academy City's overwhelming technological superiority giving it the clear advantage on the battlefield, the short war would be decided by the magic-based superweapon Star of Bethlehem and the efforts of individuals like Kamijou Touma to stop it.

While brief, World War III dramatically reshaped the political and social order of the world, weakening the great magic Churches, forcing the Magic Side to recognize Academy City's power, and accelerating the world's tilt towards the Science Side. It would lead to the rise of the magic terrorist group Gremlin and derail Aleister Crowley's plans for Academy City.

The Roman Catholic Church is the largest Christian denomination in the world, with over 2 billion followers. Led by the Pope from Vatican City, it is one of the three main branches of Christianity alongside the Anglican and Russian Orthodox Churches.

The Catholic Church has immense influence, wealth and history. Its central tenets include apostolic succession from St. Peter, the divinity of Christ, and the infallibility of the Pope. Catholic doctrine and practice is based on Scripture, tradition and the Magisterium teaching authority.

In the world of Toaru Majutsu no Index, the Roman Catholic Church is a major power on the Magic Side, often acting in opposition to Academy City and the Science Side. It has access to powerful spells like the Croce di Pietro and La Regina del Mare Adriatico, as well as elite agents like God's Right Seat. 

The Church's magic focuses on Christian motifs and relics. Its cathedrals and holy sites act as symbolic weapons. However, the Catholic Church has often been manipulated by extremist factions seeking power. It has complex political relationships with the other Churches.

God's Right Seat was an elite unit of the Roman Catholic Church, operating in secret as its 'dark side.' Composed of four extremely powerful magicians aligned with the Archangels, their original role was to advise the Pope on spiritual matters beyond normal human knowledge. 

However, over time God's Right Seat gained immense influence, to the point of being able to overrule the Pope's decisions. The members had their own extreme beliefs and philosophies. Eliminating their original sin through magic, their ultimate goal was to ascend to La Persona Superiore a Dio - The One Above God.

Each member had a unique magical ability based on their elemental alignment - Vento of the Front (wind), Terra of the Left (earth), Acqua of the Back (water) and Fiamma of the Right (fire). However, Fiamma manipulated the others in a bid to start World War III to achieve his own designs.

After a clash with Academy City, the true magic-science war many had feared, God's Right Seat fell apart, with most members defeated by Kamijou Touma and the heroes of the Science Side. The group disbanded, its legacy one of destruction and conspiracy.

Vento of the Front is the only female member of the secretive God's Right Seat of the Roman Catholic Church. She dons a yellow robe adorned with a thorn design, with a matching headpiece. Her most striking features are her heavily pierced and made-up face, and a cross attached to a chain that rests on her tongue.

She has a spiteful, assertive and sarcastic personality that matches her imposing appearance. This abrasive attitude is deliberate, meant to provoke animosity in others to fuel her Divine Punishment spell. Vento loathes science due to an accident in her past that killed her brother, blaming it as a scapegoat for her guilt.

As a God's Right Seat member, Vento is aligned with Uriel, the Archangel of Earth, and the color yellow. However, she can also use wind magic to an extent. Her primary ability is Divine Punishment, which strips the consciousness of anyone who bears ill will towards her based on idol theory involving her piercings representing the Son of God's crucifixion. She can also summon powerful air hammers to bludgeon foes.

Terra of the Left is a diminutive old man who wears green robes, representing his alignment with Raphael the Archangel of Earth. He has an impish, shark-toothed grin and spiky hair that matches his abhorrent personality.

A callous man, Terra sees all non-Catholics as inhuman and has no qualms about killing innocents to calibrate his Execution of Light spell, which relies on how the Son of God was killed. He researched that contradiction extensively. Terra arrogantly sees himself as more important than the Pope.

Using his spell, Terra can manipulate the hierarchy and precedence of anything, allowing his blade made of flour to cut through objects it normally couldn't. However, he can only affect one target at a time by verbally stating the change. He was one of the few who came close to understanding Touma's Imagine Breaker.

Terra oversaw the Document of Constantine to incite anti-Academy City protests before battling Touma in Avignon. He was later killed by Acqua of the Back for his wanton cruelty.

William Orwell, better known as Acqua of the Back, is a mercenary and former Saint aligned with the Archangel Gabriel and the element of water. He is a muscular man with tea-colored hair, bearing scars from many battles, who wears blue clothes representing his elemental alignment.

Acqua follows a unique code of honor, confident in his actions without excuse. While ruthless to enemies, he dislikes civilian casualties, looting, and cheap tricks, preferring to face foes directly. He respects courage and friendship. As a former Saint, he had immense power and the Divine Mother's Mercy, letting him use his abilities beyond their limits.

Wielding the giant sword Ascalon, Acqua is a master of water spells, using his mace to crush foes with shockwaves or shape water into weapons. His ultimate spell uses moonlight to massively enhance his power.

After losing to Touma, Acqua turned against his former allies. He protected Britain during the coup and absorbed Archangel Gabriel's Telesma in World War III. Though imprisoned after, he remains an ally to Touma.

Fiamma of the Right is the flame-haired leader of God's Right Seat, a powerful and arrogant magician obsessed with saving the world. Calculating and sarcastic, he looks down on others, only seeing the malice in their hearts. His goal is to achieve La Persona Superiore a Dio - The One Above God.

Aligned with the Archangel Michael, Fiamma wields the Holy Right, the embodiment of the Right Hand's power in Christianity. It manifests as a massive 'third arm' from his shoulder that can destroy anything with the precise force needed, negate supernatural powers, and use the Bible's many powers.

Fiamma is the main antagonist of the original Index series. He stole Index's controller, summoned Archangel Gabriel, incited global war, and created the flying fortress Star of Bethlehem for his plans. Though he achieved 'The One Above God' briefly by seizing Touma's right arm, he was defeated by the combined efforts of the heroes.

After a crushing loss to Aleister Crowley, a humbled Fiamma dedicated himself to protecting the world Touma himself protected, joining Ollerus against later threats.

Summoning involves calling forth supernatural entities like angels, demons or spirits from other planes, or supernatural energies like Telesma or magical elements, to a specific location for a specific purpose, such as to carry out commands, fuel spells, or infuse power into objects.

Summoners must precisely calculate the necessary values and set up their ceremony with the right magic circle, incantation, and other steps for their specific target. Magic circles for summoning are intricate due to the many factors involved. A separate protective circle is often used to keep the summoner safe from the summoned force.

After a summoning, a corresponding exorcism ritual, often requiring the original site, is needed to properly banish the entity. Forcibly stopping the summoning is not the same as an exorcism. The magic sword can be used to guide summoning ceremonies.

The Book of the Law, also known as Liber AL vel Legis, is the central sacred text of Thelema, written down by Aleister Crowley in 1904. Its contents originated from the entity known as Aiwass.

Written in a special code considered a completely different language, the Book of the Law has over a hundred fake ways to decipher it, with the text itself misleading would-be decoders. Even a glimpse of its contents is dangerous. The book is highly sought after for the powerful spells within.

Aleister used the book for divination and deciding his actions. It contains the phrase "Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law". Another notable line is "every man and every woman is a star", which has several metaphysical and philosophical interpretations.

If ever successfully decoded and opened, the Book of the Law could spell the end of the age of Christianity. As an indestructible original grimoire, it can only be sealed away.

Thelema is the religion and philosophical system which was developed by Aleister Crowley in the early 20th century. It is based around the central tenet "Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law".

A core concept is that of the Aeons - divisions of human history each with characteristic beliefs, with three primary ones being the Aeon of Isis, Osiris and the current Aeon of Horus. The Thoth Tarot is based around this concept.

Another key principle is the True Will - the idea that a fully actualized person will act according to their true inner drive, creating their own moral system. This forms part of Aleister's plans and the set-up of Academy City.

Thelema features various deity-like entities drawn from different mythologies, most notably the being Aiwass who dictated the Book of the Law to Aleister. The number 93 holds special significance.

Aleister devised Thelema to find the proper rules he believed the Christian God lacked. It has faced opposition from Christian churches threatened by his attempts to create a new unifying mythology between the phases.

A grimoire, also known as an original, is a book containing powerful and often dangerous magical knowledge and spells. Reading one can drive a normal person insane, the contents being too "poisonous" for the human mind to handle.

Grimoires are practically indestructible by normal means and can only be sealed away. They act as a kind of magic circle, using the life force energy around them to power their spells without needing an active magician.

Grimoires have a degree of sentience and can seemingly identify people as "readers" or "non-readers", seeking to spread their knowledge. They will even turn on and kill an owner judged to be unsuitable.

Index Librorum Prohibitorum is the only person currently known to be able to safely read grimoires, holding 103,000 of them. Due to their political importance, magic cabals will hunt her for that knowledge that can be used against them.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to electronic systems and machinery devised to have some level of intelligence and capability for autonomous operation, in contrast with the natural intelligence of humans and other life-forms. It is used both to refer to the field and specific entities. 

AI can have varying levels of development and capability, from relatively simple systems to theoretical human-level intelligence, though few reach the latter. They are utilized for many functions like operating devices, analyzing data, and supporting human operators.

In Academy City, AI is heavily used for automation in all areas of life and the military. This includes household appliances, robots, vehicles, and weapons like Powered Suits. Some like Seri can be distributed software, while others like Reading Thoth 78 are hardware built into a system.

There are various rumors and urban legends in Academy City related to AI secretly controlling things behind the scenes, as well as anti-AI groups. Research into esper powers like Meltdowner are anticipated to advance the development of highly flexible AI.

The Aztec Calendar Stone is a gigantic round stone inscribed with the highly complex calendar system used by the Aztecs, as well as information about the death and rebirth of the sun, all arranged in a circular pattern.

Members of the Return of the Winged One magic cabal have used the calendar stone to produce original grimoires, each derived from a specific portion of it. Two have been seen so far:

1) Time related to Life and Death, a scroll made from animal skin which was merged with the ground flesh of Xochitl. It has a defensive spell causing enemies to kill themselves with their own weapons. Wielded by Etzali, it launches counter-attacks and can create artificial body parts.

2) The Moon Rabbit, several thin stone tablets with Aztec writing, based on a legend of a rabbit being thrown at the moon. It fires powerful 'rabbit bone' projectiles capable of smashing through walls. Wielded by Tecpatl before being taken by Etzali.

The grimoires' creator devised a way to prevent the knowledge within from poisoning the mind of the wielder.

Hermeticism is a set of philosophical and magical beliefs and practices based primarily on writings attributed to Hermes Trismegistus ("Thrice-Great"), included along with the likes of Enoch, the Kabbalah, and astrology.

Derived from sources like Egyptian mythology and Greek philosophy, Hermeticism aims to influence the heavens through contact with divine forces. As a unified theory attempting to explain many belief systems, it has the effect of bringing the phases involved closer together and increasing collisions between them.

Hermeticism states that the world is composed of 22 letters which can be instinctually rearranged to create magical environments. The collection of texts known as the Hermetica, which discuss topics like the divine, the mind, nature and the cosmos, are a key part of the Hermetic canon.

Hermetic traditions were incorporated into the Golden Dawn magical cabal and the Golden-style magic it produced, which went on to be a major influence on 20th century Western magic.

Witches are magic users, usually female, who have existed since ancient times. Often described as priestesses of the night who dwell in nature, they are commonly associated with traits like brewing potions, flying on broomsticks, and having familiars like black cats. A pointed hat is a distinct item of clothing linked to them.

After Christianity's rise, witches were persecuted by the church, who spread misinformation to slander and justify their actions. During the early modern period in particular, many fell victim to the witch hunts carried out by the church and common folk alike.

Much of witchcraft involves natural ingredients, with witches having considerable knowledge of plants and herbs which can be used for various effects like healing, divination, and flight. In the 20th century, the Wicca system of witchcraft was established, said to be based on ancient witch practices. It centers around the goddess Aradia and has its own rules and traditions.

In the present day, many witches work with the Anglican Church. They played a notable role in the British Halloween, manning the Coven Compass fortress.

The Book of the Dead is an ancient Egyptian funerary text, containing spells to assist a person's journey through the underworld to the afterlife, used from the beginning of the New Kingdom (around 1550 BC) to around 50 BC.

In the world of Toaru Majutsu no Index, it has different versions, as a specific copy is written for a specific person when they die. Being made for people like the pharaohs, its primary purpose was to be buried in the pyramids with the mummies in order to one day return the pharaoh's soul to the world. 

The grimoire contains not only text but illustrations and diagrams as well. Each individual copy must be custom made in accordance with the specific pharaoh's deeds and sins, requiring a new grimoire to be made each time a new person dies.

Index Librorum Prohibitorum holds at least one copy in her memory, though it is unknown for whom that copy was originally made. She later acquired another copy, that of the Priestess of Sekhmet, after it was reconstructed in her mind through magical manipulation.

The Fragment of the Rune Epitaph is a small gray stone about 2 cm across discovered in Alaska, with a previously unknown type of runes inscribed on a portion of its surface. Not even a magician experienced with runes like Stiyl Magnus could determine its meaning from the incomplete fragment alone.

The epitaph's runes are an undiscovered branch derived from the standard sets which have varied throughout history, from 16 to 33 in number. The data Index holds is enough to decode them, but without her help, it would take years for others to find even a single clue.

If the Alaskan runes deviate enough from the standard, they could activate previously unusable magic, essentially acting as a new set of spells. The fragment was part of an original grimoire epitaph holding great power.

However, the fragment hasn't restored itself like an original should, as it is still bound by a special seal which can only be undone through checking the movements of Donati's Comet and possessing its horoscope data.

The Golden Dawn was once the largest and most powerful magic cabal in the United Kingdom and the world at the end of the 19th century. Founded by Samuel Liddell MacGregor Mathers, William Wynn Westcott and an unnamed third, it flourished under Mathers and Westcott's leadership after the third founder's retirement. 

The cabal had a complex hierarchical structure with grades based on positions on the Tree of Life. It also had several meeting places like the Isis-Urania Temple in London. Mathers and Westcott had clashing views on the cabal's direction, further aggravated by Aleister Crowley's joining.

Crowley destroyed the cabal from within in 1900 in the Battle of Blythe Road, provoking the two factions into bloody conflict that killed both remaining founders. The cabal splintered into various Golden-style cabals continuing its legacy.

The Golden Dawn specialized in ceremonial group magic rituals modeled after stage plays, incorporating Hermetic and Kabbalistic elements. They also had a variation of Tarot and made heavy use of symbolism.

Rosicrucianism is a movement and system of magic which forms the core of the secretive Rosicrucian Order, the most famous of the pre-Golden Dawn magic cabals. 

Its name is derived from the Rose Cross symbol and its supposed founder, Christian Rosencreutz. The legendary holy man and miracle worker was said to have founded the initial cabal with his disciples, constructing a building called the House of the Holy Spirit. 

Though it began with a false book by Johann Valentin Andreae, magicians developed Rosicrucianism into something real, ignoring Andreae when he revealed the truth. The Rosicrucians exploited the resulting legends and interpretations as 'clouds' to hide the truth while operating in secret.

Rosicrucianism was a major influence on the Golden Dawn, with Westcott forging letters from the supposed Rosicrucian Anna Sprengel to claim the cabal was continuing an ancient line. In reality, a different Anna ended up playing the role.

Tarot refers to a set of 78 cards used in Europe from the mid-15th century for games and divination. A deck is divided into the 22 trump cards of the Major Arcana and the 56 suit cards of the Minor Arcana. Each card has potential meanings, symbolism and interpretations which can change based on the spread and positions.

Tarot's mystical interpretations took hold in the 18th-19th centuries through the likes of Antoine Court de Gébelin and Éliphas Lévi. The Golden Dawn and Aleister Crowley developed their own variations, the GD Tarot and Thoth Tarot.

In the GD Tarot, the Major Arcana tells the story of the Son of God to draw on his power, with paths to enter god's realm. The Minor Arcana activate elemental spells of their respective suits.

In the Thoth Tarot, the Major Arcana instead follows Christianity to its end and a new aeon afterwards, aiming to surpass god's realm. It contains the essence of Aiwass.

Egyptian Mythology is the mythology of the ancient Egyptians, dating from 3000 BCE. It believes in a cycle of events set by the gods in ancient times being repeated, renewing the fundamental order called maat. Without maat and the Pharaoh's authority, the primordial chaos of isfet would dissolve everything.

The Egyptian pantheon consists of numerous deities, or netjeru, who maintain maat and are often depicted with animal heads symbolizing their aspects. The mythology also involves practices like mummification for the afterlife.

Over time, Egyptian mythology has been subject to distortion by European preconceptions and misconceptions, resulting in twisted interpretations persisting today. In the past, its convenient geography made it attractive to European magicians seeking breakthroughs.

Aleister Crowley incorporated Egyptian deities into his Aeons concept and Egyptian elements are heavily featured in Golden-style magic. In the present, Egyptian mythology still forms the basis for some magic.

Greek Mythology is the mythology of the ancient Greeks, a large part of which was adopted into Roman mythology to form Classical Mythology. 

Like other polytheistic mythologies, it features a pantheon of gods, the Olympians, who overthrew an older generation of deities, the Titans. The gods have human-like emotions and flaws which complement each other in a single flexible system.

In the past, the ancient Greeks actively interpreted other cultures like the Egyptians through their own lens, resulting in distorted imagining of those mythologies that have persisted to modern day. Greek culture was later absorbed into Rome resulting in a merging of mythologies.

While pure Greek mythology-based magic is uncommon in the present day of the Toaru universe, it is still a viable magical format and one of many to have caused Phases. It was also an influence on Hermeticism and in turn the Golden Dawn's system.

Enoch refers to the Enochian system of magic and beliefs, based around a supposed angelic language of the same name, derived from the writings of John Dee and Edward Kelley in the 16th century.

The Enochian language has its own unique alphabet and script. Key parts of the magical system include the Elemental Tablets and the Aethyrs, with the former arranged in a square, divided by element and each with associated angels, and the latter being 30 concentric spheres surrounding them.

The system makes use of a set of invocations called the Secret Calls to access the powers and angels of the Tablets and Aethyrs. There is also a four-player chess variant called Enochian Chess tied to the elemental symbolism.

Enochian elements were incorporated into the Golden Dawn's magical system, with Mathers being a practitioner of Enochian Chess. In the present day, the system has been utilized by the demon Coronzon.

Anna Sprengel has the physical appearance of a ten-year old girl, about 30-40% shorter than Madame Horos when she was possessing Anna's body and with a flat chest. She has purple eyes and long reddish-blonde hair which reaches her ankles, rolled into large ringlet curls and squished flat at the ends into several fried shrimp shapes, with rose decorations throughout. Anna is also capable of assuming an adult form like the one that Madame Horos had used, which she refers to as her "proper form".
