Anna is a cruel, proud and self-centered individual, who looks down on most other people and things in the world, and is focused on pursuing her own goals and interests, with no regard for whoever or whatever is harmed in the process. Given her immense power and her ability to predict outcomes with near certainty, Anna is often bored and finds enjoyment in things which defy her predictions. While various things can catch her interest, they usually don't hold it for very long and when she loses interest, she moves on. If something actually disappoints her, she is likely to destroy it before moving on.

She is a callous and toxic manipulator who has no compunction about manipulating and harming others for the sake of her own goals, often setting things up so that her pawns end up destroying themselves. From past experiences, with cabals and magicians not truly understanding the meaning of her words and distorting them to suit themselves, Anna believes that no one could understand her and is angered at people thinking that they can. She also believes that exchanges of words only distort the truth and spread corrupted information. She hates being interrupted in the middle of an explanation, in at least one case going on a rant and taking out her anger on a nearby object.

Anna has been described as clinging to success and victory more than anyone, regardless of what she says, to the point that she cannot maintain herself without them.

When posing as CRC, brought into the world via the Bridge Builders Cabal's ceremony, Andreae had the appearance of a young man, about 18, with silver hair and a beard (though with the voice of an old man). He wore a red robe provided by Trismegistus, with a variant of the Rose Cross on it. He also wore a pentagonal pendant, with an emblem of red and white pentagons inside one another - similar to the one in the Rose Cross variant on his robes, and a red cloak with gold-orange lining.

After being stripped of this guise, he appeared as a wrinkly and unkempt old man, described as nothing but skin and bones.

When posing as Christian Rosencreutz, Andreae acted out a malicious persona completely different from the wise holy man of legend, in an effort to tarnish his creation's legacy.

The most recognizable symbol of Buddhism, the dharmachakra, or Wheel of Dharma, represents the Noble Eightfold Path, Buddha's described way to enlightenment.

At its most basic level, Buddhism teaches that every sentient being has the potential to achieve Nirvana, a state of permanent peace, liberation, and "consciousness without feature, without end" beyond suffering and desire. If not in this life, then another. This is the core of Buddhism, and built around it are key concepts forming much of the basis of Buddhism.

Another notable concept in Buddhism is that of the Six Paths. The concept is that all forms of life are continually being reborn through six "lower" realms (in order from highest to lowest): The Deva/God realm, The Asura/Jealous God realm, The Human realm, The Animal realm, The Preta/Hungry Ghost realm, and The Hell realm/Naraka. All forms of life walk one of these six paths, named after the type of life-form walking down them, and on death, are reborn to walk down one of the paths again, the path depending on their karma. This applies to everyone, regardless of their status and achievements in their current life; even great priests and holy men might find themselves walking the path of an animal or preta in their next life.

The only way to escape from this cycle of reincarnation and travel to the Pure Land is to achieve enlightenment and perfect Buddhahood. With a few exceptions, this usually cannot be achieved within a single lifetime and must be strived towards gradually throughout multiple lives, slowly training and polishing one's soul, eventually liberating oneself from worldly desires.

According to the High Priest, there is no path for Magic Gods and as they didn't rise to their position through normal means, the gates of the Pure Land will not open for them.

Ouma is a tall man who is often seen wearing a black suit and tie. His eyes are always closed except when he is in pain or experiencing some other strong emotion. The Bow of Azusa is mounted on his right hand and acts as his main weapon.

He aims to use methods that would mitigate casualties and destruction. He fell in love with a girl who was cursed to die, yet refused to cry out for help. He originally claims to act for his own ends, but that is only because he doesn't want to blame his actions on and shift his sins to her. When Touma tells him that he and Index can help the girl get better, Ouma starts crying in front of them.

The Cursed Woman is a brown haired, wheelchair-bound woman. She is extremely skinny, has a fair complexion, and looks like she would collapse if left out in the sun too long. She is two to three years older than Yamisaka Ouma, old enough to no longer be called a girl.

The woman was put under an incurable curse under unknown circumstances. From an Eastern perspective, the curse resulted from Jugondō voodoo magic using mirrors and swords, while from a Western perspective, it was from a type of sympathetic magic, an imitative curse. The curse was like a tree, with its roots buried deep in her body, slowly draining her life away. She ended up in a hospital, assigned to Room 1205, but modern medicine couldn't cure her, and despite clear evidence that something was wrong with her weak body, all the tests even concluded that she was perfectly healthy. She had been in the hospital long enough to practically live there, and had resignedly accepted her death.

Kanzaki Kaori is 170 centimeters in height, with long black hair tied up in a ponytail that reaches her hips. She wears a short white T-shirt tied into a knot at the bottom, revealing her belly button; her dark blue jeans have one pantsleg cut off to be very short. She uses a two-meter-long nodachi called "Shichiten Shichitou" as her weapon. She wears a denim jacket over her usual attire in later novels. She wears a flower patterned yukata when she is at Necessarius' dormitories.

Kanzaki turned into a cold and taciturn woman, always serious, and not in the mood for jokes, the proverbial ice queen. Her personality gradually changes, showing a kinder side to herself and others after Touma saves Index and helps to confront her past with the Amakusa-Style Remix of Church, feeling more comfortable and grateful to Touma. She becomes more prone to showing emotion and sometimes showing a little embarrassment with other people. She has been described as innocent when it comes to sexuality.

She has been shown as being able to calm herself down by putting together a tower of tiles and then break them with a karate chop while she is regaining her serenity.

Saiji is described as being around 25 years old with a tall and skinny figure. He wears very loose clothes, an over-sized shirt with a slanted red cross emblazoned upon it. His hair is pitch black and is implied that he used hair dye on it, and is described as something akin to a carapace of a beetle. As with its style, it is like Touma, except messier. He wears basketball shoes with 1 meter long shoelaces. He also wears a rope hanging around his neck, where four to five mini-fans about 10 centimeters big are hanged.

To allies he is an amiable fellow who has shown to care deeply for his comrades, preferring to attack the Agnese Forces alone to free his comrades rather than escape without them. Moreover, he gets enraged when someone hurts them. As the substitute leader of the Amakusa Church, he closely follows the tenets set down by Kanzaki Kaori, specifically, to reach out to all those that are abandoned. When battling, he is shown to be boastful and confident. He often makes swaggers and sarcastic comments during them, but that does not entail that he is not serious.

A Christian sect based in Japan that was formed during the Edo period. Due to persecution, they hid their beliefs behind Shinto and Buddhist symbols, eventually creating a unique blend of Christianity mixed with other religions. The Amakusa specialize in secrecy and subtlety, carefully hiding magical symbols and rituals in everyday objects and actions. They are highly skilled in Idol Theory and unpredictable. After joining the Anglican Church, they act as field agents while residing in London's Japantown. The Amakusa favor teamwork and unity in combat.

Itsuwa is a young Japanese girl with black hair that reaches her shoulders, worn in a bobcut with short fringes. She has a well-endowed figure but is very modest about it. Itsuwa wears practical clothing that allows her to blend into her surroundings. She is friendly, warm, shy and skilled in housework. Itsuwa develops romantic feelings for Touma but struggles to express them due to her reserved nature, getting easily flustered by physical contact. In missions she is a serious and reliable ally, wielding a Friulian spear. Her special attack is the Saint Destroyer, which she developed to understand their former Priestess.

Touya is a middle-aged man in his 30s with a similar build and appearance to his son Touma. He has a stubble and tends to attract women despite being happily married, much to his and his colleagues' chagrin. As a traveling businessman, Touya journeys all over the world, collecting lucky charms and souvenirs in hopes of countering Touma's misfortune, which he feels guilty about. He sent Touma to Academy City so he could escape superstition. Though silly at times, Touya deeply cares for his family and is proud to be Touma's father, willing to stand up to magicians to protect him.

Gabriel has an androgynous appearance with feminine features, pure white skin covered in intricate golden lines, and a blue halo above its head. Its eyes are pure white with no visible pupils. As an angel, Gabriel is meant to have no emotions or desires beyond God's will. However, after falling to Earth it develops some personality, enjoying sweets and carrying on Sasha's speech patterns. It is ruthless in its goal to return to Heaven. Gabriel's power is immense, able to easily overwhelm many characters. Ruling over water, it can manipulate it in various forms and quantities. Its presence alone distorts reality.

Uragami has her hair tied in a ponytail with a small smiley-face ornament and an ahoge on top. She wears a purple shirt, red short skirt, and white thigh-high socks. Uragami wields a dress sword and is fairly acrobatic in combat. Like the other Amakusas, she likely knows how to hide magic in everyday objects and actions.

Ushibuka is a large man with short black hair. He wears a blue sweatshirt or jacket over his shirt with pants. His personality does not differ much from the other Amakusa members, sharing the perverted tendencies of the males. Ushibuka wields an axe in combat and works well in the coordinated teamwork the Amakusas specialize in.

Kouyagi is a boy with brown hair, described as short in stature. He wears a red jacket over his shirt. His personality is similar to the other Amakusas and he shares the perverted tendencies of the males despite his young age. Kouyagi dual wields a pair of daggers in combat, using his agility to parry attacks and quickly counterattack while the enemy is off balance. He is very acrobatic.

Isahaya is an elderly man over 50 years old with grey hair and a slightly protruding belly. He has a receding hairline and wears glasses. Isahaya's outfit consists of a light jacket over a turtleneck sweater with dark pants. He acts proud of Itsuwa like a grandfather would, while also sharing concern over her slow progress with Touma. Isahaya doesn't mind the occasional prank on her either. As an Amakusa, he is skilled in secretive magic and uses a flanged mace as his weapon of choice.

Coronzon's full, true appearance, if it has one, isn't known, though it is capable of manifesting a giant, sinister demonic face from the hair of its hosts.

Its current host body, supposedly that of Lola Zaza Crowley, is a girl whose appearance is that of an eighteen year old (though she is actually much older), with blue eyes and incredibly long blonde hair. Her hair is about 2.5 times her height, usually folded over and bound behind her head with a gold clasp, but still reaching her hips. She usually wears beige vestments.

Though Lola Stuart is known as someone who kept her good and bad deeds balanced as if to keep the scales level, Coronzon only restricts herself in that manner to provide an explanation and calm the waves when she takes actions which seemed out of character, until she fulfills the contract with Mathers. Beneath the façade it presents to the world, Coronzon is a cruel and manipulative entity who guided events across a century in order to complete its contract, free itself from its bounds, and seize everything it wants for itself.

Despite being the Archbishop, she looks like an eighteen year old girl. Her real age is unknown, though she looked the same twenty years prior according to Pope Matthai Reese. Regardless of her true age, Laura Stuart looks youthful. She is described as having crystal-white skin, clear blue eyes, and shining golden hair, comparing her appearance to that of a gem sold in a shop. Her very presence makes her stand out in a crowd.

The most striking characteristic of her appearance is her long blonde hair that is 2.5 times her height, which she takes tremendous effort in maintaining. It extends all the way to her ankles, then folds up and goes behind her head through the large silver hairpin that was holding it in place, and returns down to her waist.

As the head of Necessarius and the Archbishop of the Church of England, Laura Stuart has a cold and calculating personality befitting the tumultuous world of magic and science. She is described as "no one is better than her in manipulating human feelings, rationality, interests, ethics, and necessary values" and "the hidden dragon among magicians, she's somehow able to get to the top, and it's not done cheaply." She does as many good things as she does evil things, keeping an intricate balance. However, in spite of her villainous qualities she has a lighter side, having a casual and joking nature with equals and subordinates to the point they can spout violence against her without repercussions.

Awaki is a girl with long dark red hair tied into two low ponytails. Instead of wearing the Kirigaoka Girls' Academy uniform's dark blue coat the usual way, she wears it over her shoulders instead like a cape, wearing only a pink crop top and a pleated skirt. At times though, she is only seen with bandages to cover her breasts instead of wearing a crop top. She carries around a military flashlight, used to help her aim properly when she uses her ability, on her belt at all times.

Awaki is efficient in her missions and likes to make her opponents suffer. She prefers not to kill normally but won't hesitate to take lives if she has to. However, she began to develop a kinder side after moving in with Komoe Tsukuyomi, as demonstrated when she appreciated how Komoe cares even about someone like her that's fighting on the dark side. 

Awaki is fearful of her abilities, believing that she would end up using it to hurt others. This trauma is triggered not only by teleporting herself, but also by anything that reminds her of her past accident, such as seeing a man with an injured leg. She later gets over it after the events of October 9th.

FIVE_Over is based on macro engineering technology instead of micro quantum mechanics like esper abilities. The Modelcase_"RAILGUN" is the most well-known, resembling a 5 meter praying mantis with two arms, two legs, two foldable sickles, translucent wings, and a large cylinder on its back for storing shells. Its main weapons are two 3-barrel gatling railguns.

Modelcase_"MELT_DOWNER" resembles a transparent jellyfish with a dome-shaped body and tentacles all around. Along with "RAILGUN", it is a hybrid weapon that can be manned or remote-controlled. 

Modelcase_"MENTAL_OUT" resembles a 4m long scorpion wasp, with six legs, 8m long thin wings, and a translucent abdomen filled with anesthetic conducting fluid to contain a human body. It has a stinger formed by a tube that extends more than three times the length of its body.

OS (Outsider) units reproduce Level 5 powers through methods different from the original, only resembling the phenomenon. OS "ACCELERATOR" looks like a large crab monster with shields as its main weapons.

Touma looks like an ordinary high school student except for his spiky black hair, which he styles using hair gel. His father remarks that Touma looks just like his mother when worried or thinking deeply. 
Touma is a typical teenager in many ways, with the usual angst and laid-back attitude. However, he has a very strong desire to help others, even putting his own life on the line. Though lacking offensive or defensive abilities beyond his Imagine Breaker, Touma's willingness to help is a core part of his personality that attracts many to him. 
His Imagine Breaker, a mysterious power in his right hand, can negate all forms of magic, esper powers, and divine abilities - even his own good luck, leaving him plagued by misfortune. This, combined with his heroic tendencies and misfortune, often puts him at odds with powerful enemies. He has a cat named Sphynx, eternal companion of Index.

In addition to Imagine Breaker, Touma has displayed a form of instinctive precognition or an enhanced perception of his surroundings during combat. This is described as an ability to unconsciously anticipate attacks by picking up on minute changes and involuntary movements in the battlefield. 
Called 'Mind's Eye', 'Premonition Perception' or 'Zenchō no Kanchi', this ability is compared to but distinct from true Precognition. It is not a supernatural power, but rather a combination of Touma's extensive combat experience, courage, observation skills and reflexes.
Importantly, Touma is not consciously aware of this ability and it's said if he tries to actively use it, it's more likely to fail. It's an instinctual utilization of all the sensory information he's processing. This ability greatly supplements his battle strength beyond negation via Imagine Breaker.

District 6 is Academy City's recreation district, containing amusement parks, sports facilities, and other entertainment venues for residents to enjoy during their free time. The majority of the district is taken up by a massive multi-attraction amusement park used for research and experiments related to the service industry and entertainment. 
The amusement park spans nearly the entire district and includes typical attractions like roller coasters, a Ferris wheel, merry-go-round, and costumed staff. There are also luxury resort hotels and Secret Residences for wealthy patrons to rent. Infrastructure and heavy machinery supporting the attractions are hidden underground. 
Various suspicious rumors surround the district and its amusement park draws swindlers, thieves and other criminals looking to prey on the tourists. However, the advanced technology incorporated keeps the park running smoothly and safely for guests under normal circumstances.

Ainame Caroline was a highly intelligent young girl who used to be the head researcher at the Meltdowner research lab in Academy City. After being fired around half a year before the lab's closure, she formed the secret data theft group Honey Queen to steal back her research data and continue her work.
She is described as having a small yet alluring frame with imbalanced proportions. Caroline has straight rainbow-colored hair styled like an umbrella and wears a shoulderless dress made from sewn-together newspapers, duct tape, and accessories like glass shards and thumbtacks. 
In addition to her intellect and leadership skills, Caroline is a Level 1 esper who developed her own Thoughtography-type ability through Meltdowner research. She can use it to obtain information, predict the future, and destructively brand a target's brain to make them lose consciousness. Her laugh and verbal tic of ending sentences with "-desu" are distinctive traits.

Honey Queen was a secret group of data thieves that operated in Academy City, led by former Meltdowner research lab head Ainame Caroline. They aimed to steal back Caroline's research data after she was fired and continue her work on Project Angelica. 
Over six months, Honey Queen used various means to steal information to strengthen themselves and further their goal, with losses estimated at over 250 billion yen. Unlike some other dark side groups, Honey Queen had their subordinates, including thugs and delinquents with an intellectual vibe, support themselves through multiple illegal casinos rather than paying them directly.
Honey Queen came into conflict with the dark side group Item while attempting to obtain a sample of Meltdowner Mugino Shizuri's DNA. The group was ultimately destroyed after the deaths of Caroline and her main accomplice Tachiuo Mary at the research lab.

Tachiuo Mary was a tall, remodeled high school girl who acted as Ainame Caroline's test specimen and accomplice in the Honey Queen organization. She had long black hair styled in two buns and a rear braid, green eyes, and a white pollen mask covering her lower face.
Her esper ability is Anything Link, an electron-based power that allows her to send a beam through an esper's skull to disrupt their brain's chemical balance and make them lose control of their ability. Caroline considered her a prime candidate for her research due to the precision of her power. 
Tachiuo Mary underwent heavy physical modification by Caroline, granting her superhuman strength and agility with 503 bones (compared to a normal human's 206). In combat, she would use nearby objects as improvised weapons resembling Chinese weaponry, a reflex possibly written into her body and mind by Caroline. Despite her capabilities, she was ultimately killed by Item.

Hula Hoop is the largest particle accelerator in the world, situated in Academy City. The giant ring-shaped structure follows the shape of the city's walls in a 95km circumference and is built 200m underground. It consists of three rings that accelerate particles at different speeds. The third ring forces particles to go over 70% the speed of light. At maximum capacity, it can accelerate protons to 99.22% light speed and maintain that for 300 seconds before risking an explosion.
The accelerator requires a huge amount of power and has strict safety features given the dangerous radiation involved in its operation, with thick lead shielding and nuclear shelter-level protection walls. Its stability has the highest priority in the wall facility hierarchy. Hula Hoop has been used in experiments to create phenomena like new elements not found in the natural world.
Prior to its shutdown, the School District 14 portion of Hula Hoop hosted the Meltdowner research lab which developed Mugino Shizuri's Level 5 ability. The lab was also the site of Project Angelica aimed at developing an electron microscope and electric scalpel for industrial-scale genetic manipulation and esper designing, headed by Ainame Caroline before she was fired.

Qliphah Puzzle 545 appears as a translucent, barefoot girl with thin wings, pointy ears, a hole in her forehead, and a tentacle-like tail. She has a small curved frame with alluring individual parts but imbalanced proportions overall. Her most striking features are her straight rainbow-colored hair that spreads out like an umbrella and her large grin.
She wears an unusual dress made from aged and discolored English newspapers sewn together, with contents that change based on the viewer. It's decorated with silver duct tape wrapped to resemble the Qliphoth's structure, glass shards for jewels, thumbtacks, and brown ribbons. She also wears a large translucent curved hat.
Qliphah Puzzle 545 was created by Coronzon as a weapon to autonomously attack Aleister Crowley if Coronzon lost control. As an artificial demon based on the Qliphoth, the inverse of the Sephiroth, she represents misinformation, unnecessary grief, an atmosphere of hopeless war that drives people mad, and the essence of a guide. She has no direct combat strength, specializing in controlling and possessing others to fight for her.

The Kamijou Faction is a large and informal group of people associated with Kamijou Touma, the wielder of the mysterious Imagine Breaker. It spans magicians, espers, and normal people, making it a unique existence that doesn't neatly fit on the Magic or Science sides. The group has no real organization - membership is based solely on a connection to Touma.
Many of those considered part of the faction are people who used to lead difficult lives or faced problems they couldn't solve alone until they met Touma. He would help them, changing their lives and earning their friendship, respect and/or romantic feelings (the last one being most common among girls). As a result, though some like Kanzaki Kaori and Accelerator were antagonistic to Touma at first, they've become loyal allies who assist him in times of crisis.
The diversity of the faction and the power of its members makes it a formidable latent force in the eyes of some. Magicians like Terra of the Left have noted it violates the regular rules of the Magic-Science balance and could be highly destructive if roused. Touma himself is not consciously aware of his 'faction', nor does he try to utilize it, though enemies have tried to target his allies to get to him.

Princess Villian is the third and youngest daughter of Queen Elizard of the United Kingdom. She has a demeanor fitting the stereotypical image of a princess from a picture book - long blonde hair usually in a ponytail, fair skin and blue eyes. She is often seen in an elegant green dress with arm-length gloves, a hair veil, jewelry and a small crown.
Personality-wise, Villian is passive to the point of rarely having her own strong opinions, taking others' thoughts into high consideration. This stems from her inherent kindness and benevolence. However, she is capable of showing resolve when pushed, as her 'trait' among the princesses is 'virtue', allowing her to attract valuable allies to her side. 
Villian was once abducted and rescued at a young age, an event that left an impression on her. She later refused magical training out of dislike for gaining abilities that could be used as weapons. As the third princess, Villian had high popularity with the public but little real power, often serving as just the Royal Family's public face.

Elizalina is a blonde-haired woman with slightly sunken eyes and a physique so frail that one would be more concerned for her health than attracted to her beauty. She has an unkempt appearance and wears a light brown fur coat. Despite her looks, she possesses a sharp mind.
A well-loved leader referred to as a 'saint' by her citizens, Elizalina fought against Russia to gain independence for her country and established the foundations for it and others to be politically and economically independent. She has an antagonistic relationship with her elder twin sister, the Maiden of Versailles.
As a sorcerer, Elizalina specializes more in teaching and guiding others than direct combat. Her magical knowledge allowed her to readjust the Alliance's religious foundation, implement security systems, and train magicians capable of fighting. She can improvise spiritual items, has a potent defensive spell, and is versed in complex magical principles. Additionally, she has medical expertise in narcotics and communicates telepathically through unknown means.

Roberto Katze is the current President of the United States, a Hispanic man with a large muscular physique, swarthy skin, swept hair and a thick chin curtain beard. Unusual for a president, he is very casual and familiar with people to the point of childishness, getting upset when he's not recognized. He has a habit of embellishing the truth and is a rather perverted playboy prone to having visible 'reactions' even in professional settings.
However, Roberto is smarter than he seems. A high school dropout and former undocumented immigrant, he worked his way up to being the third Hispanic president. His unorthodox behavior and verbal slips give him a 'strange politician' reputation which, combined with his accomplishments, improve his approval ratings as people feel more of a connection to him.
Despite his flaws, Roberto has a deep love for his country and strives to act in the best interests of his citizens. He is willing to make difficult decisions and even risk his own political standing for the greater good, as shown when he chose to spare Othinus and leave her fate to the world's judgment.

Oyafune Monaka is a member of Academy City's Board of Directors and the mother of Oyafune Suama, a teacher at Kamijou Touma's school. She appears to be a woman in her 50s or 60s with a small stature compared to Touma. Her most notable accessory is a handmade scarf that she is very protective of as it was made by her daughter.
In contrast to the general impression of the Board of Directors being 'a gathering of shitty bastards', Monaka sincerely cares about Academy City's students. Her strong moral compass means she would stand against even an entire country for the sake of a crying child she doesn't know. This has put her at odds with the city's darker elements.
In the past, Monaka's efforts against a pro-military export faction of the board led to them threatening her daughter's life to force her to back down. Since then, she has avoided directly involving herself in the city's darkness, but still works to limit unethical actions in ways that won't draw their attention. Her unique position and strong principles make her a valuable and trusted ally to those opposing Academy City's dark side.

Kaizumi Tsugutoshi is an old man who sits on Academy City's Board of Directors. He lives a life of luxury, wearing formal attire more suited to an antique setting and enjoying refined tastes in music, theater, and the arts. As a nouveau riche, he believes indulging in vices like tobacco and alcohol dulls the senses and diminishes his ability to enjoy the finer things in life, only drinking when stressed.  
Though he has been involved in Academy City's dark side to a degree, Kaizumi has also taken actions that could be considered 'good 'with Kumokawa Seria's guidance, such as working to bring Gemstones to the safety of the city and prevent unethical projects. He refers to Gemstones as children who happen to have certain abilities rather than by that label.
Kaizumi relies heavily on Kumokawa Seria's intelligence and advice to guide his decisions as a director, with her acting as his 'brain'. The exact circumstances of how he brought the brilliant girl to his side are unclear, but it is said he 'tamed' her. Their dynamic is one where he makes the decisions while she analyzes the situation and suggests the best course of action to take.

Rain and Sunny are twin sisters who are members of the Kamisato Faction, a group that has gathered around Kamisato Kakeru. The two serve as the faction's information gatherers and a source of funds.
As fortune tellers, the sisters use a globe to gather precise information over a wide area, the globe providing a weather map of the planet and the movement of stars. They sometimes directly manipulate weather conditions by scattering substances like dry ice or silver iodide from aircraft in order to guide circumstances in a direction that favors them.
The Weather Girls are a powerful presence in weather-related markets and derivatives, their online trading providing an important source of funding for the Kamisato Faction's activities. Since their fortune telling can bypass conventional data protection, the information they can acquire is highly valuable to the faction.

Salome is the non-blood related younger sister of Kamisato Kakeru and a member of the Kamisato Faction. She has long silver hair rolled up on the sides of her head, tanned skin, and dresses in a provocative manner with two translucent hooded raincoats and no shoes. She carries a toy pocket watch on a string around her neck, which she kisses as a good luck charm.
Personality-wise, Salome is rather crazy and has no qualms about killing. She takes a thrill in hunting valuable targets and has a reputation as a mass murderer. However, she has her own set of rules and standards - she avoids killing defenseless civilians and won't kill unless it benefits her brother. Her manner of speech is frank and she tends to end sentences with 'don'tcha think?' 
Salome's magic specializes in destroying weapons and offering them to a sea god to gain their traits. She has also modified her body into an artificial one, gradually offering her original flesh and blood to boost her abilities further. As such, her body itself is a weapon. Salome is not blindly devoted to her brother like other members and is willing to act against his wishes if she deems it necessary.

The Kamisato Faction is a group similar to yet distinct from Kamijou Touma's Kamijou Faction. Its core is Kamisato Kakeru, a high school boy who has the mysterious World Rejecter in his right hand. The faction is made up of various girls, many with unusual abilities from the Magic and Science sides, who were previously helped by Kakeru in some manner and subsequently gathered around him.
Unlike the Kamijou Faction, whose members largely live their own lives, the Kamisato Faction is heavily dependent on Kakeru, following him around constantly. They are quick to use their abilities to assist him and work together in a more coordinated manner. However, their formation tends to break if Kakeru is directly threatened.
Kakeru makes use of the girls' skills and allows them to drag him around, but he is uncomfortable with the situation, believing their unnatural attachment to him is a result of World Rejecter twisting them. He dislikes the power and resents the Magic Gods for indirectly causing this situation. The girls, having been 'accepted' by Kakeru, are unaffected by World Rejecter's power, which 'exiles' what he rejects.

Stiyl Magnus is a 14-year-old magician from the Anglican Church's Necessarius division. Despite his young age, he has the appearance of a tall adult man with dyed red hair, piercings, barcode tattoo under his eye, and the smell of smoke. He is usually seen in a black priest robe and is an extremely heavy smoker.
Personality-wise, Stiyl has a short temper but is actually kind, caring deeply for Index and determined to protect her at all costs. His failure to save her life without her losing memories is his greatest regret. He dislikes Touma but respects his ability to make Index happy. Stiyl has to deal with the antics of his superior Laura Stuart.
As a magician, Stiyl specializes in fire and rune magic. He has a magic name - Fortis931. His most notable spell is 'Innocentius', a powerful 3000°C fire monster. Due to his magic draining a lot of energy, Stiyl's physical body is actually quite weak.

Orsola Aquinas is a mature nun known for her large breasts and attractive figure, accentuated by her Roman Catholic habit. She has slightly short blonde hair and blue eyes. Her exact age is unknown.
Personality-wise, Orsola is very kind, courteous, and amicable, quickly befriending even strangers. However, she is also quite airheaded and prone to trailing off topic, a fact many of her peers find annoying. When she gets serious though, her words carry weight, likely due to her skill as a preacher. 
Orsola was originally part of the Roman Catholic Church, specializing in preaching to pagan countries and decoding written codes. Her decoding skill led to her being targeted by her own church in order to silence her deciphering of the Book of the Law. She was rescued by the Anglican Church and subsequently took shelter with them in Necessarius, though she still practices her Roman Catholic faith.

Elizard is the reigning monarch, the Queen Regnant, of the United Kingdom. As a 50-year-old woman, her skin and hair are beginning to show age, but she still has a regal bearing and 'core' that outdoes even much younger people. She is always seen wearing a long black and white dress along with a golden crown.
Personality-wise, Elizard acts goofy and casual even with strangers, such as wanting to surprise guests with her electric guitar skills. However, this belies her nature as a strong and pragmatic leader, willing to make tough decisions in times of crisis. She is said to be the ideal leader, balancing the personalities of her three daughters.
Elizard rules as part of the three major factions controlling the United Kingdom alongside the Knights of England and the Anglican Church. As the monarch, she wields the lesser Curtana Second sword, representing the leader of the angels and empowering the knights with Telesma. She is a skilled magician in her own right, capable of using the Union Jack spiritual item and rebuilding the magical foundations of entire nations.

The British Royal Family refers to the group of close relatives of the reigning monarch of the United Kingdom. They form one of the three major factions that control the country through a system of checks and balances alongside the Knights of England and the Anglican Church.
The head of the royal family is the ruling monarch, who is also the Supreme Governor of the Church of England. The family primarily resides in Buckingham Palace and Windsor Castle, served by royal maids and a chamberlain. Joining the family is only possible through descent from the monarch or demonstrating exceptional political skill as a close aide.
The role of the Royal Family faction is to intervene and seize control of the parliamentary government when needed to maintain substantial control of the nation. They also handle all diplomatic foreign relations. There are a number of unique magical spells, spiritual items and privileges associated with the royal family, such as the Curtana sword representing England's ruler.

Meigo Arisa is a 15-year-old Level 0 esper with long pink hair that she often ties up and pink eyes. She is often seen wearing a light pink smock-like shirt, blue pants, and a light blue newsboy cap with a dove decoration. On one occasion she was seen wearing glasses despite having no vision problems.
Arisa is a very kind and selfless girl with a ravenous appetite similar to Index. She is a hard worker who discovered her talent for singing after failing to gain esper abilities, believing it could help her regain something she lost in the past. She is a natural idol, unafraid of the stage or skimpy outfits. Arisa does have doubts about whether people are only drawn to her singing because of her subconscious power to cause 'miracles'.
As a Level 0, Arisa has no scientifically explainable abilities, but her singing sometimes coincides with miraculous events like people surviving certain death. She was born from people's wishes during a crisis, but has no memories of her life before 3 years ago. The Church of England temporarily designated her as a potential 'Saint' because of her powers.

Carissa is the second princess of the United Kingdom, with long blonde hair tied back and blue eyes. She appears to be in her late 20s. Carissa wears a tight-fitting bright red leather dress resembling bondage gear, with matching gloves nearly up to her shoulders. She tops this with a small golden crown.
Personality-wise, Carissa is extremely prideful and militaristic. She looks down on her younger sister and is quick to propose shows of force against other countries. Her love of her country drives her to extreme actions like planning a coup to increase the UK's power. Carissa is clever though, deliberately acting as a cruel tyrant to achieve her goals while minimizing fallout on the country and her allies.
As a member of the royal family, Carissa can wield the Curtana Original sword, representing the Archangel Michael. This grants her immensely increased strength, speed, endurance and near invulnerability. She can also use the sword to generate dimensional debris as projectiles. After the sword is destroyed, Carissa makes use of leftover shards of the sword for similar abilities.

Riméa is the first princess and likely heir apparent of the United Kingdom. She is a beautiful, slender woman who appears to be in her early 30s with shoulder-length black hair, which she may dye, and blue eyes. She often wears an elegant long blue dress and a monocle, giving her an air of intellectualism and level-headedness.
Riméa has a cautious and distrusting nature, keeping even her own family at arms length. She goes to the extent of having private rooms arranged to her liking and keeping pets just to have them taste-test her food for poison. She gets along better with people who don't know her true identity. Despite this, she does have a bit of a quirky side.
While Riméa's specific abilities are not shown, she is capable of using magic. She believes she could wield the Curtana Second sword if she got ahold of it. During the British Halloween, she investigated her sister's actions and rallied support with a nationwide broadcast. She later wielded the Curtana Lost, a spear with a piece of Curtana, during an emergency.
