entries.content:
Sozty Exica is a girl of around middle school age with slightly tan skin, olive green eyes, and short grey hair with two tufts hanging down to frame her face. Her most notable accessory is a small red bindi or jewel on her forehead. Sozty wears a modified school uniform based on her (misguided) research into Japanese culture - an extremely short blouse showing her navel and an equally short skirt, with thigh-high socks and loafers.
Personality-wise, Sozty comes across as a bright, energetic and healthy girl, albeit with some naivete about the wider world. She is extremely loyal and determined in her goals, willing to work hard and make personal sacrifices for the sake of her magic cabal and especially her older sister. However, Sozty is not blindly devoted, and will turn against her cabal if she realizes their actions are wrong.
As a magician, Sozty specializes in using a modified version of the Agni's Festival Fire, which allows her to generate explosions at a distance, though with issues of accuracy. She can also use the Agni Astra in its base form to create a light-based communication code. Additionally, Sozty is capable of using Garuda for reconnaissance and the Shiva Astras for direct combat.

The Agnese Forces are a 250-strong Roman Catholic paramilitary organization of battle nuns led by Agnese Sanctis. Originally fully loyal to the Vatican, they blindly followed the Church's dogma and were willing to deceive and brutalize enemies of the Church. However, after being betrayed and used as scapegoats, they reformed and allied with the Anglican Church as part of Necessarius, though they remain Roman Catholic in practice.
In combat, the nuns use an assortment of medieval weapons like polearms and swords alongside more unconventional armaments like silver rods, giant crosses, gears, and wheels. They also employ Christian-based magic. The Agnese Forces work to gather intelligence, conduct investigations, prosecute enemies, and provide medical care. Their specialty seems to be in allowing the Church to act through them while avoiding responsibility.
After World War III, the Agnese Forces made efforts to fully return to the Roman Catholic Church as relations between the denominations improved. Members of the Agnese Forces still maintain a strong sense of camaraderie with each other and unwavering loyalty to their leader Agnese.

Agnese Sanctis is a young girl with long reddish hair tied in many pencil-thin braids resembling dreadlocks and blue eyes. She wears a modified Roman Catholic nun's habit with an extremely short skirt and tall platform boots. Her small frame makes her look a year or two younger than Index.
Agnese has an extremely devoted and ruthless personality as the leader of the Agnese Forces. She is willing to deceive others and cruelly punish enemies of the Church. However, her faith is based more on doubt than trust, and she hesitates when that doubt grows. After reforming, Agnese shows more of her childish side, getting flustered and clumsy in daily life.
Agnese's primary weapon is the Lotus Wand, a metal staff topped with an angel statuette. Channeling the symbolism of various elements through the wand based on Idol Theory, Agnese can generate powerful invisible attacks, switching between blunt strikes and cutting by damaging the wand itself. She can also create bright flashes of light by striking the ground to blind opponents.

Angelene is a small young nun with a childlike appearance, notable for her freckles and long honey-colored hair worn in twin braids. Her nun's habit is very loose on her small frame, with her hands and feet often hidden in the billowing fabric. Around her waist she wears a metal belt with containers for her coin bag weapons.
In contrast with the serious Lucia, Angelene comes across as timid and childish. She is a big eater rivaling Index in appetite and has a sweet tooth. However, Angelene can get very determined when it comes to helping her friends and admired leader Agnese. She also has a strange habit of flipping up others' skirts to distract them when arguments get out of hand.
Angelene's magic revolves around her Coin Bags of St. Matthew, based on the apostle's role as a tax collector. By infusing the bags with angelic prayers, Angelene can launch the coin-filled pouches as remote-controlled projectiles that glow with elemental colors and sprout wings. The bags automatically lock on to targets, but are weak to interception spells exploiting their long activation chant.

Lucia is a tall young nun with short blonde hair mostly covered by a black coif except for a lock on each side of her face. She has intense blue eyes and a cold demeanor. Like the other Agnese Forces nuns, she wears a customized black habit with detached lower half to expose her legs, which are clad in black stockings attached to a garterbelt. 
Lucia has an extremely devoted personality, bordering on religious fanaticism. She views all non-believers as enemies and takes great offense to a man simply touching her. Lucia strictly adheres to her idea of a proper nun and is very critical of her junior Angelene's more childish behavior. However, she shows genuine care for her friends and is fiercely loyal to Agnese.
In battle, Lucia wields a large wooden carriage wheel, based on the story of St. Catherine of Alexandria's martyrdom. Smashing the wheel causes it to explode into numerous sharp wooden shards which automatically target the 'guilty' as defined by Lucia's perception, making it a dangerous weapon. The wheel can regenerate itself by pulling the shards back together.

Agata is a young nun with long brown hair, blue eyes, and glasses. She has a similar build and height to Lucia.
Like the other Agnese Forces nuns, Agata is a skilled combatant and works to support the group in various missions and battles.
Agata has enough magical and technical knowledge to serve as the helmsman of a large ice ship on her own, commanding her own subordinates in the process. She is also trained in magical forensic techniques for removing traces of magic from incident scenes.

Caterina is a young nun and member of the Agnese Forces. Like Agnese, Lucia, Angelene, and Agata, she was originally an orphan who was taken in and raised by the Roman Catholic Church to become a nun.
While not much is known about Caterina's appearance or personality, she works together with the other Agnese Forces nuns to carry out the group's various missions and duties.
Caterina is skilled enough in magic to be a member of the battle-oriented Agnese Forces and to live alongside the other magic-wielding nuns in Necessarius's women's dorm in London.

The Dawn-Colored Sunlight is one of the largest and most influential magic cabals in the world, based in the United Kingdom. Their ultimate goal is to remove the distinction between the magic and science sides, allowing them to rule over both.
The cabal was originally founded under a different name to investigate and document the qualities of those who stand above others, intending to eventually use that knowledge to dominate the world. They later infiltrated the famous magic cabal Golden Dawn in order to study them from within.
Over time, the Dawn-Colored Sunlight took on more qualities of the magic cabals they studied, but still seek to regain their original power and achieve world domination. The group is currently led by the young Leivinia Birdway and has assets and agents positioned all around the globe.

Mark Space is a tall blonde man who wears a clean black formal suit. He has a serious and professional demeanor as the personal assistant to Leivinia Birdway, the leader of the Dawn-Colored Sunlight magic cabal.
Despite his boss's young age and bratty attitude, Mark is extremely loyal to Leivinia and the organization's goals. However, he is not afraid to be strict with Leivinia when needed, believing a leader should put work before play.
As a magician of the Dawn-Colored Sunlight, Mark specializes in using the Minor Arcana tarot cards, specifically the suit of swords, to create powerful elemental wind spells. By arranging the cards in different combinations, Mark can summon the power of an archangel to cause massive phenomena.

Shutaura Sequenzia is a slim young woman with long black hair and eyes. She is usually seen wearing the form-fitting gray, white and red bodysuit that serves as the uniform of Academy City's Black Crow Unit, which she leads.
Shutaura has an extremely serious personality and rarely shows emotion, though anger is a notable exception. She is ruthlessly dedicated to her missions. Shutaura is also tone-deaf and unable to recognize music due to a past trauma, which fuels her stubborn denial of miracles.
As a Level 4 Esper, Shutaura's ability is known as Earth Palette. She can store and release explosive energy through rare earth elements, usually in the form of discs or cartridges fired from her weapons. In combat, Shutaura is very agile and skilled in using wires and firearms alongside her ability.

Ladylee Tangleroad is a very petite girl with long blonde hair, aquamarine eyes and pale skin who appears to be around 10 years old. She often wears eccentric gothic lolita style dresses featuring black and white or gray checkered patterns.
Having lived for around 1000 years, Ladylee is a highly manipulative and patient schemer, but also somewhat deranged, obsessed with finding a way to end her immortal existence at any cost. She sees humans as disposable pawns in her plans and has grown completely numb to the value of life.
Originally an ancient Greek astrology sibyl, Ladylee gained immortality by eating the legendary ambrosia in the 12th century AD. However, this twisted her body's mana circuits, preventing her from using magic directly. Ladylee has since gained extensive magical knowledge which she uses to create tools and spells for others to utilize on her behalf.

Fleiss is a female magician and member of the small Dawn that Wipes Away Darkness magic cabal from England. Her cabal specializes in a now-obsolete Tattva-based magic system that involves colorizing elements and interfering with natural forces by mixing colors.
Despite coming from the magic side, Fleiss is fairly knowledgeable about science, microbes, and can use some technological equipment. She infiltrated Academy City under the pretense of preventing a worldwide threat from the artificial microbes developed in the Mars World experiment in order to prove her cabal's relevance in the modern world of magic.

Oumi Shuri has the appearance of a 10-year old girl despite being over 30 years old, due to her body being modified by a disease that stopped her aging. She has long brown hair tied back in a ponytail and a child-like complexion. Shuri wears a pink cheerleader-like outfit with a tied crop top, short skirt, thigh-high socks and boots. She carries a large backpack containing various tools.
As the oldest of her group, Shuri is the most serious and dedicated to her missions as a Kouga ninja. She works best in a team, acting as the center of attention to distract enemies while her allies employ their tricks. Despite her skills, Shuri can still act childishly at times and has extensive knowledge of children's media to maintain her disguises.

Kumokawa Maria is a teenage girl with long black ringlet curls and a moderate chest size. She wears a distinctive maid uniform based on the electronics district with a fluorescent yellow color scheme, including a crop top, mini skirt, thigh-high socks and a rabbit-shaped name tag.
Maria has a very energetic and prideful personality, aiming to serve an incompetent master to lower her pride to a manageable level. She is extremely intelligent, athletic, and analytically minded. Maria cares deeply about her former teacher Kihara Kagun.
As a Level 2 esper, Maria's ability is Violence Doughnut, which increases her body's centrifugal forces. She combines this with her mastery of Capoeira, breakdancing, pole dancing and other unorthodox martial arts to be a surprisingly formidable hand-to-hand fighter despite her level.

Cendrillon is a slender young woman with blonde hair, white skin and a well-featured face. She dresses in a princess-like gown made of countless thin membranes layered on top of each other, giving an ideal picture book girl image. 
As a magician, Cendrillon is merciless to her enemies and very clever in battle, using her opponents' powers to her advantage. However, she holds a strong loyalty to her comrades, willing to endure torture and cause self-harm to protect their plans. Cendrillon has a deep hatred for traitors and will manipulate others to get revenge.
After being betrayed and nearly killed, Cendrillon gained the ability to reconstruct her body from separated 'ingredient' parts, though improper reconstruction can alter her form, such as making her appear as a young girl. She is resourceful enough to create medical equipment from nearby objects.

keys: Will of the Whole Misaka Network
entries.content:
The Will of the Whole Misaka Network is a non-corporeal existence, a single organic system and thought entity born from the gathering of consciousness and egos of the 20,001 Sisters clones. Having no physical form of her own, she temporarily possesses the bodies of individual Sisters to communicate.
Energetic and prone to cracking jokes, the Will is nonetheless very wise and caring, able to perceive the dangers of certain courses of actions and warn the protagonists against them. She speaks in a unique manner reminiscent of a typewriter, using key names like "/return" to start new sentences.
The Will contains the recorded memories and final moments of all the Sisters, including the ones who have died, giving her a special perspective on life, death and the feelings of the deceased. Unbound by individual life and death, her existence cannot be directly altered by Magic Gods.
entries.comment: Will of the Whole Misaka Network

entries.content:
Saflee is a young woman in her early 20s with shoulder-length blonde hair, white skin, and a physique attractive enough to be a magazine model. Her usual outfit is a modified deep blue party dress reinforced with leather belts wrapped around her upper body, along with fingerless gloves containing urethane to reduce impact on her fists.
Her beliefs center around the idea of pure destruction and the exhilaration that comes from it, seeking to prove that those with special abilities aren't the only ones who can set the standard for power. Saflee has a strong sense of justice and will not hesitate to protect the innocent from harm.
Possessing incredible martial arts skill and physical fitness, Saflee was able to defeat the microwave-wielding Osad Flakehelm in the Natural Selector tournament and go toe-to-toe with various armed opponents throughout the chaos in Baggage City.

Kanou Shinka is a short boy who appears to be about 12 years old. He has shoulder-length brown hair and wears a black hooded jacket with bear ears, black shorts, a blue shirt, and socks.

Kanou is described as a crybaby and is shown to be timid and easily frightened. Despite this, he cares deeply for his friend Frenda Seivelun. When she disappears, Kanou assumes the false identity of Aihana Etsu in order to search for clues about what happened to her, even if it means getting involved with the dark side of Academy City.

Though frightened and out of his depth, Kanou shows great determination and bravery in his quest to find the truth about Frenda. In the end, even after learning of her death, he fights to protect the memory of his dear friend.

Akikawa Mie is a middle school girl with shoulder-length black hair and a healthy tan. She wears a white sailor uniform with a short skirt and a mint green cardigan tied around her waist.

Mie acts like a typical teenager - wanting to assert herself through her appearance but getting embarrassed if its pointed out, and finding her own father lame. However, she deeply loves her parents and the work they do. This leads to her stubbornly trying to deliver their precious Liquid Diamond even through the dangerous chaos in Academy City and against her mother's wishes.

During her adventure, Mie ends up crossing paths with several other characters while being pursued by delinquents who want to steal the diamond. She is ultimately saved by Kamijou Touma, though he doesn't remember the incident afterwards much to her annoyance. Mie later becomes an unlikely leader figure at her school during the heatwave in the city.

Keshouin Asuka has black hair in a bob cut with a frontal fringe and purple eyes. She wears a largely grey school uniform consisting of a white shirt, red and yellow striped tie, grey V-neck jumper, skirt, long socks and black shoes. Her most distinctive feature is the red bunny ear headband she always wears, which has earned her the nickname Jumpy Bunny. 

Asuka has a very shy and easily frightened personality, frequently turning to her friend Akikawa Mie when scared or in need of help. She is quick to tears when upset. However, she is still reliable enough to serve as the student council president at her school.

As an esper, Asuka has the Level 2 ability of Pyrokinesis. While the exact scope of her power is unknown, she should be capable of creating and controlling small flames. Her ability and level were briefly relevant when her appearance was borrowed by someone else using it as a disguise.

Fran is a small girl who wears pink pajamas covered in Bunny Grey designs. The pajama hoodie has baggy sleeves, is lined in purple, has carrot-shaped toggles and a large Bunny Grey logo on the back. She also wears a headband with antennae positioned to resemble rabbit ears as well as a round rabbit tail antenna on her bottom. Her black hair is in a bob cut with a frontal fringe and she has purple eyes. 

She carries a round, overstuffed grey backpack full of radios and electronic equipment, with various antennae sticking out of it. Fran is frequently seen floating around holding onto a giant UFO-shaped balloon with 'ABDUCTION' written on it, also sporting a Bunny Grey logo. The balloon is capable of lighting up and glowing.

Fran is a magician who specializes in spells derived from the observation of stars and mysterious lights in the sky, which were seen as ill omens in the past before the modern UFO age. She can read the future in the stars and draw out their power. Unknown to herself for a long time, Fran also served as a secondary avatar for the demon Coronzon while under the Archbishop's command, with her life force pathways and strength enhanced by a Telesma-like power at great risk to herself.

Mina Mathers appears as a young woman with long white hair covered by a black mourning veil. She wears risqué black mourning clothing which exposes her legs and large breasts. Her dress has a star motif, with constellations on her veil, dress and stockings, and large silver stars fastening her dress. She also has black cat ears and a tail.

Aspects of the original Mina's personality are shown through her recreation. She prioritized the cabal's magical research goal like the other members, though showing signs of jealousy at times. The recreated Mina likes explaining things and has a witch-like tendency to tempt, tease and lead astray.

Mina's existence is that of a thought entity and grimoire born from the Reading Thoth 78 device, given the identities of Mina Mathers and the Thoth Tarot to remind Aleister Crowley of his trauma from the Golden Dawn's downfall. As a grimoire, she is bound to the Windowless Building unless given a new vessel.

After being released back into the world, Lilith appears as a young baby wrapped in a blanket, whose gender might not be determinable at a glance and weighs less than 5kg. She has a colorful name tag around her wrist, seemingly plastic but actually made from an unknown material.

Though Lilith exhibits typical baby behavior, her mind is fairly mature and she displays it when communicating via her proxy. She is quite knowledgeable for her age.

When she was released, Lilith lacked a physical body and was an exposed life force that would not have lasted long without a vessel of flesh eventually being created for her. While she had the strength, Lilith was capable of creating animated wooden constructs with her thoughts and communicating through a proxy. Having passed through Aiwass, she holds unfathomable hidden power and potential within her.

During a vision shown to Kamijou Touma, Rose was described as ephemeral. Shortly after Lilith's birth, Rose was shown wearing a dress and bonnet with long light-colored hair.

Prior to her breakdown and alcoholism after Lilith's death, Rose was kind and her kindness was compared to that of Orsola Aquinas by Aleister.

Rose met Aleister some time after he destroyed the Golden Dawn. During their marriage, she assisted Aleister in his magical research, acting as a medium for Aiwass in Egypt which led to the creation of the Book of the Law. After giving birth to Lilith, Rose became unstable and Aleister stopped his research to protect her and their daughter. Following Lilith's sudden death and Aleister's subsequent actions, Rose broke down, turned to alcoholism and eventually left Aleister.

Lola Zaza Crowley was the second daughter of Aleister Crowley and his first wife, Rose Edith Kelly.

Lola disliked her father Aleister due to his treatment of her mother Rose after her older sister Lilith's death.

While Lola herself does not personally appear in the story's events, her name features prominently during the latter part of the story concerning Aleister Crowley.

The Bologna Succubus is described as a beautiful horned and winged woman, appearing college-aged. She has light skin, long, fluffy blonde hair, a large bust, and pink eyes with heart shapes in them. She also has a pair of goat-like horns, a pair of giant, thin bat-like wings, and a long tail. Her attire, all pink, consists of a lacy corset with rose thorn decorations, arm covers, stockings and high heels.

The Bologna Succubus is associated with a 1468 case where a man in Bologna, Italy was executed after being found guilty of running a brothel of succubi. As a result, she has made it her purpose to protect the reputation of the falsely accused and hates any such accusations, willing to risk her life to save victims of them and fight her fellow Transcendents over such matters.

As a Transcendent, the Bologna Succubus is powerful enough to rival the regular magic side under the right circumstances. She uses a spell called Cold Mistress, which converts pleasure signals into pain with a large range and both specific and general targeting. The greater the target's happiness, the greater the agony she can inflict on them. By adjusting its strength, she can also deliberately induce mass hysteria and witch hunts.

The Bridge Builders Cabal dwells in the hidden part of the world and is made up of powerful magicians called Transcendents, each capable of rivaling the regular Magic Side on their own, who have gathered to collectively decide how to make the world a better place, with Alice Anotherbible at their center.

Transcendents each have their own legends, reasons for wanting to change the world, and set conditions, often related to their backgrounds, for who they will save and who they will let be destroyed in the process. Most share a mechanical mentality in carrying out their "salvation". If their conditions are met, a Transcendent will fight to save a target even against their fellow Transcendents.

The cabal's ultimate goal involves positioning the Transcendents as a complex device to create something extremely powerful to save the world in a way they cannot, using a ceremony based on a certain idea proposed by Aleister Crowley. One of their main rules revolves around not upsetting Alice. The cabal's base changes according to Alice's whims, with no other real reason for its form.

"Good Old Mary" appears as a young wife with long blonde hair which reaches down to her ankles. She wears a wide-brimmed hat which hides her eyes, and a long, loose white dress with a thick belt lazily wrapped around her waist with various camping kitchen products attached. Mary tends to refer to herself in the third-person as "mama".

Matching the symbolism of a mother protecting her children or a queen protecting her people, Mary will apparently do whatever it takes to protect her decided territory, currently the Bridge Builders Cabal.

As a Transcendent, Mary is said to possess alchemical skill that can produce miracles on par with her namesake. She specializes in "kitchen alchemy", using the tools on her belt to produce various phenomena in her vicinity, described as highly versatile and comparable to a Swiss army knife. By releasing a singular seal, she can summon gigantic alchemical tools said to contain entire universes inside them. Among Mary's repertoire is a Resurrection Recipe which repairs a dead human body to a clean, uninjured state, though it has limits and costs.

Aradia appears as a silver-haired girl of around 17 or 18. She wears a wimple large enough to fall to her ankles, giving her a nun-like silhouette, combined with a skimpy dancer's outfit resembling a bikini variant and baring her feet and navel, the combination apparently meant to look immoral.

Aradia expresses disinterest in things relating to the cross, considering it newfangled nonsense, though this may be simply lip service given her role as an advocate for witches. She moonbathes and forestbathes in order to calm herself. 

As a Transcendent, Aradia is said to be powerful enough to rival the regular magic side under the right circumstances. She is described as a goddess of witches, the moon and night. Aradia makes extensive use of Wiccan magic, including ointments, the Rule of Three, and a spell to amass good fortune by exploiting it. By releasing a triple seal, she can draw on the power of the triple goddess within her flesh.

Mut Thebes looks to be a skinny girl of about 15, with blue eyes, long wavy blonde hair and brown skin. She wears a revealing outfit consisting of thin belts and pure gold ornaments, exposing her skin to support her magic.

Mut Thebes outdid other candidates to earn her desired position in the Bridge Builders Cabal. Matching the symbolism of a mother or queen protecting her children or people, she will apparently do whatever it takes to protect her decided territory. She has a tsundere trait and some tension with her fellow Transcendent Trismegistus.

As a Transcendent, Mut Thebes is said to be powerful enough to rival the regular magic side and specializes in punishment and execution. Her primary magic, Dead Phoenix, allows her to absorb the shadows of objects and people that come into contact with her own shadow, deploying white copies of absorbed objects with their original capabilities. By releasing a dual seal, she can enhance this power. Some of her movements have been compared to those of a bird.

The HsB-02 is a series of supersonic stealth bomber planes created by Academy City. Its length varies but is generally considered to be around 80 to 100 meters long. 

The HsB-02 has a maximum speed of 7,000 km/h, capable of outrunning any missiles. It uses liquid oxygen and hydrogen for both fuel and cooling. Besides bombs, the HsB-02 is equipped with the powerful Earth Blade weapon. By accelerating iron sand to 10,000 km/h into the vacuum left by the plane's speed, it can create a blade of 8,000°C molten metal, with a pattern that can be controlled by electricity.

Eight HsB-02s were sent to suppress a riot in Avignon, carrying several hundred automated HsPS-15 suits. The bombers were also deployed in World War III to bomb targets and deploy powered suits in Russia. Their manufacture broke agreements with the Japanese government, though the consequences of this are unknown.

School District 9 is located in the western part of Academy City. The district concentrates on schools related to arts and crafts. In the field of performing arts, hologram technology is used instead of traditional methods.

The district has a unique regulation where the typical Japanese hierarchy based on seniority is completely abolished. Instead, the district's hierarchy is based purely on ability alone.

There are rumors that if one asks for a portrait in one of the district's parks, they could get scouted as a model, though the truth of this is unconfirmed. Notable locations include an academic theatre holding classic performances and a conference center which has hosted an International Esper Powers Research Conference.

The Beauty Salon Specialty School is located in Academy City's School District 9.

All new students at this school are provided with professional scissors for their studies. Specifically, they are given Zeligem's RU-77K model scissors.

Among the students, there are three at Level 1 and 2 who have the ability to put people to sleep. At Level 2, the ability feels like a nice lullaby and is effective at putting tired children to sleep.

School District 13 is located in the southwest of Academy City. Its primary purpose is catering to kindergartens and elementary schools.

Despite other districts being capable of handling kindergartens, School District 13 has the most kindergartens and elementary schools out of all the districts in the city. There are also many facilities and orphanages for Child Errors in the district.

A lot of security personnel besides Anti-Skill are provided in School District 13 in order to safeguard and protect the children living there. The district is used by Academy City for its public image, featuring in the city's brochures and pamphlets.

Azumi has the appearance of a young elementary school girl, with black hair tied up in pigtails and glasses. She is in the same class as Fremea Seivelun and is referred to as their class's intellectual girl.

Azumi shows a strong sense of curiosity, taking the initiative to research things she and her classmates are unsure about, such as the existence of Santa Claus. At the same time, she displays hesitation and uncertainty when questioning others. 

Azumi is close friends with Fremea and the two are often seen together, whether debating the reality of Santa Claus, getting caught up in the city's heatwave and evacuation, or making a fuss over a supposed Santa-catching kit. Through their interactions, Azumi's logical skepticism is contrasted with Fremea's sense of childish wonder, though Azumi also demonstrates concern for her friend.

The Academy City military relies heavily on its technological superiority and advanced Hs-series equipment, said to be 30 years ahead of the rest of the world. Many of its military vehicles and weapons have Hs designations.

A key aspect is the use of AI-controlled and remote operated units, ranging from powered suits, tanks, attack helicopters, fighters and bombers. Academy City's military technology is described as operating on completely different principles compared to conventional militaries.

The autonomous units share the same firmware and operating system as civilian technology like phones. While efficient, this also introduces potential vulnerabilities.

Alice Anotherbible appears as a 12-year old girl with white skin, long blonde hair, and sapphire blue eyes. She has pointy curls in her hair resembling animal ears. Alice wears a blue dress with a white apron, the apron having a round white fluff on the back resembling a rabbit tail. She also wears white tights and black mary-jane shoes.

Alice has been described as bored, speaking in absurdities and indecipherable nonsense. While pure and innocent, she is also capricious, cruel and prone to violence if angered. Her fellow Transcendents cater to her whims out of both necessity and fear.

As a Transcendent, Alice is powerful enough to rival the Magic Side on her own and stands above even her peers. Her unique magic, Live Adventures in Wonderland, allows her to affect the entire world by linking together different ideas and laws to create bridges and new paths, even if the connections are flawed. She can manifest various entities and "wonders" from the Alice stories, either automatically as psychological defense or by choice.

Spiritual Items are special tools used by magicians to assist in the use of magic. When performing precise spells and ceremonies, magicians will often employ tools corresponding to the symbols and requirements of that particular magic. Using an item closely matching the intended legendary artifact makes the magic more efficient and effective.

When held by a magician, a spiritual item becomes part of their body, with magic power circulating through it. In the past, destroying the item would sever this circulation and harm the magician, but modern ones have safety devices to prevent this.

Symbolic Weapons are a representative type of spiritual item. These are produced, consecrated and exclusively used by a single magician to ensure the magic power circulation is pristine and uninterrupted by others' interference.

The Walking Church is a magical defensive tool worn by members of the Anglican Church. Its appearance varies, with the most notable example being the pure white robe with golden embroidery and a nun cap worn by Index. Himegami Aisa's Walking Church takes the form of a silver Celtic cross necklace that appears to float.

Based on Idol Theory, the Walking Church symbolically takes the essential protective elements of a church building and bestows them upon the wearer. Index's Walking Church replicates the Holy Shroud of Turin and has Pope-class defensive power, rendering it as strong as a nuclear bomb shelter, able to absorb most magical and physical attacks.

Himegami Aisa's Walking Church functions to seal her ability to attract vampires. Other members of the Church like Stiyl Magnus, Kanzaki Kaori and Tsuchimikado Motoharu are said to own their own Walking Churches, each likely with unique properties.

School Garden is an area located in the southern end of Academy City's School District 7. It is similar to other areas in the district, being composed of schools and establishments like shops and restaurants, but is unique in that it consists of five elite schools for girls and similarly high-class establishments catering to their students.

The area has a distinct aesthetic, with reddish cobblestone roads in strange tessellated designs, brick and mortar buildings with varying roof types and decorative elements, metal lamps, baroque architecture, and narrow roads prioritizing aesthetics over practicality. Access is restricted, with students possessing ID cards and guests needing permission. Males are prohibited from entering.

School Garden is jointly controlled by the five schools, with the area divided into their respective territories and gray areas known as "Lost Pieces" being a source of tension. The schools use cutting-edge technology not allowed outside and have the facilities and budget to protect it. Hierarchy in School Garden is based on ability rather than the typical Japanese seniority system.

Tsuchimikado Maika has short blue-black hair barely reaching her shoulders and is usually seen wearing her maid school uniform, as she is training to become a maid. She is proud of the fact that she only ever wears her maid outfit. Maika is often seen riding on cleaning robots.

Maika is kind, willing to go to great lengths to help others, even giving up a top ranking spot. She greatly cares for her stepbrother Motoharu, often performing "almost girlfriend" services for him like cooking, cleaning and massages. She refers to others as "Onii-chan" or "Onee-chan", showing her casual and friendly nature.

Maika is an expert cook, able to quickly determine the ingredients and process behind high-class dishes. While an orphan, Maika was adopted by Motoharu to help maintain his cover in Academy City, but their sibling bond grew to be genuine. She accompanies him in his escape from Academy City, even after a curse strikes her.

Anti-Skill is the primary police and security force in Academy City, made up of adult volunteers and teachers rather than students. They are called in to handle major threats and situations beyond the ability of the student-based Judgment, such as terrorist attacks, hostage situations, and rogue espers. Anti-Skill also assists Judgment with community service tasks.

Anti-Skill members undergo training in combat tactics, firearms usage, and first aid. They have access to protective equipment like armored uniforms and riot shields to defend against esper abilities. Their armory includes vehicles like armored trucks and high-speed "supercars", as well as various firearms and other experimental weapons for heavy threats.

The organization has a presence in all School Districts and acts as Academy City's primary military force in major conflicts. They have dedicated squads like Anti-Skill Aggressors for high-risk operations, and have authority extending outside the city's borders. However, their effectiveness can sometimes be limited by a separation from Academy City's Dark Side.

Judgment is a student-based disciplinary committee and volunteer law enforcement organization in Academy City. Working alongside Anti-Skill, Judgment members help to maintain peace and order, with a focus on policing school grounds and minor offenses compared to Anti-Skill handling major threats. There are at least 177 branches throughout the city.

Students of varying ages and esper abilities can join Judgment after passing exams and training. Younger members are partnered with seniors for patrols, with their authority usually limited to their school district. They can arrest offenders and assist Anti-Skill. Judgment and Anti-Skill also monitor each other to prevent corruption.

Judgment members wear armbands with their symbol and have protective equipment like riot shields. They are trained in first aid, crime scene analysis, and combat, though they do not carry firearms like Anti-Skill. They operate out of branch offices, usually located in or near schools, and undergo training in specialized facilities.

Multi Active Rescue (MAR) is an emergency response organization based in Academy City. Their primary duties are to prevent civilian involvement in dangerous situations, rescue victims, and control the escalation of casualties in high-risk scenarios. They often work together with Anti-Skill during large-scale emergencies.

MAR was formerly led by Therestina Kihara Lifeline, who served as both the captain and head of research. The organization is divided into units with designated leaders for different tasks, allowing them to perform multiple operations simultaneously and coordinate effectively.

MAR members are trained in piloting mechanical mobile suits, firearms usage, and first aid. They utilize various equipment such as rifles, grenade launchers, and heavily armored vehicles for transporting units. MAR is most recognizable for their use of the Large Weapon, a bipedal armored unit used for high-risk situations and heavy lifting.

Hound Dog is an elite black operations unit that takes orders directly from Aleister Crowley, under the command of Kihara Amata. Unlike Anti-Skill, they covertly perform operations that are considered against regular military conduct and laws.

Members of the unit are well-trained in weapons handling, quick and efficient tactics, and relentless tracking using their superior olfactory sensor technology. They work in small squads with a leader during missions and swiftly remove any traces of their presence afterwards.

Hound Dog members wear distinct black armor, helmets with face masks, and goggles to conceal their identities. They are referred to as scum without human rights, easily replaceable during missions, and are often punished severely for failure by Kihara Amata, whom they fear. The unit also employs acid spray to remove evidence like fingerprints and DNA.

Therestina has wavy orange hair usually tied in a ponytail, wears glasses, and is described as having a glamorous figure. Her office attire consists of a dark-colored coat, pencil skirt, light brown stockings and white high heels.

Initially, Therestina exudes an air of elegance, authority, and friendliness, with some childish quirks like her fondness for candy and toys. However, this is a facade masking her true cold, manipulative and unstable nature, willing to use others as pawns for her goals. When things go her way, she breaks down into hysterical laughter.

As a child, Therestina was experimented on by her grandfather as the first test subject for the Crystallized Esper Essence. Despite previously being an esper herself, Therestina's power level is theorized to be reduced to Level 0 as an adult. She is a skilled hand-to-hand fighter, powered suit pilot, and possesses keen intelligence, having fooled authorities with her facade.

Disciplinary Action (DA) is a rogue group within Anti-Skill, consisting of former members who faced punishment for excessive force and brutality. Officially they are a cooperative organization like a police union, but in reality they are a secret society that uses any means to carry out their idea of "justice".

DA has many influential sympathizers providing them with information, funding and advanced technology, enabling them to boast of being able to oppose the Board of Directors. However, their zealotry and extreme methods can turn supporters against them. Members are fiercely devoted to their cause, willing to kill their own for cowardice.

DA utilizes special equipment like chameleon camouflage, armored Powered Suits, grenade launchers, tasers, acoustic weapons, and the Coffins. They have their own transports but also use stolen Anti-Skill vehicles. Breeder and hound breed-based codenames are used in communications to conceal identities.

Aero Hand is an esper ability that enables the user to create ejection points for air on objects they touch, allowing them to propel those objects if they are a high enough Level. Multiple ejection points can be made at once, with a delay before activation that varies by user. The ejection points can still release blasts of air even if the object cannot be propelled.

A Level 4 Aero Hand user like Kongou Mitsuko can propel trucks, Powered Suits, walls and parabolic antennas through the air. When Saten Ruiko briefly gained the power through Level Upper, she could levitate leaves around her palms.

The only known variant of Aero Hand is Volcanic Ball, which compresses, accelerates and strengthens air currents into a sphere in the user's hands.

Yumi has long dark hair tied with a ribbon resembling rabbit ears and wears a sleeveless shirt exposing her undergarments and hot pants with a studded belt. She has a bubbly personality and quickly befriends Last Order, though tends to be handsy with her. 

Yumi manifested the Volcanic Ball esper power at the same time as her twin sister Mami. Her ability allows her to enclose air currents into a sphere, compress and strengthen them before releasing it, which she can use to propel herself or create a shield. However, overuse makes her ill. She is also skilled at redirecting already compressed air.

Aside from her power, Yumi has strong physical endurance and fighting ability. She is a good cook and dreams of owning a restaurant to make children happy with her food. As a Judgment member, she has a strong sense of justice.

Mami is Yumi's younger twin, with long red hair, a yellow ribbon, an eyepatch covering a missing eye, and wearing a dark hoodie with no pants. She is more vicious than her sister, taking down several Anti-Skill before confronting Yumi.

Like Yumi, Mami manifested the Volcanic Ball ability simultaneously. However, an unknown disease and implied abnormal upbringing allowed Mami to train her power to be more offensive and potent, keeping it active longer. She can use compressed air like a cannon and further propel a 2000m/s air current into a powerful drill.

Despite her nature, Mami was friends with Himegi Matsuri and wanted her to escape the city. But this came at the cost of Mami becoming "altered" and a member of the group Full Course.

Kongou has long black hair with two prominent fringes flanking her forehead, an attractive figure she flaunts in revealing swimwear, and is usually seen with a fan. As an ojou-sama type, she is proud and has a lofty attitude, often at odds with Shirai Kuroko. She embellishes the truth for her convenience until she can no longer maintain the facade.

Despite this, Kongou is kind, looks out for friends, helps those in need, and comes to her rival Misaka Mikoto's aid. She is also an aspiring swimsuit model and very open about her sexuality and body. After enrolling in Tokiwadai, her haughty persona becomes more mellow.

As a Level 4 Aero Hand user, Kongou can create up to 8,092 ejection points on objects or the ground by touching them, propelling them with powerful gusts of wind. She can control the timing of the activation and launch trucks, walls and satellite dishes.

The Disciplinary Guides were an urban legend themselves in Academy City, said to bestow 'Guidance' on those who irresponsibly spread other urban legends. While users under the name posted threatening comments online, there was little reliable information on the group's actual members, abilities or even numbers, with authorities initially dismissing the threats due to lack of evidence of assaults. 

The group consisted of five members, with the only one identified by name being the apparent leader, Noriko. The members all wore light blue hoodies to conceal their identities. Each utilized different weapons or esper abilities, including Noriko as a bare-handed fighter, one with a wind-based ability, one throwing Molotov cocktails, one wielding a metal bat, and one using an electric stun baton.

Noriko was the leader of the Disciplinary Guides, a vigilante group in Academy City that attacked people spreading urban legends online. Like the other members, she wore a light blue hoodie to conceal her identity. Noriko had long dark colored hair.

As the leader, Noriko was presumably the core of the group's activities in 'guiding' rumor spreaders. She was skilled enough in martial arts and bare-handed fighting to easily take down opponents.

A Gemstone is an esper who gained their ability without the use of artificial methods like Academy City's Power Curriculum Program. Gemstones are considered very rare, with only around 50 estimated to exist in the world. The phenomena they produce are more difficult to analyze than artificial espers and they emit much higher amounts of AIM energy.

Academy City's theory is that if artificial espers are like synthetic diamonds, Gemstones are the natural equivalent - a natural phenomenon occurring under the same circumstances as artificially induced ones without human intervention. However, the idea of abilities without the Curriculum is scorned by most in the city, with exceptions like Mifune Chizuko who predated the system.

Gemstones are considered extremely valuable research material, as understanding how their abilities formed naturally could allow other organizations to develop their own espers. Both the USA and Russia pursued Gemstone research during the Cold War era and are believed to still have an interest in acquiring them.

The Gemstone Girl has an unusually beautiful appearance, with long blonde hair, blue eyes, and a gorgeous face and figure. Her most distinctive feature is that she walks around with a suitcase handcuffed to her right wrist. She wears a very revealing one-piece dress described as barely counting as clothing. Based on her youthful looks, she is estimated to be in her late teens.

In terms of personality, she is very taciturn and only speaks when necessary. She shows concern for bystanders and people caught up in her affairs, not wanting to hurt them. The girl forms an attachment to Kamijou Touya after meeting him.

While the exact nature of the Gemstone Girl's esper ability is unknown, it seems to be sound-based. She once used an amazing noise to knock down an entire group of men in one blow.

Iori Mashiro is a clique leader and candidate in Tokiwadai Middle School's student council election. As a Tokiwadai student, she wears the standard school uniform.

Iori has medium length pink hair styled in ringlet curls at the back. She greatly dislikes Shokuhou Misaki, resenting her growth in both body and clique, and favors a quick and violent approach to dealing with her rivals.

Iori's esper ability allows her to remotely control water balls, both many small ones and larger single ones. The water balls are speculated to be 0.9% saline as a necessary part of her power. As a Tokiwadai student, her ability level is likely 3 or 4.

The Relic refers to a pair of cube-shaped objects connected to a mysterious past Level 5 esper in Academy City. The Relic Level 5's ability is known as Synthesize Grid or Absolute Leaf, allowing control of the Starting Crystal at the base of all crystals to transform and control all matter in an area.

At the time of Tokiwadai's student council election, one Relic was in the possession of candidate Kokuchou Mayui, while the other made contact with Kouzaku Mitori. The Relics are capable of manipulating their holders, drawing upon powers like freezing through nanometal particles and producing Shadow Metal from consumed esper powers. 

The will and memories of the former Level 5 are split between the two Relics, with one seeking revenge on Academy City and the other aiming to stop its counterpart. A group known as □□ is connected to the Relics and the "previous generation", seeking to create a new vessel for the Level 5.

Multi-Skill is an ability that allows the user to wield multiple esper powers at once, derived from a connection to the Level Upper network created by Kiyama Harumi. By matching their brainwaves to Harumi's, espers in the network can share processing power to boost their abilities.

As the creator and administrator of the Level Upper network, Harumi can borrow the abilities of all the espers connected to it, using multiple powers simultaneously. A visible sign of Multi-Skill being used is the user's eyes turning red with yellow irises.

Multi-Skill has been used by Harumi and Kihara Gensei. It differs from the theoretical Dual Skill in that it relies on a network of esper minds rather than a single esper's Personal Reality. The AIM Burst created from the collapse of the Level Upper network also demonstrated use of Multi-Skill along with a regenerative ability.

Kihara Gensei is an elderly scientist and prominent member of the infamous Kihara family known for their unethical experiments. He has a hunched posture, a notable birthmark on his right temple, and keeps his eyes closed most of the time. Due to his dangerous research, much of his body has been replaced with mechanical prosthetics, making him a cyborg.

Gensei is utterly amoral in his pursuit of scientific advancement, especially in creating a Level 6 esper, and has no qualms about performing deadly human experiments. His analytical mind and experience in Academy City's Dark Side makes him very perceptive of deception.

Gensei's esper ability is called Comeback Detection, which allows him to predict when an opponent still has a trump card to play based on his experience. He has also used the Level Upper system to gain use of multiple esper abilities through the Multi-Skill power.

Hishigata Mikihiko is a neuroscientist who worked with the rogue Anti-Skill group DA while actually using them for his own ends. He has messy blond hair, bored-looking eyes, and is often seen with a lollipop in his mouth. Hishigata wears a labcoat over a turtleneck sweatshirt.

He is willing to use corpses and live humans for his research into achieving the perfect mind and body to create a Level 6 esper. Hishigata will slaughter subordinates for failure, but is wise enough not take on challenges he lacks time for. Despite this, he deeply loves his sister Hirumi, conducting his experiments for her sake and even shielding her from a fatal attack at the cost of his own life.

Hishigata has knowledge of Rosenthal-style necromancy learned from Esther, allowing him to reanimate corpses. He created the Coffins using this in combination with his research into how esper powers reside in bodies, though he cannot be called a full necromancer himself.

Coffins are mobile weapons housing a deceased esper, allowing their ability to be used at a greatly enhanced level through a combination of technology, esper powers, and magic. They were created by Hishigata Mikihiko and planned to be used by DA.

Coffins use corpses reanimated through Rosenthal necromancy, with machines they recognize as part of their body to boost the esper ability. They follow the commands of their controllers but have some autonomy. All known Coffins display an ability output roughly two levels above the esper's original level.

The Prototype uses the Level 2 Pyrokinesis of Hitokawa Hasami at Level 4. Qiong Qi, Taotie, and Hundun each use an Evil Spirit charm, a Level 3 esper, and a different ability at Level 5. Qiong Qi has powerful Psychokinesis for offense and defense. Taotie uses Replace teleportation to swap marked targets. Hundun has Stealth Hide for concealment. All three can be further enhanced with a special formula.

Hishigata Hirumi is the younger sister of Hishigata Mikihiko, associated with the group DA that they were actually just using for their own ends in pursuit of the perfect mind and body. She has long hair worn in twin-tails.

Hirumi was originally a normal high school girl who became friends with Esther Rosenthal, who had been tricked into supervising Hishigata's research. After Hirumi died, Esther resurrected her, but she ended up possessed by the evil spirit Taowu. 

In her first appearance, Hirumi had little on and was connected to many wires and pipes. While alive, she wore the uniform of Seiin High School. She has very few lines of dialogue, only briefly speaking as herself near the end.

Scavenger is a mercenary organization operating in the dark side of Academy City. The group consists of three esper girls - Iizumi Rita (Leader), Sakuragi Naruha (Naru), and Yakumaru Itsuki (Yakumaru) - and one boy, Seike Taroumaru, who has an effeminate appearance. They work as a clean up and disposal group for the Academy City Board of Directors.

The members of Scavenger have no regard for human life and are willing to kill anyone who gets in their way, even allies like Anti-Skill. They share an irrational hatred for teachers and educators, seeing them as the source of the city's problems. The only exception is Seike, who just pretends to agree with their views. 

Scavenger operatives are kept in stasis pods when not on missions, only being awakened by their liaison when they have a job. While in stasis, they wear specialized stitched bodysuits. The group is powerful enough to level entire buildings on their own.

The Scavenger Liaison is an unnamed woman who acts as a handler and intermediary for the Scavenger mercenary group, similar to the liaisons of other dark side organizations in Academy City. She has long hair with an exposed forehead, a mole below her lip on the left, and wears oval glasses. Her typical outfit consists of large hoop earrings, a black dress shirt, white lab coat, khaki pencil skirt, white pumps and dark hosiery.

Despite her authority over Scavenger, the liaison is willing to negotiate terms and sort out issues with the team, even if it means putting them at a disadvantage while framing it as a mutual sacrifice. She has a habit of twisting the cord of her communication device, which resembles a telephone earpiece, while conversing.

Yakumaru Itsuki, known as Ya-kun or Yakkun to her comrades, is a member of the Scavenger mercenary group. She wears a loose square neck blouse, black spats, and a utility belt for her vials of chemicals. Yakumaru hides her long brown hair and attractive looks under a large newsboy cap. 

Like the other Scavengers, Yakumaru has no guilt about killing and shares their hatred of teachers. However, she's slightly more serious than Naru. As a long-time teammate of Leader, Yakumaru can pick up on her intentions without needing to be told.

Yakumaru's esper ability, Mix Master, lets her separate liquids by manipulating their specific gravity, then mix them to produce various phenomena. She carries an array of chemicals ranging from rapid freezing coolant to liquid thermite. Outside of her ability, Yakumaru is a skilled actress, able to feign vulnerability to manipulate others.

Sakuragi Naruha, known as Naru to her comrades, is a Level 3 esper and member of the Scavenger mercenary group. She has shoulder-length purple hair with a skull tattoo under her left eye. Naru wears a revealing outfit resembling a maid and bunny girl costume, made entirely out of paper through her ability. 

Naru is one of the most childish members of Scavenger. Like the others, she has no problems with killing and destruction, and hates teachers. She displays no concern with exposing her body, with her paper armor often leaving little to the imagination, but isn't an exhibitionist. Naru enjoys art museums, especially three-dimensional exhibits.

Her esper power, Perfect Paper, is a variant of psychokinesis that lets her freely manipulate paper into forms like explosives, armor, shields, and even complex vehicles. The paper's properties change to be as flexible as cloth or as strong as hardened alloy. Combined with her close combat skills, Naru fights at a Level 4 capacity despite her rank.

Seike Taroumaru, known as just Seike to his teammates, is the lone male member of Scavenger. He has an androgynous appearance, with long black hair and a bored look in his eyes, and convincingly passes as a girl in his sailor school uniform. On his tongue is a stylized tattoo of a skull with horns and chains.

Compared to his teammates, Seike is much more low-key and speaks little, though he still displays a mischievous side. Like them, he has no problems with killing. However, Seike doesn't actually share their hatred of teachers, only pretending to agree to maintain group harmony.

Seike's esper ability, Stick Slip, allows him to control frictional coefficients within a meter of his body. At maximum air friction, he can melt bullets and stop a 120-ton mecha, with the effects lasting several seconds after he stops touching the target. Seike can also remove friction to launch himself at high speeds using a magnum's recoil. His ability has a three-minute time limit.

Battle Armor, also referred to as Bunny Armor, is a special "powered suit" constructed by Sakuragi Naruha out of paper using her Perfect Paper ability. It has the appearance of a playboy bunny outfit, with rabbit ears on the helmet.

The armor considerably enhances Naru's physical strength, allowing her to smash Hitokawa Hasami's earth armor with a hammer and send Yomikawa Aiho flying with a single punch, breaking her shield in the process. 

As it is made of Naru's paper, the Battle Armor can be quickly repaired and restored if damaged, making it difficult for enemies to permanently destroy. Naru can reshape it into other forms like an excavator arm to increase its power.

The L-type Lab Equipment was a predecessor machine to the Coffins which appeared in the A Certain Scientific Accelerator anime adaptation.

It had four legs and a suspended main body, with a red container on one side for storing test subjects. The machine acted as a life support system during experiments on the effect of organ shutdown on esper abilities.

During this research, it was observed that the larger the machine serving as the subject's body, the greater their power output became. However, this increase in size had a negative effect on the subject's sense of self, leaving many of them in a broken state.

The Tarantula is a heavy six-legged mobile weapon used by DA. It is equipped with a String Juicer disc that can be launched as a spinning projectile.

During the battle between DA and Anti-Skill, a Tarantula was deployed to attack the enemy forces. However, it was intercepted by Scavenger mercenaries Seike and Leader who had been sent to eliminate DA.

Seike used his Stick Slip ability to immobilize the Tarantula by maximizing the air friction around it, melting the String Juicer disc and preventing the machine from moving. The Tarantula's pilot, realizing that Scavenger were Nakimoto's "cleaners", was forced to abandon the disabled vehicle and flee.

Etzali is a magician from the Aztec organization Return of the Winged One. He can take on the appearance of others by using a charm made from their flayed skin. His usual disguise is that of Unabara Mitsuki, a boy with black hair, but his true form has wavy black hair and dark skin.

Originally loyal to his cabal, Etzali defected to Academy City after falling in love with Misaka Mikoto while observing her. He is driven to accomplish his goals and willing to kill to maintain his disguises, but has a hidden heart of gold. His conflicted feelings eventually lead him to join the dark side group known as GROUP in order to protect Mikoto from the shadows.

Etzali's magic allows him to use the replica Spear of Tlahuizcalpantecuhtli, an obsidian dagger which destroys targets by reflecting the light of Venus. He has also acquired two Aztec grimoires derived from the Calendar Stone, one which turns any weapon against its wielder and one which shoots powerful bone bullets.

Return of the Winged One is the largest magic cabal in Central and South America, using Aztec techniques and rituals as the basis for their magic. This includes using flayed human skin for disguise charms, obsidian and wooden weapons, and grimoires based on the Aztec calendar.

The cabal was once led by a Council of Elders, but this was overthrown by Tecpatl, the head of military affairs. Under his leadership, the organization began to arm its members with mass-produced original grimoires as weapons. 

Key members include Tecpatl, Etzali, Xochitl and Tochtli. The cabal has been involved in conflicts with the American military and Academy City organizations. Leadership after Tecpatl's death is unknown, as Etzali, the intended successor, has shown no signs of returning.

Tecpatl was the leader of the Aztec magic cabal Return of the Winged One after overthrowing its Council of Elders. He is a brown-skinned man between 25-30 years old. As head of the organization's military affairs, he is knowledgeable about its magic but ruthless in its application.

Tecpatl spearheaded the mass production and distribution of original grimoires to the cabal's soldiers along with measures to protect the wielders from the books' knowledge. He took the maimed Tochtli captive to use her bones as material for his own grimoire's attacks.

Using his Moon Rabbit grimoire, Tecpatl could fire powerful bone projectiles for long range destruction. He challenged Etzali to a duel for leadership of the cabal, but was killed by his own grimoire when Etzali exploited its tendency to help those who spread knowledge of its contents.

Tochtli is a brown-skinned 15-year old magician girl belonging to the Return of the Winged One magic cabal. She is often seen partnered with fellow member Xochitl.

After disobeying some orders during a conflict, Tochtli was punished by having her ability to think and speak removed. She was later taken captive by Tecpatl, who used her bones to power his grimoire, replacing them with obsidian in a painful process until less than half remained.

Tochtli was eventually rescued by Etzali after he defeated Tecpatl. During her recovery alongside Xochitl, she enjoyed teasing the two about their relationship, calling Etzali "onii-chan" to Xochitl's chagrin despite a lack of real affection.

Xochitl, known as the Corpse Worker, is a young Aztec magician girl with shoulder-length curly black hair and brown skin. She normally wears a red sailor uniform but can disguise herself as an Asian girl. Her magic originally involved retrieving the wills of the dead.

Originally a gentle girl hesitant to harm others due to her role dealing with corpses, Xochitl's personality changed after she disobeyed orders and was punished by being fused with a grimoire, replacing two-thirds of her body. Under its influence, she pursued her former senior Etzali to kill him for betrayal. 

The fusion made Xochitl a living weapon, able to dry her flesh into a powder to control objects it touches. She wields a traditional Aztec wooden sword called a macuahuitl. Xochitl was saved by Etzali and restored with artificial parts, ending up hospitalized and watched as leverage over him.

entries.content:
The Mixcoatl is a special wooden aircraft used by the Return of the Winged One magic cabal, named after the Aztec god of the hunt. It has an aerodynamic front section made of wood and obsidian, with a long tail covered in feathers extending behind it.

Mixcoatls are extremely fast, able to fly at up to Mach 1 speeds. Combined with their unorthodox construction, this makes them very difficult to detect and intercept compared to conventional aircraft.

Xochitl's partner Tochtli is capable of piloting a Mixcoatl, using it to retrieve Xochitl when she was stranded in the American facility Liberal Arts City after a sabotage operation against the Aztec magic cabal's enemies there.

The Xiuhcoatl is the ultimate weapon of the Return of the Winged One magic cabal, named after the mythical Aztec serpent of fire. It is a massive flying vessel over a hundred meters long, built from wood, cloth and obsidian like the smaller Mixcoatl aircraft.

The Xiuhcoatl's true form is that of an ancient magical Aztec satellite designed to preserve the Sun. In this function, it can gather solar energy and unleash it in devastating attacks, raining down kilometer-wide blasts that scorch everything in the target area.

Several Xiuhcoatl are known to exist, with a number of them being deployed along with Mixcoatl craft by the Return of the Winged One during their attack on the American facility Liberal Arts City.

The Rosenthal Family is a line of necromancers who have sought to create the perfect golem for over 400 years. Their techniques, referred to as Rosenthal-style Necromancy, involves placing artificial souls into corpses to animate them. This unorthodox method was developed by their ancestor Obed from Kabbalistic golem creation, and further refined by later generations with the incorporation of Taoist practices.

The Rosenthals' greatest desire is to create a golem with a perfect soul and body - essentially a god. Successors are raised and trained to pursue this singular goal, developing the family's magic as they do so. Among the Rosenthals' creations are the powerful Evil Spirits artificial souls and tools like Emperor Shun's Blade to control them.

The current head, Esther Rosenthal, abandoned this long-held desire after tragically losing her friend twice to the family's practices. She now seeks to prevent others from similarly toying with life and death using their necromancy techniques.

Obed Rosenthal, usually just referred to as Obed, was the founder of the Rosenthal Family over 400 years ago. He had curly black hair, an exposed forehead, a goatee, and wore light-colored robes.

Having tested various methods, Obed devised a heretical technique of creating golems by inserting artificial souls into corpses, allowing the use of a human brain to create more intelligent servants. Condemned by his homeland's religious authorities, Obed was exiled.

Ending up in the East, Obed and his descendants would continue to pursue the Rosenthal goal of creating the perfect golem. While the exact details of his capabilities are unknown, Obed specialized in Kabbalistic golem creation and his unorthodox method would serve as the foundation for the Rosenthal Family's necromantic practices.

Isaac Rosenthal, usually just called Isaac, was the 4th generation head of the Rosenthal Family. In his original body he had light hair and wore non-Chinese clothes and a turban. His soul was later implanted into the artificial soul Taowu.

Dedicated to the family's goal of creating the perfect golem, Isaac had little regard for human life, murdering many to use their corpses. He took pride in his creations, becoming angered when they were compared to mere jiangshi. In China, he developed Rosenthal-style Necromancy by combining their Kabbalah techniques with Taoist practices like the Hopping Zombie Spell.

When Isaac was dying of disease, his soul was transferred into Taowu by his son Nathan. Centuries later, it manipulated Hishigata Mikihiko and DA through the possessed Hishigata Hirumi in an attempt to artificially create a perfect soul, before being exorcised by Esther Rosenthal.

Nathan Rosenthal, typically just Nathan, was the 5th generation head of the Rosenthal Family. He had long dark hair covering his right eye and wore Chinese-style robes with a light inner layer.

While not much is known about his personality, Nathan advanced the family's necromantic practices as they continued to pursue the creation of the perfect golem. He created four powerful artificial souls bearing the names of mythical Chinese creatures, the Evil Spirits of the Numbers - Taowu, Hundun, Qiong Qi and Taotie.

When his predecessor Isaac was on his deathbed, Nathan transferred the 4th head's soul into Taowu before it could be lost, imprinting it onto the artificial soul. The Rosenthal style would continue to develop under the subsequent 19 generations but their ultimate goal remained out of reach.

Esther Rosenthal is a well-endowed young woman with long blonde hair, green eyes, and a mole under her left eye. She wears a revealing sleeveless white blouse with an open back, red skirt, black cloak, thigh-high socks, and bandages on her forearms. Two black ribbons adorn her hair.

As the 23rd head of the Rosenthal Family, Esther is well-versed in their necromantic arts but is kind and respectful to both the living and the dead. However, after twice losing her dear friend Hirumi to the family's practices, she has abandoned their long-held desire to create a perfect golem, realizing they should not toy with life and death.

Esther's necromancy focuses on implanting artificial souls like Huotou into corpses to control them. She also uses paper charms for various spells and can summon the Armor of the Dead to protect her reanimated servants. The dagger Emperor Shun's Blade acts as a failsafe against artificial souls.

A golem is an animated anthropomorphic being created from inanimate matter, most commonly clay or mud. In mystical and philosophical terms, it is an attempt by humans to imitate God's creation of Adam from dust.

According to Kabbalic lore, the first golems were made in the 16th century for protection and the removal of threats. However, they cannot speak, only making sounds from the movement of their material, and have a failsafe where their creator can return them to inanimate components. They are seen as imperfect replicas of how God made humans.

Various golems appear in the series, most prominently those made by Sherry Cromwell, which combine Kabbalic and Christian practices and can be made from materials like concrete and metal, and the ice golems created by magic ships. The Rosenthal Family have long pursued the creation of a 'perfect golem' akin to a god.

A Miracle is a mysterious and powerful phenomenon that can cause normally impossible events to occur, overturning causality. They manifest as colorful auras surrounding the area they take place in.

When Shutaura Sequenzia wished for a miracle to ensure the safety of a spaceplane, even at the cost of what she held dear, her desire created a distortion that split her existence in two and formed Meigo Arisa. Arisa's presence alone can induce further miracles in dire situations.

Miracles are a power distinct from both magic and science, and cannot be negated by Kamijou Touma's Imagine Breaker. Aleister Crowley has theorized that they result from a person's wish changing their perception to such an extent that it distorts reality when combined with the wishes of others.

The Black Crow Unit is a private security organization in Academy City under the control of Ladylee Tangleroad. While officially meant to preserve order, they primarily act for Ladylee's own purposes. The group is named for the beak-like front of their mobile weapons.

Members are called Crows, with Shutaura Sequenzia as their Crow Leader or Captain. They wear form-fitting bodysuits and are fiercely loyal to Shutaura's ideals of protecting the city, continuing to follow her even when ordered against her.

Black Crow mobile weapons are high-speed and agile, able to drive on walls and jump, with Shutaura's being the most advanced. They have optical camouflage for stealth and are resistant to heat and impact. The unit's large quadrupedal mobile weapon has heavy armor and powerful guns. Their teamwork is based around Shutaura's Earth Palette esper ability.

The Russian Orthodox Church is one of the largest branches of Christianity, claiming descent from the original church via Apostolic Succession. It is the main religion in Russia and uses the three-barred cross as its symbol.

The Church is relentless in identifying and eliminating supernatural entities that fall outside Christian doctrine, such as ghosts, will-o-wisps and other spirits. They have even established facilities like the Phenomena Control and Reduction Reproduction for this purpose.

The head of the Russian Orthodox Church is the Patriarch, but the position is largely a figurehead, with the organization's true leadership unclear. Annihilatus, a secret branch of the Church, deals with magical threats.

Krans R. Tsarskiy is the current Patriarch of the Russian Orthodox Church. Despite being only around 15 years old and about 145 cm tall, his childish appearance belies his keen diplomatic and political skills. He has an effeminate, slender build and wears the majestic robes of the Patriarch, looking more like a child playing dress-up than a religious leader.

Krans' personality combines the charisma and intellect needed for his role with occasional childish qualities. As Patriarch, he imprisoned and targeted for assassination by the ambitious Bishop Nikolai Tolstoy during World War III. After being rescued, Krans worked to end the conflict and punish those responsible.

As a magician, Krans can use the powerful Seven Deadly Sins spell, which allows him to debilitate a target by forcing them to bear the weight of the sins he judges them to have committed. However, this spell can backfire if the target turns Krans' judgement back upon him.

Nikolai Tolstoy was a Bishop in the Russian Orthodox Church with a voice befitting a man in his prime. Driven by personal ambition, he believed his success was synonymous with the Church and Russia's benefit, a view born from his ego and habit of underestimating others. Nikolai saw subordinates as disposable pawns for his goals.

During World War III, Nikolai imprisoned the Patriarch Krans and faked his signature to help start the war, intending to become the next Patriarch by having Krans assassinated. He worked with the Roman Catholic Fiamma of the Right to capture Sasha Kreutzev and used his position to displace people in preparation for Fiamma's Star of Bethlehem.

When confronted by Vasilisa, Nikolai attacked using his Water of Death spiritual item, a deadly liquid that rapidly disintegrates whatever it touches. However, it proved ineffective against Vasilisa's Water of Life and Nikolai was killed shortly after she revealed his plot.

Saronia A. Irivika is a 14-year-old Russian magician formerly aligned with the Russian Orthodox Church before defecting to the magic cabal Gremlin. She has blonde hair worn at shoulder length, blue eyes, and wears a distinctive green turtleneck, miniskirt, hairband, and thigh-high brown boots.

Ruthless and manipulative, Saronia has no qualms in controlling others, even children, to achieve her goals. She joined Gremlin in order to force Russia to continue its war against Academy City and its allies as revenge for the country's devastation in World War III. Saronia refers to herself as an indoor-type, contrasting with her forest-based magic.

Saronia's ability is derived from the woodland spirit Leshy. By using a special core plant, she can turn a territory into her "forest" and control those inside through group psychology, punishing outsiders who make contact with elements of her domain. She is also a skilled martial artist specializing in kicks to bypass Touma's Imagine Breaker.

Brassa P. Marhaisk is a male magician and member of the Russian Orthodox Church.

During World War III, Brassa was one of the Russian magicians operating a prisoner transport caravan pulled by the eight-legged horse Sleipnir. He and his comrades became unnerved by the nearby flight of Academy City's HsB-02 planes, as the magicians were unable to match their speed due to an anti-flight spell and knew of the planes' deadly bombing capabilities.

When extreme heat seared part of the surrounding terrain, Brassa realized an attack was imminent. Fearing the caravan would be targeted, he and the other magicians abandoned their posts and prisoners, fleeing to safety.

Caliche I. Niknosh is a female Russian magician and former member of the Russian Orthodox Church. According to Lessar's deductions, she may be a failed Church member using a false name.

Caliche's group was hired through a Russian Academy City cooperative institution to observe the effects of Code EIC on people's minds from an occult perspective, in exchange for using the results themselves. When the higher-ups failed to deliver on their promise, Caliche decapitated them, leaving swords on the neck stumps.

As a magician, Caliche uses the Ex Voto method to request miracles from religious figures, offering parchment with prayers written in holy oil as payment. This allows her to create flying ice knives and rotating guillotine blades. In battle, she was able to pressure Lessar before being defeated by the New Light magician's tactics and allies.

The Church of England, also known as the Anglican Church, is one of the three largest Christian denominations in the world of Toaru Majutsu no Index. It was founded in the 16th century during the reign of King Henry VIII, who sought to free England from external religious influences. 

The Anglican Church specializes in inquisitions and anti-magic operations. To aid this, the Church created the 0th Parish Necessarius, a secret organization of magicians tasked with understanding and defending against magic. Despite initial resistance and a history of bloody witch hunts, Necessarius has since become the true power in the Church, eclipsing the official seat in Canterbury Cathedral.

The Church is the state religion of the United Kingdom, forming a power balance with the British Royal Family and Knights of England. It is more flexible in practices compared to other churches, encompassing a wide variety of sects and beliefs. The Church also maintains a global presence and close ties to Academy City.

Lancis is a member of the magic cabal New Light. She has long hair worn in two braids and wears the New Light uniform. Her spiritual item takes the form of dragon claws or nails, but their abilities are unknown.

Lancis' magic power is said to cause a tickling sensation through her body which can incapacitate her at times.
